selected.element_ja: 乖離（平均からの行き過ぎ）
selected.one_line_ja: 直近75本の回帰トレンド線から終値がどれだけ外れたかを、そのトレンドの普段のブレ幅で測る線です。トレンドに沿って動いている間は0付近にいて、吹き上げや投げで±60を超えます。
selected.raw_formula: CORRECTED version (red team). y_t = ln(close_t). n = 75. fit_t = ta.linreg(y,n,0) = OLS line over bars t-74..t (x = 0 oldest .. 74 current) evaluated at the current bar. b_t = ta.linreg(y,n,0) - ta.linreg(y,n,1) = OLS slope (ta.linreg = intercept + slope*(n-1-offset)). vy_t = ta.variance(y,n), population (biased=true). sres_t = sqrt(max(vy_t - b_t^2*(n^2-1)/12, 0)); this is the population stdev of the OLS residuals, because var(x) = (n^2-1)/12. zc_t = sres_t > 0 ? (y_t - fit_t)/sres_t : 0. zc is na for bars 0..73. zsm_t = f_ema(zc,3) (alpha 0.5, seeded with the first non-na zc at bar 74). The ta.correlation-based sres was dropped because it returns NaN on flat windows.
selected.normalization: line = zsm >= 0 ? 100*f_tanh(zsm/2.3) : 100*f_tanh(zsm/2.6). The asymmetric scale is needed because 3x crash residuals are larger. ±60 ⇔ +1.59 / -1.80 residual sigma. |line| < 100. A steady log-linear trend reads about 0, so the line does not pin through a trend.
selected.thresholds: Fixed: 高値圏ライン +60, 安値圏ライン -60. Measured share of bars beyond the lines: NQ3x 20% (9/11), SP3x 19% (8/11), GOOG3x 24% (13/11). Hysteresis 0 by default; the common '離脱の遊び' input is available if flicker appears.
selected.default_params: n=75 (about 3.5 months). Use log close. Do NOT go below 40 bars: that turns the line into an E3-like acceleration measure. Use n=50 only if tops must improve (top lift 1.82/1.83/1.44), but its E2 corr rises to 0.73 (Jaccard 0.32-0.37). Final EMA 3. kUp 2.3, kDn 2.6. Lines ±60. Distinctness lever: n 75→100.
selected.signals: Uses the common zone state machine on line vs U=+60 / L=-60. 高値圏突入: the state becomes +1 (line > +60). 高値圏離脱: the state leaves +1 (line <= +60 - hyst). 安値圏突入 and 安値圏離脱 mirror this at -60. Labels and alerts fire only at confirmed bar close. Reading: 突入 = price has run far beyond its 3-month trend line (blow-off or capitulation). 離脱 = the stretch has started to mean-revert.
selected.repaint: No repaint. It is the endpoint of a trailing regression on the current and past closes only. Nothing is refit into the past (unlike TradingView's drawn regression channel), and there are no offsets and no request.security. Signals are final at bar close, with a 0-bar delay. The forming bar moves intrabar, as is normal.
selected.pine_v6_core:
TAG = 'E1乖離'
G1 = '計算'
n    = input.int(75, '回帰期間(本)', minval=40, maxval=300, group=G1)
kU   = input.float(2.3, '上側スケール', minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=G1)
kD   = input.float(2.6, '下側スケール', minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=G1)
upTh = input.float(60.0, '高値圏ライン', group=GL)
loTh = input.float(-60.0, '安値圏ライン', group=GL)
float y    = math.log(close)
float fit  = ta.linreg(y, n, 0)
float b    = fit - ta.linreg(y, n, 1)          // OLS slope
float vy   = ta.variance(y, n)                  // biased=true (population)
float sres = na(vy) or na(b) ? na : math.sqrt(math.max(vy - b * b * (n * n - 1) / 12.0, 0.0))
float zc   = na(sres) ? na : sres > 0 ? (y - fit) / sres : 0.0
float zsm  = f_ema(zc, 3)
float line = na(zsm) ? na : 100.0 * f_tanh(zsm / (zsm >= 0 ? kU : kD))
float U = upTh
float L = loTh
string sfxTop = ''
string sfxBot = ''
selected.python_replication:
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view as swv
y = np.log(c); n = 75; X = np.arange(n, dtype=float); xm = X.mean(); vx = (n*n-1)/12.0
W = swv(y, n)                         # row r = bar r+n-1, oldest -> newest
ym = W.mean(1); b = ((W - ym[:, None])*(X - xm)).mean(1)/vx
fit = ym + b*(n-1-xm); vy = W.var(1)  # ddof=0
sres = np.sqrt(np.maximum(vy - b*b*vx, 0.0))
zc = np.full(len(y), np.nan); zc[n-1:] = np.where(sres > 0, (y[n-1:] - fit)/np.where(sres > 0, sres, 1.0), 0.0)
zsm = ema_p(zc, 3)
line = np.where(np.isnan(zsm), np.nan, 100*tanh_p(zsm/np.where(zsm >= 0, 2.3, 2.6)))
U = np.full(len(y), 60.0); L = -U; st, ev = zones(line, U, L)
Parity tolerance: 1e-9 relative, because ta.linreg and ta.variance may sum in a different order. Score from bar 300.
selected.expected_strengths: The most distinct E1 option. Corr with E2-tsi is 0.67, versus 0.86 for Bollinger-z, and zone Jaccard 0.25-0.33. It is the smoothest line in the set: mean|diff|/stdev 0.1-0.2. Bottom lift is strong at 2.34-2.93, peak lag is 0, and it does not pin while the trend is steady. It reads like a natural 75日線乖離 that already accounts for the trend.
selected.expected_weaknesses: Weak tops: lift 1.09-1.67, and many 15% tops are missed. After regime changes the 75-bar line still reflects the old trend, so zone runs can reach 19-27 bars. Mostly it fires at the end of accelerations, so it leans toward confirmation. Daily-change corr with E2 is still about 0.80, and corr 0.73 with E6. Watch the E1-E2 pair in the distinctness checks.

selected.element_ja: 勢い（上昇と下落の強さ）
selected.one_line_ja: 直近の上げ幅と下げ幅の綱引き（短期TSI）です。一方的な買いや売りが積み上がるほど±に伸び、天井や底の足で山や谷を作ります。
selected.raw_formula: pc_t = close_t - close_{t-1}, with pc_0 = 0 (nz(ta.change(close))). num = f_ema(f_ema(pc,6),3) and den = f_ema(f_ema(|pc|,6),3). Every f_ema uses alpha = 2/(n+1) and is seeded with its first input (bar 0); the inner length 6 is applied first. line_t = den_t > 0 ? clamp(100*num_t/den_t, -100, 100) : 0.
selected.normalization: |num| <= den holds exactly (same positive weights and seeds), so line is in [-100,100] with no mapping. The clamp is only a numeric guard. 0 = balanced; ±100 = completely one-sided.
selected.thresholds: Default 適応 (adaptive, drawn as plotted lines). U_t = clamp(PNR(line,120,90), 35, 75) and L_t = clamp(PNR(line,120,10), -75, -35). PNR = nearest rank over the last 120 non-na values, current bar included: sort ascending and take rank ceil(p*120/100), i.e. the 108th value for 90% and the 12th for 10%. Before 120 values exist, use the fallback ±55. Option 固定: ±55. Measured zone share 20.3-21.5% on every dataset (top 10.7-11.3 / bottom 9.7-10.3). Bull-year top-zone time is 12-17%, versus 22-26% with fixed lines.
selected.default_params: r1=6, r2=3 (centre of mass about 3.5 bars, which suits 3x legs with a median of 10-18 bars). Adaptive window 120, percentiles 90/10, clamps 35-75, fallback ±55. Scale-free, so 1x and 3x use the same defaults. Treat E2 as the anchor: no distinctness lever is applied to it.
selected.signals: Common state machine on line vs the same-bar U_t / L_t. 高値圏突入 means one-sided buying is near its peak (median 2 bars before the extreme) — そろそろ高値. 高値圏離脱 means the imbalance is breaking down and the turn is under way. 安値圏突入 and 安値圏離脱 mirror this. About 9 entries per side per year.
selected.repaint: No repaint. The EMAs are causal recursions with fixed seeds, and the percentile window holds only the current and past bars. Labels and alerts fire only at confirmed bar close, with a 0-bar delay. Adaptive lines did not cause any threshold-driven crossings in testing.

selected.expected_strengths: Best momentum lift: tops 1.57-1.68, bottoms 2.31-2.56. Peak lag 0, and 54-70% of extremes fall within ±2 bars. Median lead of zone entry is 2 bars, which is real 「そろそろ」. Smooth (38-40 direction changes per 100 bars). Zone share is a stable 21% on all datasets, and the adaptive lines do not pin in bull years.
selected.expected_weaknesses: On rounded or distribution tops momentum fades first, so 高値圏離脱 comes before the final high. Single ±8-10% gap days dominate the short EMAs. Adaptive lines lag regime changes by weeks. Opposite-zone entry within 4 bars after 13-19% of highs. Every price-based line partly co-moves with it (E1, E6, E8), so it is the reference pane for the distinctness checks.

selected.element_ja: 加速・失速（勢いの変化）
selected.one_line_ja: 今の上昇脚（下落脚）で一番速かった時に比べて、速度がどれだけ落ちたかを表す線です。勢いの『失速』を見るもので、加速している間は0付近にいます。
selected.raw_formula: r_t = nz(ln(close_t/close_{t-1})), with r_0 = 0. v = f_ss(r,4): 2-pole SuperSmoother, y_0 = x_0, y_1 = x_1, y_t = c1*(x_t + x_{t-1})/2 + c2*y_{t-1} + c3*y_{t-2}, where a1 = exp(-sqrt2*pi/4), c2 = 2*a1*cos(sqrt2*pi/4), c3 = -a1^2, c1 = 1 - c2 - c3 (≈0.81600, 0.29245, -0.10845). sig = f_rma(|v|,100), seeded |v_0| = 0. Leg state (var): s = v > 0 ? 1 : v < 0 ? -1 : (side == 0 ? 1 : side). If s != side, a new leg starts: side = s, pk = |v|. Otherwise pk = max(pk, |v|). raw = side*(pk - |v|)/max(pk, 1.0*sig), or 0 if the denominator is 0. line = f_ema(100*raw, 3).
selected.normalization: 0 <= pk - |v| <= pk <= max(pk, sig), so |raw| <= 1 and line is in (-100,100) with no clipping. Legs whose peak speed is below the typical speed sig are scaled down, so chop stays near 0. The line is a ratio, so it is scale-free across 1x and 3x.
selected.thresholds: Fixed ±45: the leg has lost at least 45% of its peak speed. Measured zone share 12.1-13.5% (top 7.7-9.7 / bottom 3.7-4.3). Option ±40 gives 15-17%. Fixed lines suit this indicator because it is already relative to the leg's own peak.
selected.default_params: SuperSmoother period 4, sig window 100, floor 1.0*sig, final EMA 3, lines ±45. Lever: ±40 if the zone share is below 10%.
selected.signals: Common state machine with U = +45, L = -45. 高値圏突入: the up-leg is still on but has lost at least 45% of its peak speed — 失速、そろそろ天井 (often 0-1 bar after the high). 高値圏離脱 has two meanings, read from the line's shape: a fall through 0 to negative means the leg flipped (反落開始); an easing while still positive means the move re-accelerated (上昇継続). 安値圏突入 and 安値圏離脱 mirror this. About 16-17 entries per year.
selected.repaint: No repaint. SuperSmoother, RMA and EMA are causal. The leg and peak state is held in var variables, which Pine rolls back on every realtime tick, so it is committed only at bar close. No pivots. Signals are final at bar close, with a 0-bar delay. By concept the line peaks about 1 bar after the price extreme.
selected.pine_v6_core:
TAG = 'E3失速'
G1 = '計算'
P    = input.int(4, '速度の平滑期間', minval=2, group=G1)
sigN = input.int(100, '平均速度の期間', minval=20, group=G1)
flr  = input.float(1.0, '小さな脚のフロア(σ倍)', minval=0.1, step=0.1, group=G1)
post = input.int(3, '仕上げEMA', minval=1, group=G1)
T    = input.float(45.0, 'ライン ±', minval=10.0, maxval=95.0, group=GL)
float r   = nz(math.log(close / close[1]))
float v   = f_ss(r, P)
float sig = f_rma(math.abs(v), sigN)
var int   side = 0
var float pk   = 0.0
int s = v > 0 ? 1 : v < 0 ? -1 : side == 0 ? 1 : side
if s != side
    side := s
    pk   := math.abs(v)
else
    pk   := math.max(pk, math.abs(v))
float den  = math.max(pk, flr * sig)
float raw  = den > 0 ? side * (pk - math.abs(v)) / den : 0.0
float line = f_ema(100.0 * raw, post)
float U = T
float L = -T
string sfxTop = '(失速)'
string sfxBot = '(失速)'
selected.expected_strengths: Pure change of momentum: daily-change corr with E2 is only 0.18 (level 0.64), and Jaccard is <= 0.19 with every pick. The opposite-zone flip rate is low (4-11%). It is the smoothest of the E3 options (about 31 direction changes per 100 bars) and never pins (runs <= 14). It complements E2: E2 says 「そろそろ」, E3 says 「失速した＝転換が近い/始まった」. Bottom lift is 1.74-3.04 with the [p-5,p+3] window.
selected.expected_weaknesses: On NASDAQ-3x blow-off tops it has almost no lead (top lift 1.10), because price accelerates into the high. The bottom side fires rarely (about 4% of bars), since crash legs end in a V. 高値圏離脱 is ambiguous (flip vs re-acceleration). The leg reset makes a quick drop at the turn. Zone share is about 13%, at the low end of the target.

selected.name_ja: 出来高重心オシレーター（VCOG）
selected.one_line_ja: 直近10本で、大商いが高い価格帯と安い価格帯のどちらに集中したかを表す線です。高値帯での大商いは天井警戒、安値帯での大商いは底警戒のサインです。
selected.raw_formula: CORRECTED version (custom EMAs, alerts gated). v_t = nz(volume_t)*close_t (dollar volume; an option uses shares only). tp = hlc3. evh = f_ema(v*tp,10), ev = f_ema(v,10), ewp = f_ema(tp,10), all seeded with their bar-0 value. atr = f_rma(ta.tr(true),14), seeded with TR_0 = high_0 - low_0. raw_t = (ev > 0 and atr > 0) ? (evh/ev - ewp)/atr : 0. With constant volume, vwp = ewp exactly, so raw is identically 0: all movement comes from how volume is distributed across price levels.
selected.normalization: rms_t = sqrt(ta.sma(raw^2, 252)), defined from bar 251. line = rms > 0 ? 100*f_tanh(raw/rms/1.5) : na. ±60 ⇔ z ≈ ±1.04. The RMS self-normalisation absorbs the 2.5x scale difference between symbols.
selected.thresholds: Fixed ±60. Measured zone share 16-20% (NQ3x 13/7, SP3x 8/11, GOOG 12/5). The adaptive option is not used by default.
selected.default_params: len 10, ATR 14, RMS window 252, scale 1.5, dollar volume ON (on a 3x ETF the share count rises mechanically as price falls), entry-label cooldown 3. Lever: len 10→14. Validation input: index Volume × index Close, never index Volume × 3x close (that creates a price-level bias).
selected.signals: Common state machine on ±60. 高値圏突入 = 高値帯に大商い (天井警戒期間). 安値圏突入 = 安値帯に大商い (底警戒期間). The exits mean that warning context has ended. This is a context/warning type, not a pinpoint type: in caught turns it enters 2-5 bars before the extreme. About 5-7 entries per side per year. If the symbol has no volume (cumulative volume is 0), the pane shows the label '出来高データなし' and the line is na.
selected.repaint: No repaint by calculation. It uses only current and past OHLCV, with no security calls and no offsets, and signals are final at bar close with a 0-bar delay. Caveat: the data vendor can revise the day's volume after the close, which can change the last bar slightly. That is a data correction, not script repaint.
selected.pine_v6_core:

normLen = input.int(252, '正規化期間(本)', minval=50, group=G1)

float L = loTh

string sfxBot = '(出来高)'

v = vol_index*close_index   # validation: underlying index dollar volume; zero-volume days stay 0
tp = (h + l + c)/3            # 3x-synthesized H/L/C
evh = ema_p(v*tp, 10); ev = ema_p(v, 10); ewp = ema_p(tp, 10); atr = rma_p(tr_p(h, l, c), 14)

Purity checks to re-run: constant v gives line ≡ 0 (or na); time-shuffled v must drop the lift to about 1. Score from bar 300.
selected.expected_strengths: The only E4 type whose information is verified to come from volume: shuffling volume kills the lift, and constant volume gives 0. It has the lowest correlation with every other pick (<= 0.31) and RSI zone overlap of 15-19%. Labels are sparse (stays about 4 bars, 5-8 entries a year), and the line is smooth. It works as independent volume-based confirmation of the price panes.
selected.expected_weaknesses: The weakest predictor: recall 0.24-0.53, and it does not point at the extreme bar. False top warnings persist in volume-backed recoveries (zone runs 16-22 bars, e.g. 2003/2009-type rallies). Validation uses index dollar volume, but TQQQ's own volume (leveraged-ETF hedging and dip-buying flows) may behave differently, so re-check it on real ETF volume. The line is invalid on symbols without volume. Volume split-adjustment on TradingView is unverified.

selected.one_line_ja: 今の大きなスイングが、過去の同じ方向の大波と比べて日柄的にどれだけ成熟したかを表す線です。古い波が高値（安値）を更新し続けるほど±に伸び、更新が止まると時間とともにしぼみます。
selected.raw_formula: CORRECTED version, de-correlated from E6. Uses the shared causal swing detector SD (shared_helpers) with k = 3.0 (major swings, about 9 legs per year), while E6 keeps k = 2. Per bar, after the SD update: s = dir; ae = eB - pB (bars from the pivot to the latest extreme); sb = t - eB (bars since that extreme); D_s = durations of the last <= 8 completed legs in the same direction. raw_t = 100*s*KC(ae; D_s; rho=0.15, c=1.0)*exp(-(sb/4)^2), where KC(v; a_1..a_m; rho, c) = (1/m)*Σ_j 1/(1 + exp(-clamp((v - a_j)/(rho*a_j + c), -50, 50))). raw = na if dir = 0 or size(D_s) < 3. line = raw (no smoothing).
selected.normalization: KC is a smoothed percentile in (0,1), and the fade exp(-(sb/4)^2) is in (0,1]. With the sign and ×100, line is in (-100,100) with no clamp. Fade after 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 bars without a new extreme: 0.94, 0.78, 0.57, 0.37, 0.11. 0 means neutral (a swing just confirmed, or a stalled swing).
selected.thresholds: Fixed ±70: the swing is older than about 70% of recent same-direction major swings and is still making new extremes. Measured at k=3: zone 15/15/17% (NQ3x/SP3x/GOOG3x), runs <= 20 bars.
selected.default_params: SD k = 3.0 (E5 only), nAtr 50 (SMA-seeded Wilder RMA of log TR), K 8, Kmin 3. KC rho 0.15, c 1 bar. tau 4. No smoothing. Lines ±70. Lever: k 3→3.5 (corr with E6 falls to 0.71-0.78). History-start dependence lasts about 8 legs (about 11 months at k=3).
selected.signals: Common state machine on ±70. 高値圏突入: the major up-swing is mature in time and has just made a new high — 日柄的にそろそろ. 高値圏離脱: usually no new high for 2-3 bars (time fade), meaning the top may be in, or the reversal got confirmed. Mirror for the bottom side. The peak lands on the bar of the last new extreme (median lag 0).
selected.repaint: No repaint. The detector is causal and threshold-confirmed. Past pivots are only bookkeeping inside the bar-t calculation and are never drawn back in time. Signals are final at bar close, with a 0-bar delay. The detector's own confirmation comes a median of several bars after the extreme, but the line does not wait for it. The var UDT/array state relies on Pine's realtime rollback; this is checked by the realtime reload test in the validation plan.
selected.pine_v6_core:
TAG = 'E5日柄'

selected.one_line_ja: 今のスイングの値幅が、直近8回の同方向スイングの何割より大きくなったかを表す線です。高値（安値）から押したり戻したりすると0へ戻り、反転が確定した足でちょうど0になります。
selected.raw_formula: CORRECTED version (asymmetric lines). Shared detector SD with k = 2.0. selected.normalization: KC is in (0,1) and the hand-off factor (1-u) is in [0,1], so line is in (-100,100). The line reaches exactly 0 when the pullback equals θ, i.e. at swing confirmation, so there is no formula jump. Right after confirmation a new swing starts at about ±5-10.
selected.thresholds: Fixed asymmetric lines: 高値圏ライン +65, 安値圏ライン -55. This balances the top-heavy zone: 21/20/21% total, about 14-15% top and 6-7% bottom. Top lift rises to 1.46/1.44 (NQ/SP). Option for the pinpoint variant (smLen=1): ±65.
selected.default_params: SD k = 2.0, nAtr 50, K 8, Kmin 3. KC rho 0.15, c 0. WMA3. Lines +65/-55. Optional lever: a hand-off at 0.6θ (u = clamp(s*(eX-x)/(0.6θ),0,1)), which shortens top runs from 33-40 to 22-32 bars. Second lever: +70/-55.
selected.signals: Common state machine with U = +65 and L = -55. 高値圏突入: the up-swing is already bigger than about 65% of recent up-swings and price is near its high — 値幅的にそろそろ天井. 高値圏離脱: usually a pullback of about a third of θ (about 3-4% on TQQQ), meaning the top may be in; a new high re-enters the zone. Mirror at -55. About 6.6 top and 4 bottom entries per year.
selected.repaint: No repaint. The causal threshold-confirmed detector uses only data up to t, nothing is redrawn, and closed-bar values are final, with a 0-bar delay. The raw line peaks on the extreme close itself; WMA3 can shift the plotted peak by 0-1 bar. The swing confirmation, where the line reaches 0, comes a median 4 bars after the extreme. selected.name_ja: サイクル位相（相関サイクル）
selected.one_line_ja: 直近20本の値動きを1周期の波と照らし合わせる『サイクル時計』です。サイクルの山（谷）の約2本前にラインを越え、山（谷）の足で折り返します。
selected.raw_formula: P = 20. x_i = ln(close_{t-i}) for i = 0..P-1 (i = bars ago). Templates: c_i = cos(2π i/P) (crest now) and s_i = -sin(2π i/P) (rising phase). Raw sums with n = P: Sx, Sxx, Sc, Scc, Sxc, Ss, Sss, Sxs. Vx = n*Sxx - Sx^2. Real = (n*Sxc - Sx*Sc)/sqrt(Vx*(n*Scc - Sc^2)); Imag = (n*Sxs - Sx*Ss)/sqrt(Vx*(n*Sss - Ss^2)); both are 0 if Vx <= 0. mag = sqrt(Real^2 + Imag^2). The line is na for bar_index < P-1. There is no recursion and no seed.
selected.normalization: line = 100*Real/max(mag, 0.5). |Real| <= mag, so line is in [-100,100]. In a coherent cycle (mag >= 0.5) the line is a pure phase reading, 100*cos φ. In a non-cyclic window it shrinks toward 0. A straight ramp reads +15.6 (analytically verified), so trends read neutral.
selected.thresholds: Fixed ±85: within about ±32° (about ±1.8 bars) of the crest or trough. Measured zone share 17-18%, split evenly top/bottom. ±90 gives about 14%.
selected.default_params: P = 20 (the measured median dominant cycle on 3x indices is 20-22 bars; sensible range 16-24, 16-18 for SOXL, 20-24 for SPXL). z0 = 0.5. Source ln(close). Lines ±85. Lever: P 20→18. Detrending was tested and rejected (zone share explodes to 45-50%).
selected.signals: Common state machine on ±85. 高値圏突入 comes about 2-3 bars before the cycle crest — サイクル的にそろそろ高値. 高値圏離脱 comes on the crest bar or the next bar: the cycle has turned. Mirror at the trough. Every cycle crest visits the zone, including small ones.
selected.repaint: No repaint. The value is a pure function of the last 20 closes: no recursion, no pivots, no dependence on where chart history starts. Signals are final at bar close, with a 0-bar delay. max_bars_back must cover the dynamic close[i].

float sxc = 0.0

float sss = 0.0

for i = 0 to P - 1
    float xv = math.log(close[i])
    float cv = math.cos(2.0 * math.pi * i / P)
    float sv = -math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * i / P)
    sx  += xv
    sxx += xv * xv
    sc  += cv
    scc += cv * cv
    sxc += xv * cv
    ss  += sv
    sss += sv * sv
    sxs += xv * sv

selected.name_ja: 高値・安値切り上げ連続
selected.one_line_ja: 高値・安値の切り上げ（切り下げ）が何日連続したかを数える『階段』の線です。連続が長いほど、その方向への動きが疲れてきているとみます。
selected.raw_formula: hh_t = high_t > high_{t-1}; hl_t = low_t > low_{t-1}; ll_t = low_t < low_{t-1}; lh_t = high_t < high_{t-1}. All comparisons are strict and false at t = 0; equality breaks a streak. Each run length r_t = cond ? r_{t-1} + 1 : 0 (seed 0, uncapped). f = min(r/N, 1) with N = 5. Hold-and-decay H_t = max(f_t, rho*H_{t-1}) with rho = 0.5, seed 0, kept separately for each of the 4 runs. C_HH = H(hh) - H(ll); C_HL = H(hl) - H(lh).
selected.normalization: line = 100*(C_HH + C_HL)/2, in [-100,100]. One step adds 10 per component (N=5). After a break the component halves each bar, so the drop is smooth, and the timing of a fresh streak is unchanged.
selected.default_params: N = 5 (the measured 90th-percentile run length of HH/HL on NQ3x), rho 0.5, lines ±65. Scale-free. Lever: N 5→6.
selected.signals: Common state machine on ±65. 高値圏突入: a clean staircase of higher highs and higher lows has run long — 買いの連続が疲弊、そろそろ高値. 高値圏離脱: the staircase broke (inside bar, or a lower high/low). Mirror at the bottom. The peak lands on the extreme bar (median lag 0 to 1 bar early).
selected.repaint: No repaint on confirmed bars. It uses only the current and prior bar's high/low. The forming bar's high/low can still extend intrabar, so labels and alerts wait for barstate.isconfirmed. The decay forgets within about 7 bars (no history-start dependence). 0-bar delay.

def run_len(b):
    out = np.zeros(len(b)); r = 0
    for t, v in enumerate(b): r = r + 1 if v else 0; out[t] = r
    return out
def hold(f, rho=0.5):
    out = np.zeros(len(f)); m = 0.0
    for t, v in enumerate(f): m = max(v, rho*m); out[t] = m
    return out
hp, lp = np.r_[np.nan, h[:-1]], np.r_[np.nan, l[:-1]]
hh, lh = h > hp, h < hp; hl, ll = l > lp, l < lp   # NaN compares False at t=0
F = lambda b: np.minimum(run_len(b)/5, 1)
line = 100*((hold(F(hh)) - hold(F(ll))) + (hold(F(hl)) - hold(F(lh))))/2
U = np.full(len(c), 65.0); st, ev = zones(line, U, -U)

selected.name_ja: 恐怖・慢心ゲージ（ボラ拡大・収縮）
selected.one_line_ja: 値動きの荒さの急変を表す、恐怖指数の代わりの線です。下げで値幅が急に広がると恐怖として安値圏、値幅が縮んで静かすぎると慢心として高値圏に入ります。
selected.raw_formula: trp_t = ta.tr(true)/close_{t-1} (true range %; na at bar 0). vf = f_rma(trp,3), vs = f_rma(trp,30), both seeded with trp_1. VR = (vf > 0 and vs > 0) ? ln(vf/vs) : 0, na while either is na. r_t = ln(close_t/close_{t-1}), with r_0 = 0. up2 = f_ema(r > 0 ? r^2 : 0, 5) and dn2 = f_ema(r < 0 ? r^2 : 0, 5), seeded at bar 0. gate = (up2 + dn2) > 0 ? f_tanh(4*(dn2 - up2)/(up2 + dn2)) : 0 (+1 = down-driven). w = gate > 0 ? gate : 0.5*gate. xx = VR > 0 ? -VR*w : -VR (na if VR is na). xs = f_ema(xx,3). Amplitude comes only from the volatility term structure VR; the gate only signs an expansion.
selected.normalization: line = xs >= 0 ? 100*f_tanh(xs/0.45) : 100*f_tanh(xs/0.26). The asymmetry follows the right-skewed log vol ratio. +60 ⇔ the fast range is about 27% below base (complacency); -60 ⇔ a down-driven range expansion of about 1.2x base after smoothing (fear). |line| >= 95 on about 1% of bars.
selected.thresholds: Fixed ±60. Measured zone share 17-20% (NQ3x 10/8, SP3x 12/8, GOOG3x 9/9).
selected.default_params: Fast RMA 3, base RMA 30, gate EMA 5, gate sharpness 4, blow-off weight 0.5, final EMA 3, kUp 0.45 / kDn 0.26, lines ±60. TR% scales with leverage but cancels in the ratio, so the defaults are leverage-invariant. Lever: base 30→40.
selected.signals: Common state machine on ±60. 安値圏突入(恐怖): a selling climax is in progress, often on the low day itself. 安値圏離脱: fear is receding, the bottom is usually in. 高値圏突入(慢心): ranges are unusually narrow, an early complacency warning rather than a price-top pinpoint. 高値圏離脱: ranges are re-expanding, the usual top confirmation. Label suffixes make this meaning explicit.
selected.repaint: No repaint. It uses only the current and past H/L/C. The custom var recursions are rolled back intrabar. No request.security and no external VIX. Signals are final at bar close, with a 0-bar delay. Seed influence lasts about 150 bars.
selected.pine_v6_core:
TAG = 'E10ボラ'
G1 = '計算'
fL   = input.int(3, '短期値幅 RMA', minval=1, group=G1)
sL   = input.int(30, '基準値幅 RMA', minval=5, group=G1)
gL   = input.int(5, '上下判定 EMA', minval=2, group=G1)
sh   = input.float(4.0, '上下判定の鋭さ', minval=0.5, group=G1)
wb   = input.float(0.5, '吹き上げの重み', minval=0.0, maxval=1.0, group=G1)
smL  = input.int(3, '平滑EMA', minval=1, group=G1)
kUp  = input.float(0.45, 'スケール上側(慢心)', minval=0.05, step=0.01, group=G1)
kDn  = input.float(0.26, 'スケール下側(恐怖)', minval=0.05, step=0.01, group=G1)
upTh = input.float(60.0, '高値圏ライン', group=GL)
loTh = input.float(-60.0, '安値圏ライン', group=GL)
float trp  = na(close[1]) ? na : ta.tr(true) / close[1]
float vf   = f_rma(trp, fL)
float vs   = f_rma(trp, sL)
float vr   = na(vf) or na(vs) ? na : vf > 0 and vs > 0 ? math.log(vf / vs) : 0.0
float r    = na(close[1]) ? 0.0 : math.log(close / close[1])
float up2  = f_ema(r > 0 ? r * r : 0.0, gL)
float dn2  = f_ema(r < 0 ? r * r : 0.0, gL)
float gate = up2 + dn2 > 0 ? f_tanh(sh * (dn2 - up2) / (up2 + dn2)) : 0.0
float w    = gate > 0 ? gate : wb * gate
float xx   = na(vr) ? na : vr > 0 ? -vr * w : -vr
float xs   = f_ema(xx, smL)
float line = na(xs) ? na : 100.0 * f_tanh(xs / (xs >= 0 ? kUp : kDn))
float U = upTh
float L = loTh
string sfxTop = '(慢心)'
string sfxBot = '(恐怖)'

w = np.where(gate > 0, gate, 0.5*gate)

Validate on NQ3x, GOOG3x and SP3x 2007+ (TR uses H/L). Score from bar 300.
selected.expected_strengths: Amplitude comes purely from volatility, so it is genuinely different: corr <= 0.62 with every pick, daily-change corr 0.46-0.49 with E1/E2/E6. It pinpoints panic lows (median offset 0; bottom lift 2.20-3.38): e.g. 2011-08-08 -100, 2015-08-24 -99, 2018-12-24 -85/-93. It also gives a calm-before-the-top warning (SP 2007-10). Leverage-invariant, any symbol, and no external VIX needed.
selected.expected_weaknesses: The top side is weak (lift 1.08-1.44, NQ near chance): it is complacency, not price location, and 5-10% of top-zone bars sit below SMA50 (27% on GOOG), e.g. quiet bases. Tops made in high volatility (2000-03) are missed, and so are quiet lows made while volatility is already falling (2002-10, 2009-03). Top runs reach 16-24 bars in calm uptrends. Earnings gaps on single stocks distort it.

final.common_pane_spec:
Applies identically to all 10 files. The only differences are the core block, the default line values, TAG and the label suffix.
1) Pane and scale: indicator(..., overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500, max_bars_back=1000). One common scale, -100..+100, 0 = neutral. Two transparent plots at +100 and -100 (display=display.pane, editable=false) fix the autoscale, so every pane looks the same and the lines never jump. The main line is the FIRST plot, so {{plot_0}} = the line in alert messages.
2) Main line, color by level: one smooth line, linewidth input 1-4 (default 2; 3 recommended on iPhone).
- line > U (in the top zone): solid red #d32f2f.
- 0 <= line <= U: color.from_gradient(line, 0.3*U, U, gray #9e9e9e, orange #f57c00). It stays gray in neutral and warms to orange as it approaches the line (「そろそろ」).
- L <= line < 0: color.from_gradient(line, L, 0.3*L, light green #66bb6a, gray).
- line < L (in the bottom zone): solid green #2e7d32.
3) Threshold lines: 高値圏ライン = red #d32f2f, linewidth 1, solid; 安値圏ライン = green #2e7d32, linewidth 1, solid. Both are drawn with plot(), not hline(), so the adaptive E2 lines and the fixed lines use the same code and can be filled. display=display.pane (no price-scale tag or status-line clutter). The 0 line is an hline, gray at 50% transparency, dotted. There are no other levels: no ±85 dotted sets and no stage text.
4) Fills (light):
- Static band between U and +100: red at 94% transparency. Same between L and -100 in green.
- Excursion fill between the main line and the threshold, only while beyond it: red or green at 60-65% transparency. Input 'ライン超えの塗り', default ON.
5) Background tint: bgcolor at 93% transparency while in a zone. Input 'ゾーン中の背景色', default OFF; offered for small screens.
6) Sparse labels, only at zone events on confirmed bars:
- 高値圏突入: at y=line, label.style_label_down, solid red, white text, size.small.
- 安値圏突入: at y=line, style_label_up, solid green, size.small.
- 高値圏離脱: at y=U, style_label_up, red at 70% transparency, size.tiny.
- 安値圏離脱: at y=L, style_label_down, faded green, size.tiny.
Exit labels sit on the neutral side of the line, so they never overlap the entry label. A same-side entry label is not repeated within 'cool' bars (default 3; E9 uses 5). Optional suffix per indicator: (慢心)/(恐怖) for E10, (天井確認)/(底確認) for E9, and so on. Exit labels can be hidden ('離脱ラベル'; E9 default OFF). No plotshape, dots, triangles, histograms or side text anywhere.
7) Status table: one cell, table.new at a selectable corner (default top_right), updated only on barstate.islast. Text: '【E1乖離】状態: 高値圏 3本目 / 上ライン超え +8', '【E1乖離】状態: 上ライン接近 / 上ラインまで 12' (when line >= 0.75*U), '【E1乖離】状態: 中立 / 下ラインまで 41'. '（確定前）' is appended while the realtime bar is still open. Text color is red/green in a zone and chart.fg_color otherwise. bgcolor = chart.bg_color at 20% transparency. Text size input 小/中/大 (default 小). The TAG lets the user tell the 10 panes apart on a phone.
8) Zone state machine (common, deterministic, mirrored in Python zones()): zone ∈ {+1, 0, -1}.
- Exit: from +1 when line <= U - hyst; from -1 when line >= L + hyst.
- Entry from 0: +1 if line > U, -1 if line < L. Exit and opposite entry can happen on the same bar.
- hyst defaults to 0 ('離脱の遊び').
Events are state changes: topIn, topOut, botIn, botOut. zBars counts the bars spent in the current zone. ta.crossover is NOT used: this avoids both the strict/non-strict ambiguity and the v6 lazy-and evaluation issue.
9) Alerts: alertcondition titles exactly 高値圏突入 / 高値圏離脱 / 安値圏突入 / 安値圏離脱 / ゾーン変化(いずれか). Every condition is ANDed with barstate.isconfirmed. Message format: '{{ticker}} <TAG> 高値圏突入'. There is also one alert() call with a dynamic message (event + value) using alert.freq_once_per_bar_close, for the 'Any alert() function call' alert type. The user should create alerts with 'Once Per Bar Close'.
10) Japanese inputs, grouped into 計算 / ライン / 表示. Every input is labelled in Japanese; tooltips explain what the line means at ±.
11) Mobile readability:
- shorttitle = E-number + element word (E1乖離, E2勢い, E3失速, E4出来高, E5日柄, E6値幅, E7周期, E8連続, E9足形, E10ボラ).
- At most 3 plotted lines + the 0 line, 2 label styles and 1 table cell.
- Colors are legible on both light and dark themes.
- Values are integers (precision 0).
- Recommendation: show 2-3 panes at a time on an iPhone and keep the rest hidden.
12) Distinct shapes are intentional and must be preserved, so that the panes do not look alike: E1 slow smooth, E2 fast smooth, E3 ramp that resets at leg flips, E4 slow context, E5 time-fade, E6 tracks price then 0 at confirmation, E7 sine, E8 staircase, E9 pulses, E10 spikes at panics.
final.common_pine_skeleton:
//@version=6
// ===== 共通スケルトン: 各ファイルは [指標固有ブロック] だけを差し替える =====
indicator('E0 名前', shorttitle='E0', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500, max_bars_back=1000)

// ---- 色 ----
color C_RED  = #d32f2f
color C_ORG  = #f57c00
color C_GRY  = #9e9e9e
color C_LGRN = #66bb6a
color C_GRN  = #2e7d32

// ---- 共通入力 ----
GV = '表示'
GL = 'ライン'
lw       = input.int(2, 'メインラインの太さ', minval=1, maxval=4, group=GV)
showIn   = input.bool(true, '突入ラベル', group=GV)
showOut  = input.bool(true, '離脱ラベル', group=GV)            // E9: false
cool     = input.int(3, '同じ側の突入ラベルの間隔(本)', minval=0, group=GV)   // E9: 5
showFill = input.bool(true, 'ライン超えの塗り', group=GV)
showBg   = input.bool(false, 'ゾーン中の背景色', group=GV)
showTbl  = input.bool(true, '状態テーブル', group=GV)
tblPosS  = input.string('右上', 'テーブル位置', options=['右上', '右下', '左上', '左下'], group=GV)
tblSizeS = input.string('小', 'テーブル文字', options=['小', '中', '大'], group=GV)
hyst     = input.float(0.0, '離脱の遊び(0=なし)', minval=0.0, maxval=30.0, group=GL)

// ---- 共通ヘルパー（必ず毎バー無条件に呼ぶ: var 状態は呼び出し位置ごと）----
f_ema(float x, simple int n) =>        // α=2/(n+1), 最初の非na値で初期化, na入力で再初期化
    var float s = na
    float a = 2.0 / (n + 1)
    s := na(s) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s
    s
f_rma(float x, simple int n) =>        // α=1/n, 同上
    var float s = na
    s := na(s) ? x : x / n + (1.0 - 1.0 / n) * s
    s
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e = math.exp(-2.0 * math.abs(x))
    math.sign(x) * (1.0 - e) / (1.0 + e)
f_ss(float x, simple int P) =>          // Ehlers 2極 SuperSmoother, 最初の2本は素通し
    float a1 = math.exp(-math.sqrt(2.0) * math.pi / P)
    float c2 = 2.0 * a1 * math.cos(math.sqrt(2.0) * math.pi / P)
    float c3 = -a1 * a1
    float c1 = 1.0 - c2 - c3
    var float y1 = na
    var float y2 = na
    var float x1 = na
    var int k = 0
    float y = k < 2 ? x : c1 * (x + x1) / 2.0 + c2 * y1 + c3 * y2
    y2 := y1
    y1 := y
    x1 := x
    k += 1
    y
f_pnr(float x, simple int n, float p) =>   // 直近n個(当日含む)の最近順位パーセンタイル ceil(p*n/100)番目
    var array<float> buf = array.new<float>()
    if not na(x)
        buf.push(x)
        if buf.size() > n
            buf.shift()
    float r = na
    if buf.size() == n
        array<float> srt = buf.copy()
        srt.sort(order.ascending)
        r := srt.get(int(math.ceil(p * n / 100.0)) - 1)
    r
// E5/E6 のみ: f_logatr と SD ブロック（shared_helpers）

// ======== [指標固有ブロック] ここだけ差し替え ========
// 必須: TAG(定数文字列), float line(-100..100), float U(高値圏ライン), float L(安値圏ライン), string sfxTop, string sfxBot
TAG = 'E0'
float line = na
float U = 60.0
float L = -60.0
string sfxTop = ''
string sfxBot = ''
// ====================================================

// ---- ゾーン状態機械（Python zones() と同一）----
var int zone  = 0          // 1=高値圏, -1=安値圏, 0=中立
var int zBars = 0
var int lastTopLbl = na
var int lastBotLbl = na
int prevZ = zone
int newZ  = zone
if not na(line) and not na(U) and not na(L)
    if zone == 1 and line <= U - hyst
        newZ := 0
    else if zone == -1 and line >= L + hyst
        newZ := 0
    if newZ == 0
        newZ := line > U ? 1 : line < L ? -1 : 0
bool topIn  = newZ == 1 and prevZ != 1
bool topOut = prevZ == 1 and newZ != 1
bool botIn  = newZ == -1 and prevZ != -1
bool botOut = prevZ == -1 and newZ != -1
zBars := newZ == 0 ? 0 : newZ == prevZ ? zBars + 1 : 1
zone  := newZ

// ---- 描画 ----
color lineCol = na(line) ? na : line > U ? C_RED : line < L ? C_GRN : line >= 0 ? color.from_gradient(line, 0.3 * U, U, C_GRY, C_ORG) : color.from_gradient(line, L, 0.3 * L, C_LGRN, C_GRY)
pLine = plot(line, 'メインライン', color=lineCol, linewidth=lw)
pU    = plot(U, '高値圏ライン', color=C_RED, linewidth=1, display=display.pane)
pL    = plot(L, '安値圏ライン', color=C_GRN, linewidth=1, display=display.pane)
pTop  = plot(100, '上端', color=color.new(C_RED, 100), display=display.pane, editable=false)
pBot  = plot(-100, '下端', color=color.new(C_GRN, 100), display=display.pane, editable=false)
hline(0, '0', color=color.new(C_GRY, 50), linestyle=hline.style_dotted)
fill(pU, pTop, color=color.new(C_RED, 94), title='高値圏の帯')
fill(pL, pBot, color=color.new(C_GRN, 94), title='安値圏の帯')
fill(pLine, pU, color=showFill and line > U ? color.new(C_RED, 62) : na, title='高値圏の塗り')
fill(pLine, pL, color=showFill and line < L ? color.new(C_GRN, 62) : na, title='安値圏の塗り')
bgcolor(showBg and zone == 1 ? color.new(C_RED, 93) : showBg and zone == -1 ? color.new(C_GRN, 93) : na, title='ゾーン背景')

// ---- ラベル（確定足のみ）----
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn and showIn and (na(lastTopLbl) or bar_index - lastTopLbl > cool)
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏突入' + sfxTop, style=label.style_label_down, color=C_RED, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
        lastTopLbl := bar_index
    if botIn and showIn and (na(lastBotLbl) or bar_index - lastBotLbl > cool)
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏突入' + sfxBot, style=label.style_label_up, color=C_GRN, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
        lastBotLbl := bar_index
    if topOut and showOut
        label.new(bar_index, U, '高値圏離脱', style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(C_RED, 70), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
    if botOut and showOut
        label.new(bar_index, L, '安値圏離脱', style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(C_GRN, 70), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)

// ---- 状態テーブル ----
var table tb = table.new(tblPosS == '右上' ? position.top_right : tblPosS == '右下' ? position.bottom_right : tblPosS == '左上' ? position.top_left : position.bottom_left, 1, 1)
if showTbl and barstate.islast
    string tsz = tblSizeS == '大' ? size.large : tblSizeS == '中' ? size.normal : size.small
    string st  = zone == 1 ? '高値圏 ' + str.tostring(zBars) + '本目' : zone == -1 ? '安値圏 ' + str.tostring(zBars) + '本目' : na(line) ? '計算中' : line >= 0.75 * U ? '上ライン接近' : line <= 0.75 * L ? '下ライン接近' : '中立'
    string ds  = na(line) ? '' : zone == 1 ? ' / 上ライン超え +' + str.tostring(line - U, '#') : zone == -1 ? ' / 下ライン超え ' + str.tostring(line - L, '#') : line >= 0 ? ' / 上ラインまで ' + str.tostring(U - line, '#') : ' / 下ラインまで ' + str.tostring(line - L, '#')
    string pv  = barstate.isconfirmed ? '' : '（確定前）'
    color tc   = zone == 1 ? C_RED : zone == -1 ? C_GRN : chart.fg_color
    table.cell(tb, 0, 0, '【' + TAG + '】状態: ' + st + ds + pv, text_color=tc, text_size=tsz, bgcolor=color.new(chart.bg_color, 20))

// ---- アラート（確定足のみ）----
alertcondition(topIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '高値圏突入', '{{ticker}} ' + TAG + ' 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(topOut and barstate.isconfirmed, '高値圏離脱', '{{ticker}} ' + TAG + ' 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(botIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '安値圏突入', '{{ticker}} ' + TAG + ' 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(botOut and barstate.isconfirmed, '安値圏離脱', '{{ticker}} ' + TAG + ' 安値圏離脱')
alertcondition((topIn or topOut or botIn or botOut) and barstate.isconfirmed, 'ゾーン変化(いずれか)', '{{ticker}} ' + TAG + ' ゾーン変化')
if barstate.isconfirmed and (topIn or topOut or botIn or botOut)
    string evt = topIn ? '高値圏突入' : topOut ? '高値圏離脱' : botIn ? '安値圏突入' : '安値圏離脱'
    alert(syminfo.ticker + ' ' + TAG + ' ' + evt + ' 値=' + str.tostring(line, '#'), alert.freq_once_per_bar_close)

// UNVERIFIED Pine details (no tradingview.com access; check at first compile):
// (a) TAG = 'literal' is a const string, so const + const concatenation is accepted by alertcondition; if not, inline the literal.
// (b) display.pane exists in v6.
// (c) color.from_gradient clamps values outside its range.
// (d) chart.fg_color and chart.bg_color exist.
// (e) math.ceil returns int (wrapped in int() anyway).
// (f) var arrays/UDT objects are rolled back on realtime ticks like other var variables; this is verified by the realtime reload test.
// (g) fill() accepts a series color with na meaning no fill.
// (h) table.new accepts a position chosen by a ternary on an input string.
final.shared_helpers:
A. EXACT SCALAR HELPERS. Pine definitions are in the skeleton. The Python mirrors below are the reference implementation and must be used for every recursion: do NOT use pandas ewm/rolling for recursive parts.
- f_ema(x,n): a = 2/(n+1); state s = na. Each bar: s = na(s) ? x : a*x + (1-a)*s. An na input after seeding makes s na, and the next valid x re-seeds.
- f_rma(x,n): the same with a = 1/n.
- f_tanh(x) = sign(x)*(1-e)/(1+e), where e = exp(-2|x|). It never overflows and gives na for na.
- f_ss(x,P): Ehlers 2-pole SuperSmoother. a1 = exp(-√2·π/P), c2 = 2·a1·cos(√2·π/P), c3 = -a1², c1 = 1 - c2 - c3. y_0 = x_0, y_1 = x_1, y_t = c1·(x_t + x_{t-1})/2 + c2·y_{t-1} + c3·y_{t-2} (call 0 = bar 0).
- f_pnr(x,n,p): buffer of the last n non-na values, current bar included. When full, sort ascending and take element ceil(p·n/100) (1-based); otherwise na. Replaces ta.percentile_nearest_rank, whose rank convention and na handling are unverified.
- WMA3(x) = (3x_t + 2x_{t-1} + x_{t-2})/6, na-propagating.
- TR = ta.tr(true) = max(H, C_{t-1}) - min(L, C_{t-1}), with H_0 - L_0 on bar 0.
- KC(v; a; ρ, c) = mean_j 1/(1 + exp(-clamp((v - a_j)/(ρ·a_j + c), -50, 50))).

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, math
def ema_p(x, n, alpha=None):
    a = 2.0/(n+1) if alpha is None else alpha; out = np.full(len(x), np.nan); s = np.nan
    for t, v in enumerate(np.asarray(x, float)):
        s = v if math.isnan(s) else a*v + (1-a)*s; out[t] = s
    return out
def rma_p(x, n): return ema_p(x, n, 1.0/n)
def tanh_p(x): x = np.asarray(x, float); e = np.exp(-2*np.abs(x)); return np.sign(x)*(1-e)/(1+e)
def ss_p(x, P):
    a1 = math.exp(-math.sqrt(2)*math.pi/P); c2 = 2*a1*math.cos(math.sqrt(2)*math.pi/P); c3 = -a1*a1; c1 = 1-c2-c3
    y = np.array(x, float).copy()
    for t in range(2, len(y)): y[t] = c1*(x[t]+x[t-1])/2 + c2*y[t-1] + c3*y[t-2]
    return y
def pnr(x, n, p):
    out = np.full(len(x), np.nan); buf = []; k = math.ceil(p*n/100.0) - 1

def zones(line, U, L, hyst=0.0):   # == Pine state machine

Definition:
- x = ln(close).
- trL = ln H - ln L on bar 0; otherwise max(ln H - ln L, |ln H - x_{t-1}|, |ln L - x_{t-1}|).
- atrL = Wilder RMA(trL, 50), seeded with the SMA of the first 50 values (defined from bar 49): atrL += (trL - atrL)/50.
- θ = k·atrL.
- The state runs from the first bar with θ defined.
- dir = 0 (init): track the running max hX/hB with the min since it (hcX/hcB), and the running min lX/lB with the max since it (lcX/lcB); a new max or min resets its counter to that bar. If hX - x >= θ: dir = -1, pivot = (hX, hB), extreme = (hcX, hcB), counter = earliest MAX of x over [eB, t]. Else if x - lX >= θ: dir = +1, pivot = (lX, lB), extreme = (lcX, lcB), counter = earliest MIN over [eB, t].
- dir = d (running): if d·(x - eX) > 0, set extreme = counter = (x, t); else if d·(x - cX) < 0, set counter = (x, t).
- Reversal: if d·(eX - x) >= θ, push dur = eB - pB and amp = |eX - pX| into the direction-d buffers (keep the last K = 8), then pivot := extreme, extreme := counter, counter := earliest max (d = +1) or min (d = -1) of x over [max(eB, t-999), t], dir := -d.
- All comparisons are strict, so the earliest bar wins ties. The line for bar t is computed after the update.

def sd_line(c, h, l, k, mode, nAtr=50, K=8, Kmin=3, tau=4.0):
    x = np.log(c); lh, ll = np.log(h), np.log(l); xp = np.r_[np.nan, x[:-1]]
    trL = np.where(np.isnan(xp), lh-ll, np.maximum.reduce([lh-ll, np.abs(lh-xp), np.abs(ll-xp)]))
    atr = np.full(len(x), np.nan); s = np.nan; acc = 0.0; cnt = 0
    for i, v in enumerate(trL):
        if math.isnan(s):
            acc += v; cnt += 1
            if cnt == nAtr: s = acc/nAtr
        else: s += (v - s)/nAtr
        atr[i] = s
    th = k*atr; n = len(x); raw = np.full(n, np.nan); D = {1: [], -1: []}; A = {1: [], -1: []}
    d = 0; hX = None
    def scan(frm, t, want_max):
        a = max(frm, t-999); seg = x[a:t+1]; j = int(np.argmax(seg) if want_max else np.argmin(seg)); return seg[j], a+j
    for t in range(n):
        v, hh = x[t], th[t]
        if math.isnan(hh): continue
        if d == 0:
            if hX is None: hX = hcX = lX = lcX = v; hB = hcB = lB = lcB = t
            else:
                if v > hX: hX, hB, hcX, hcB = v, t, v, t
                elif v < hcX: hcX, hcB = v, t
                if v < lX: lX, lB, lcX, lcB = v, t, v, t
                elif v > lcX: lcX, lcB = v, t
            if hX - v >= hh: d = -1; pX, pB, eX, eB = hX, hB, hcX, hcB; cX, cB = scan(eB, t, True)
            elif v - lX >= hh: d = 1; pX, pB, eX, eB = lX, lB, lcX, lcB; cX, cB = scan(eB, t, False)
        else:
            if d*(v-eX) > 0: eX, eB, cX, cB = v, t, v, t
            elif d*(v-cX) < 0: cX, cB = v, t
            if d*(eX-v) >= hh:
                D[d].append(float(eB-pB)); A[d].append(abs(eX-pX))
                if len(D[d]) > K: D[d].pop(0); A[d].pop(0)
                pX, pB, eX, eB = eX, eB, cX, cB; cX, cB = scan(eB, t, d == 1); d = -d
        if d != 0:
            if mode == 'age' and len(D[d]) >= Kmin: raw[t] = 100*d*kc(eB-pB, D[d], 0.15, 1.0)*math.exp(-((t-eB)/tau)**2)
            if mode == 'ext' and len(A[d]) >= Kmin:
                u = min(1.0, max(0.0, d*(eX-v)/hh)); raw[t] = 100*d*kc(abs(eX-pX), A[d], 0.15, 0.0)*(1-u)
    return raw

0. ENVIRONMENT. arch, backtesting and scipy are NOT installed in this container (import fails); numpy 2.5, pandas 3.0 and matplotlib 3.11 with the IPAGothic font are available. Implementation step: create a venv and pip install arch backtesting through the proxy. Files:
- research/indicators.py: the Python mirrors, function names identical to the Pine helpers.
- research/validate.py.
- Reuse zigzag() and the evaluate() scaffolding from research/turn_proximity_sample.py, and retire proximity(). It is the ingredient-mixing pattern the user rejected.

1. DATA.
- arch.data.nasdaq.load() and arch.data.sp500.load(): daily OHLCV 1999-2018.
- backtesting.test.GOOG: 2004-2013.
- 3x synthesis with daily reset and no fees: C3_t = C3_{t-1}·(1 + 3(C_t/C_{t-1} - 1)), C3_0 = 100. X3_t = C3_{t-1}·(1 + 3(X_t/C_{t-1} - 1)) for X ∈ {O, H, L}. Assert L3 <= min(O3, C3) and H3 >= max(O3, C3), and that all prices are > 0.
- Datasets: NQ3x, SP3x, GOOG3x, plus GOOG1x (leverage-invariance check).
- SP 1999-2006 High/Low are contaminated (fake open = previous close). For the H/L-using indicators (E4, E5, E6, E8, E9, E10), SP3x is scored on 2007-2018 only.
- E4 volume input = underlying index Volume × index Close. Never use index volume × the 3x close. Zero-volume days stay 0.
- Indicators are computed causally on full history; only bars >= 300 are scored.

2. GROUND TRUTH. Hindsight close ZigZag on the 3x close with 15% reversal (primary) and 25% (major subset); 10% for GOOG1x. Drop pivots before bar 300. The prototype's zigzag starts with trend = +1, so its first pivot is discarded.

3. PER-INDICATOR METRICS (each dataset; top and bottom separately):
a) Zone share: % of bars with state +1 and -1. Target total 10-25%, each side >= 3%.
b) Hit rate:
- Leading hit = the matching zone is active on any bar in [p-5, p] (in the zone at the extreme, or left it <= 5 bars before).
- Confirm hit = active in [p+1, p+3].
- Combined = [p-5, p+3].
Chance baseline: circularly shift the state series by 200 random offsets (>= 50 bars) inside the scored span. Lift = hit / mean shifted hit.
c) Lead/lag of 突入 vs the extreme: for hit pivots, p - (entry bar of the episode containing or preceding p). Report median and IQR.
d) Distance from the extreme at 突入: |ln(C_entry/C_p)|·100 in %, and divided by ATR14% at entry. Report the median.
e) False-entry rate: share of entries with no same-side 15% pivot in [s-2, e+5], where s/e are the episode start and end. Also the wrong-side rate: an opposite pivot within 5 bars after the entry.
f) 離脱 lag and giveback: exit bar - p (median); giveback = |C_p - C_exit|/C_p in % and in ATR.
g) Oscillator-peak vs price-peak alignment: the offset of the line's extreme within ±10 bars of p. Report the median and the % of pivots within ±2.
h) Smoothness: direction changes per 100 bars (sign changes of Δline), mean|Δline|, % of bars with |line| >= 95, longest zone run.
i) Entries per side per year.

4. PASS CRITERIA. An indicator passes if the criteria hold on >= 2 of NQ3x / SP3x / GOOG3x:
- Total zone 10-25% and each side >= 3%.
- Leading types (E1, E2, E4, E5, E6, E7, E8, E10): leading-hit lift >= 1.2 on the stronger side and >= 1.0 on the weaker side.
- Confirmation types (E3, E9): combined-window lift >= 1.3 on both sides.
- Median |peak offset| <= 2 bars.
- Wrong-side rate <= 20%.
- Longest zone run <= 25 bars.
- Saturation (|line| >= 95) <= 12% of bars.
- Direction changes <= 45 per 100 bars (<= 50 for the E8 staircase and E9 pulses).
- Entries 2-15 per side per year.
- Pine/Python parity OK (section 8).
Realistic expectation, stated to the user: a single pane catches 30-60% of 15% swings. Coverage is also reported: the % of pivots hit by >= 1 and by >= 3 of the 10 panes. Target >= 85% for >= 1; informational only.

5. DISTINCTNESS (the user's 似通ってはいけない rule). Computed over all 45 pairs, on each dataset (scored bars where both lines are non-na):
- Pearson level corr r_L.
- Pearson corr of daily changes r_Δ.
- Same-side zone Jaccard J = |A∩B|/|A∪B|, the mean of the top and bottom sets.
- Entry-event overlap O = share of A's entries with a same-side entry of B within ±2 bars, symmetrised as the mean of A→B and B→A.
- Sign agreement, for E5-E6.
HARD limits: |r_L| <= 0.80, |r_Δ| <= 0.80, J <= 0.30, O <= 0.40. A pair FAILS if any hard limit is exceeded on >= 2 datasets.
SOFT limits: |r_L| <= 0.70, J <= 0.20. Exceeding one triggers its lever.
Red-team expectations: max J 0.28 (E1-E2). Watch E1-E2 (0.67/0.80), E2-E6 (0.76/0.73), E1-E6 (0.73/0.76), E5-E6 (0.78, sign agreement 0.83) and E2-E8 (0.76/0.64). E3, E4, E7, E9 and E10 should be <= 0.5 in r_Δ.
Known infeasible runner-ups (do not swap in): E1-bollinger-z with E2-tsi (0.86/0.83, J 0.44); E10-signed-semivol with E2 (0.85-0.87). Borderline: E8-td-setup with E2 (0.80-0.82).
Levers:
- E1: n 75→100.
- E5: k 3→3.5.
- E6: +70/-55 or the 0.6θ hand-off.
- E3: ±45→±40.
- E4: len 10→14.
- E7: P 20→18.
- E8: N 5→6.
- E9: sm 3→4.
- E10: base 30→40.
- E2 is the anchor and is changed last.
RUNNER-UP SWAP RULE:
(1) For a failing or soft pair, apply the lever of the lower-ranked member. Keep it only if that member still passes section 4 and its mean lift drops by <= 15%.
(2) If the pair still fails, swap the lower-ranked member to its runner-up. The runner-up must pass section 4 and create no new hard failure against the other 9.
(3) Otherwise try the higher-ranked member's runner-up under the same conditions.
(4) Otherwise keep the pair and report it to the user as 似ている組.
(5) An indicator that fails section 4 on its own is swapped to its runner-up if the runner-up passes and is distinct.
After every change, recompute the full matrix. Maximum 3 rounds. The final set must have 0 hard failures and <= 3 soft warnings.

6. RANKING. Score = 0.5·mean(top, bottom lift) for the primary window type + 0.2·(1 - false-entry rate) + 0.15·(% |peak offset| <= 2) + 0.15·(1 - min(dirchanges/60, 1)). Average over the 3 primary datasets. Tie-break: lower max |r_L| with the other 9. Confirmation types are flagged as 確認型 in the report.

7. CALIBRATION vs CHECK.
- Calibration: 1999-2010. NQ3x; SP3x (2007-2010 only for the H/L-using indicators); GOOG3x 2004-2010.
- Only the tanh scale k and the threshold values may be re-tuned: small grid, thresholds ±10 points, k ±20%. Structural lengths stay frozen unless an indicator fails.
- Check: 2011-2018 (NQ3x, SP3x) and GOOG 2011-2013, with parameters frozen and indicators computed causally on full history.
- Pass in the check period: zone share 8-30%, lift >= 80% of the calibration value, no new hard distinctness failure.
- GOOG1x vs GOOG3x: zone-share difference <= 5 points for the scale-free lines.
- Caveat: the designers' defaults were tuned on 1999-2018, so the check is not fully out-of-sample for their reported numbers.

8. PINE/PYTHON PARITY.
- The Python mirrors are line-by-line copies of the Pine helpers (loops, same seeds, same na rules). Never use pandas ewm/rolling for recursive parts.
- Unit tests:
  - EMA/RMA of a constant equals the constant;
  - SS passes a constant through;
  - f_pnr ranks on known arrays;
  - SD on a hand-made zigzag series;
  - E4 with constant volume gives 0;
  - E7 on a pure ramp gives +15.6.
- Chart parity: the user exports TQQQ daily chart data with all 10 indicators applied ('チャートデータのエクスポート' includes the plot values; it may require a paid plan, unverified). Python recomputes on the same exported OHLCV with the same first bar and dividend-adjustment setting.
- Tolerance:
  - E1, E2, E7, E8: |Δline| <= 1e-6 on all bars.
  - Recursive indicators: the same tolerance from bar 300 on.
  - Event lists must be identical.
  - E5/E6: >= 99.5% agreement on dir, with mismatches allowed only at >= θ ties within 1e-12.
- Realtime rollback test: run each script on a 1-minute chart of a liquid ETF for 30+ bars, record the values and labels, then reload. Every closed-bar value and label must be unchanged. This proves the var/array/UDT rollback and no-repaint claims.

8. 評価の基準: 『当てたい天井・底』は3倍ETFで15%以上のスイングでよいですか？それとも25%以上の大きな転換だけを重視しますか？検証のヒット判定と順位付けがこれで変わります。
9. 検証後の照合: TradingViewの『チャートデータのエクスポート』（有料プラン限定の可能性あり）で、TQQQ日足と10指標の値をCSVで出していただけますか？PythonとPineの計算が一致しているかを最終確認できます。

reviews.issues_found: (1) The trend cap only holds for log prices. On raw close a steady exponential 3x uptrend of +1%/+2% a day gives z=1.70/1.75, i.e. osc +60.9/+62.2, so it sits inside the zone. Steady downtrends give −58/−57 and never reach the zone. That is an up/down asymmetry. (2) With log close a steady trend reads exactly ±59.6, hugging the ±60 line, so it flickers (about 6.4 top entries/yr). (3) It is E2 in disguise. My replication on NQ3x/SP3x/GOOG3x: corr with E2-tsi 0.86 level / 0.83 daily change, same-side zone Jaccard 0.44; corr 0.91 with RSI14 and 0.84 with E5/E6. On a TQQQ chart it would look like E2. Math, the bound |z|≤√19 and the Pine API are otherwise fine.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: y=ln(close); basis=SMA(y,20); sd=population stdev(y,20); z=sd>0?(y−basis)/sd:0 (na bars 0..18); zs=EMA3(z) seeded with the first valid z (custom f_ema).
reviews.corrected_normalization: osc=100·tanh(zs/2.6). A steady trend reads ±55.9 (clear of the lines); ±60 ⇔ |zs|=1.80. |osc|<96.
reviews.corrected_thresholds: Fixed ±60 with k=2.6 gives zone 11/10/16% (NQ3x/SP3x/GOOG3x). Optional exit hysteresis: leave the zone only below ±50.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E1b σ乖離(log)', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500)
len=input.int(20,'期間'), k=input.float(2.6,'k'), T=input.float(60,'ライン')
f_ema(float x, simple int n)=>
    var float s=na
    s:=na(s)?x:2.0/(n+1)*x+(1-2.0/(n+1))*s
    s
f_tanh(float x)=>
    e=math.exp(-2*math.abs(x))
    math.sign(x)*(1-e)/(1+e)
float y=math.log(close)
float sd=ta.stdev(y,len)
float z=na(sd)?na:sd>0?(y-ta.sma(y,len))/sd:0.0
float osc=100*f_tanh(f_ema(z,3)/k)
// plot, hline ±T/0, crossings and labels/alerts on barstate.isconfirmed exactly as in E1-regression-channel-z
reviews.corrected_default_params: len 20, EMA3, k=2.6, lines ±60, log close. Runner-up only; it is too close to E2 to sit in the same set.
reviews.corrected_signals: Unchanged four crossings of ±60 via ta.crossover/ta.crossunder, labelled/alerted only on barstate.isconfirmed.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint. Windowed SMA/stdev plus a 3-bar EMA on current/past closes; signals final at bar close, 0-bar delay.
reviews.pine_api_uncertainties: ta.stdev default biased=true (population) believed correct. No math.tanh assumed. Comma-separated input declarations on one line are allowed, but split them if the compiler objects.

reviews.issues_found: Math and Pine are correct: the KAMA seed, math.sum warm-up and f_rma match the pandas version. But ATR-normalised kairi is RSI: corr 0.87 with RSI14, 0.86 with E2-tsi, 0.92 with E1-bollinger. It has the highest wrong-side rate at tops (11–23%) and the first ~100 bars are seed-dependent. It adds nothing distinct.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged (dropped, not to be built). Core: kama:=(na(sc) or na(kama))?close:kama+sc*(close-kama); osc=100*f_tanh(f_ema((close-kama)/f_rma(ta.tr(true),14),3)/2.3).
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint: causal recursions, labels at bar close.

reviews.issues_found: PICK for E1. It is the most distinct E1: corr with E2-tsi 0.67, Jaccard 0.25–0.33 (bollinger-z: 0.86/0.44); with E8-hhhl 0.40, E7 0.39, E3 0.42, E6 0.73. Measured zone share 9/11%, 8/11%, 13/11%; lift (zone in [p−5,p] vs chance) tops 1.35/1.67/1.09, bottoms 2.47/2.93/2.34; peak lag 0. Weaknesses: tops are weak and zone runs reach 19–27 bars after regime changes. Pine fragility: sres via ta.correlation(y, bar_index) gives na/NaN on a flat window while the Python gives 0. Replace it with the exact identity σ_res²=var(y)−b²·var(x), where b is obtained from two linreg calls. n=50 raises top lift to 1.82/1.83/1.44 but raises E2 overlap (corr 0.73, Jaccard 0.32–0.37). Keep 75 for distinctness.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: y=ln(close); n=75; fit=linreg(y,n,0); b=linreg(y,n,0)−linreg(y,n,1) (slope); vy=population var(y,n); sres=sqrt(max(vy−b²·(n²−1)/12,0)); zc=sres>0?(y−fit)/sres:0 (na until bar 74); zs=EMA3(zc), seeded with the first valid value.
reviews.corrected_thresholds: Fixed ±60 (red/green): 20/19/24% of bars. Optional cooldown: no repeat same-side entry label within 5 bars.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E1 回帰トレンド乖離', shorttitle='E1乖離', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500)
n=input.int(75,'回帰期間',minval=40)
kU=input.float(2.3,'上側k')
kD=input.float(2.6,'下側k')
T=input.float(60,'ライン')
f_ema(float x, simple int len)=>
    var float s=na
    float a=2.0/(len+1)
    s:=na(s)?x:a*x+(1-a)*s
    s
f_tanh(float x)=>
    float e=math.exp(-2*math.abs(x))
    math.sign(x)*(1-e)/(1+e)
float y=math.log(close)
float fit=ta.linreg(y,n,0)
float b=fit-ta.linreg(y,n,1)
float vy=ta.variance(y,n)
float sres=na(vy) or na(b)?na:math.sqrt(math.max(vy-b*b*(n*n-1)/12.0,0.0))
float zc=na(sres)?na:sres>0?(y-fit)/sres:0.0
float zs=f_ema(zc,3)
float osc=zs>=0?100*f_tanh(zs/kU):100*f_tanh(zs/kD)
bool tI=ta.crossover(osc,T)
bool tO=ta.crossunder(osc,T)
bool bI=ta.crossunder(osc,-T)
bool bO=ta.crossover(osc,-T)
plot(osc,'乖離',osc>T?color.red:osc<-T?color.green:color.gray,2)
hline(T,'高値圏ライン',color.red)
hline(-T,'安値圏ライン',color.green)
hline(0,'0',color.new(color.gray,60),hline.style_dotted)
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if tI
        label.new(bar_index,osc,'高値圏突入',style=label.style_label_down,color=color.red,textcolor=color.white,size=size.small)
    if bI
        label.new(bar_index,osc,'安値圏突入',style=label.style_label_up,color=color.green,textcolor=color.white,size=size.small)
    if tO
        label.new(bar_index,osc,'高値圏離脱',style=label.style_label_down,color=color.new(color.red,60),textcolor=color.white,size=size.tiny)
    if bO
        label.new(bar_index,osc,'安値圏離脱',style=label.style_label_up,color=color.new(color.green,60),textcolor=color.white,size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(tI and barstate.isconfirmed,'高値圏突入','E1 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(bI and barstate.isconfirmed,'安値圏突入','E1 安値圏突入')
reviews.corrected_default_params: n=75 (≈75日線乖離), log price, EMA3, kUp 2.3 / kDn 2.6, lines ±60. Option n=50 for better tops at a cost in distinctness.
reviews.corrected_signals: 高値圏突入=crossover(osc,+60); 高値圏離脱=crossunder(osc,+60); 安値圏突入=crossunder(osc,−60); 安値圏離脱=crossover(osc,−60). All on barstate.isconfirmed.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint. Only the current regression endpoint is used (no refit drawn into the past); 0-bar delay.
reviews.pine_api_uncertainties: ta.linreg(src,len,offset)=intercept+slope·(len−1−offset), so the slope is the difference of offsets 0 and 1 (believed correct). ta.variance default biased=true. hline(-T) with an input-qualified negation (believed OK; else use plot(-T)).

reviews.issues_found: PICK for E10. Math verified: continuous at VR=0, bounded, TR% exactly leverage-invariant on synthesized 3x, saturation small (|osc|≥95 on ~1% of bars). Measured lift: bottoms 2.73/3.38/2.20, but tops only 1.08/1.27/1.44 (NQ near chance), so the top side is a weak complacency warning, not a pinpoint. Semantic quirk: compression maps to the top zone regardless of price location; 5–10% of top-zone bars on indices (27% on GOOG) have close<SMA50, e.g. quiet bases at lows labelled 高値圏. The 5-bar gate uses return sign (directional), but only as a sign for expansions. Zone runs reach 16–24 bars in calm uptrends. Distinct: corr ≤0.62 with every pick; daily-change corr 0.46–0.49 with E1/E2/E6.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: Unchanged: trp=TR/close[1]; VR=ln(RMA3(trp)/RMA30(trp)); gate=tanh(4(dn2−up2)/(up2+dn2)) with EMA5 semivariances; w=gate>0?gate:0.5·gate; x=VR>0?−VR·w:−VR; xs=EMA3(x).
reviews.corrected_thresholds: Unchanged ±60 (zone 18/20/17%). Label text: '高値圏突入(値動き縮小=慢心)' so users do not read it as a price top.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged from candidate (compiles as written; all ta.cross* evaluated globally, labels and alerts gated by barstate.isconfirmed).
reviews.corrected_default_params: Unchanged: fast RMA3, base RMA30, gate EMA5, sharpness 4, blow-off weight 0.5, EMA3, kUp 0.45 / kDn 0.26.
reviews.corrected_signals: Unchanged four crossings of ±60 at bar close. 安値圏突入 = panic in progress; 安値圏離脱 = fear receding; 高値圏 = complacency (early warning).
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint: H/L/C of current and past bars only, custom var recursions rolled back intrabar, 0-bar delay. Seed influence about 150 bars.
reviews.pine_api_uncertainties: ta.tr(true) handles na close[1]. No math.tanh.

reviews.issues_found: RUNNER-UP only. It is a momentum look-alike: corr 0.85–0.87 with E2-tsi, 0.84 with E1-bollinger, Jaccard 0.40 with E1. After V-bottoms the line flips into the top zone within 10 bars after 17–25% of 15% lows. Fix tested: damp the positive semivariance term by min(1,B/V), which is a pure vol-state gate. Flips fell to 10–13% with bottom lift unchanged (2.84/3.14/2.63), but the E2 correlation remains, so do not combine it with E2 in the same set. Math is otherwise fine; seeds of 0 decay as (62/64)^k, so warm-up is about 250 bars.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: r=ln(C/C[1]); U=EMA7(r>0?r²:0); D=EMA7(r<0?r²:0); B=EMA63(r²); V=U+D; S=B>0?(U−D)/B:0; S⁺ damped: S=S>0?S·min(1,B/V):S; comp=max(0,ln(B/V)); xs=EMA3(S+0.3·comp).
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Candidate sketch plus one line after S: S := S > 0 and V > 0 ? S * math.min(1.0, B / V) : S
reviews.corrected_default_params: Unchanged: EMA7, EMA63, λ=0.3, kUp 0.95 / kDn 1.08.
reviews.corrected_signals: Unchanged crossings of ±60 at bar close.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint: causal close-only recursions, 0-bar delay.

reviews.issues_found: WVF is the drawdown from the 22-bar highest close and the inverse is the run-up from the lowest close. Both are price-distance (E6/E1) quantities: corr 0.85 with E1-bollinger, 0.81 with E7-harmonic, 0.73 with E6. Bottom lift is only about 2 and self-normalisation raises the trigger in long bears. Pine is fine; math.min(na,…) propagating na is fine.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged (dropped).
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint: windowed highest/lowest on past bars.

reviews.issues_found: PICK for E2. |N|≤D holds exactly (same positive weights and seeds 0/0), so it is bounded with no clamp needed. Measured lift: tops 1.68/1.57/1.62, bottoms 2.41/2.31/2.56; lag 0; zone 21% everywhere; runs ≤15; ~9 entries/side/yr. Adaptive lines did not cause any threshold-driven crossings (0% of entries had the line moving away). Main problem is external, not in E2: E8-close-run duplicates it (0.88/0.84, Jaccard 0.40) and E1-bollinger duplicates it (0.86/0.83, Jaccard 0.44). The fix is to change E1 and E8, not E2.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: Unchanged: pc=nz(ta.change(close)); mom=100·EMA3(EMA6(pc))/EMA3(EMA6(|pc|)), EMA seeded with the bar-0 value.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged from candidate.
reviews.corrected_signals: Unchanged four crossings against the plotted adaptive lines, barstate.isconfirmed gated.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint: causal EMAs and a trailing percentile window; 0-bar delay.
reviews.pine_api_uncertainties: ta.percentile_nearest_rank: whether it returns na for the first length−1 bars and its rank convention (ceil(p·n/100)) are unverified; na fallback handled.

reviews.issues_found: Correct identity (2·RSI7−100) and Pine. But it is a jumpier duplicate of E2-tsi: corr 0.97, about 50 direction changes per 100 bars vs 39. Fixed ±45 pins in bull years (21–29% top zone), and it has corr 0.90 with E1-bollinger.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged (dropped).
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint.
reviews.pine_api_uncertainties: Built-in ta.rsi uses an SMA seed; the custom f_rma is correct.

reviews.issues_found: RUNNER-UP. Smoothest E2 (about 31 direction changes per 100 bars) and slightly less kairi-like than TSI (0.85 vs 0.86 with E1-bollinger); corr 0.94 with E2-tsi. Lift similar to TSI. The Pine sketch is incomplete (labels/alerts omitted). Validation caveat: SP500 1999–2006 High/Low include the fake open (Open=prev close 84–96% of days; H<prev close on only 0.3% of days vs 16–19% after 2007), so ±DM is distorted there. Validate on NQ, GOOG and SP 2007+ only. Bottom zone is sticky in crashes.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: Unchanged: +DM/−DM by Wilder rule; A=EMA3(EMA6(+DM)), B=EMA3(EMA6(−DM)); bal=100(A−B)/(A+B).
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Candidate core plus the full E2-tsi plot/label/alert block: cuT=ta.crossover(bal,upper), cdT=ta.crossunder(bal,upper), cdB=ta.crossunder(bal,lower), cuB=ta.crossover(bal,lower); label.new(...) inside 'if barstate.isconfirmed'; 4 alertconditions.
reviews.corrected_signals: Four crossings of ±65 at bar close.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint: H/L of current/prior bar only, gated at close.

reviews.issues_found: PICK for E3. Bounded |raw|≤1 (equality only when v=0 exactly). Leg state is causal and var-rolled-back. Distinct: daily-change corr only 0.18 with E2 (level 0.64), Jaccard ≤0.19 with every pick. Lift: tops 1.10/1.52/1.20 (NQ blow-off tops at chance), bottoms 2.22/3.04/1.74; peak lag 0 to −1; smooth (about 31 direction changes per 100 bars); never pins (runs ≤14). Bottom zone is used sparingly (4%), because crash legs end in V shapes. σ=RMA100(|v|) needs about 300 bars to settle.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: Unchanged: v=SuperSmoother4(ln C/C[1]); leg=sign(v); pk=max|v| in leg; raw=side·(pk−|v|)/max(pk,σ), σ=RMA100(|v|); stall=EMA3(100·raw).
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged from candidate (if hline(-T) is rejected, use plot(-T,'安値圏ライン')).
reviews.corrected_default_params: Unchanged: SS period 4, σ 100, floor 1.0σ, EMA3, ±45.
reviews.corrected_signals: Unchanged four crossings at bar close. Note: 高値圏離脱 means either the leg flipped (fall toward 0, then negative) or the move re-accelerated.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint: causal filters, var leg state committed at close; 0-bar delay.
reviews.pine_api_uncertainties: hline with a negated input. Local-series history (y[1], y[2]) inside f_ss is per call site (believed correct).

reviews.issues_found: A faster E2, not acceleration in user terms: daily-change corr 0.90 with E2-tsi (level 0.77). It flips into the opposite zone within 4 bars after 26–45% of extremes. Math and Pine are fine.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged (dropped).
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint.

reviews.issues_found: RUNNER-UP. The most orthogonal line of all 30: daily-change corr ≈0 or negative with every pick, Jaccard ≤0.16. Confirmation-type: lift before the extreme is at chance, but zone in [p+1,p+3] for 0.44–0.53 of tops and 0.76–0.77 of bottoms. Spiky (zero on about 60% of bars) with 24–28 entries/yr at ±50. Use ±60 to cut labels.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: Unchanged: s=SS10(ln C); v=Δs; a=Δv; dec=v·a<0 ? −a·min(1,|v|/(0.3σ)) : 0; line=EMA2(100·tanh(dec/RMS100/1.5)).
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Candidate sketch with f_ema/f_rma/f_ss/f_tanh pasted in full and T default 60.
reviews.corrected_signals: Four crossings at bar close; read as 天井/底の確認.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint; inherent 1–2 bar concept lag.

reviews.issues_found: PICK for E4. Purity confirmed: constant volume gives exactly 0, and shuffled volume drops lift from T 1.58/1.10/1.26, B 1.56/2.14/1.93 to about 0.8–1.4 while doubling entries. Lowest correlation with every pick (≤0.31). Weak and context-like: runs 16–22 bars in volume-backed rallies. Fixes: (1) alertconditions lack barstate.isconfirmed; (2) built-in ta.ema seeding is uncertain, so use custom f_ema for exact replication; (3) warm-up is about 265 bars (RMS252), document it; (4) ta.percentile_nearest_rank on line[1] with na in the window is unverified; (5) TQQQ's own volume dynamics (leveraged-ETF hedging flows) differ from index dollar volume, so re-check on real ETF volume.
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: v=nz(volume)·close; tp=hlc3; vwp=EMA10(v·tp)/EMA10(v) (na if EMA10(v)≤0); ewp=EMA10(tp); raw=(vwp−ewp)/RMA14(TR); custom EMAs seeded with the first value.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Candidate sketch with: evh=f_ema(v*hlc3,10), ev=f_ema(v,10), ewp=f_ema(hlc3,10), atr=f_rma(ta.tr(true),14); alertcondition(topIn and barstate.isconfirmed, ...) for all four alerts.
reviews.corrected_default_params: Unchanged: len 10, ATR14, RMS252, k 1.5, dollar volume, ±60, cooldown 3.
reviews.corrected_signals: Unchanged four crossings, labels/alerts at bar close only.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint (except vendor volume revisions after the close); 0-bar delay.
reviews.pine_api_uncertainties: ta.ema seeding (SMA vs first value); percentile na handling; split-adjustment of ETF volume on TradingView.

reviews.issues_found: RUNNER-UP. Pure: 0 under constant volume, and shuffling destroys the top lift (1.59→1.08, 1.66→0.48). Weak (bottom lift 0.94–1.33) and jumpy (about 52 direction changes per 100 bars). Same alert-gating fix as VCOG.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Candidate sketch with alertconditions ANDed with barstate.isconfirmed.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint.

reviews.issues_found: By the designer's own test its information comes from the daily sign (price), not volume: corr 0.48 with E2, 0.50 with E8-close-run. Realtime partial volume makes z swing hugely. Correctly rejected.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged (dropped).
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint on closed bars.

reviews.issues_found: Pure time, but it pins: the longest zone run is 63–94 bars at k=2 and 83–208 at k=3, the clock sits near 100 until confirmation, and |line|≥95 on 9–13% of bars. Peak lag +3/+4. Lift at or below chance on tops (0.8–1.1), sign agreement with E6 0.96.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Unchanged (dropped).
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint (causal detector).

reviews.issues_found: PICK for E5, with one change. At k=2 it shares the detector's leg sign with E6, making them visual twins: sign agreement 0.97, corr 0.87, Jaccard 0.44–0.46. Run the E5 detector on MAJOR swings (k=3.0; about 9 legs/yr, median duration 19–22 bars) while E6 keeps k=2. Then corr with E6 is 0.74–0.81, Jaccard 0.23–0.28, sign agreement 0.82–0.85, and lift is equal or better: tops 1.28/1.78/1.21, bottoms 3.41/3.70/3.09, zone 15/15/17%, runs ≤20. τ=6 tested worse; keep τ=4. Purity caveat: the peak timing comes from price new-extreme events. Pine risks: comma-separated multi-assignments (split them), descending for-loop, dynamic x[i] needing max_bars_back=1000. UDT/array fields are rolled back intrabar (not varip), so this is safe. History-start dependence lasts about 8 legs (about 11 months at k=3).
reviews.corrected_raw_formula: Shared detector SD exactly as specified but k=3.0 (θ=3·RMA50(logTR), SMA-seeded). raw=100·dir·KC(eB−pB; last ≤8 same-direction durations; ρ=0.15, c=1)·exp(−((t−eB)/4)²); na if dir=0 or <3 durations.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Candidate sketch with k default 3.0. Split every 'a := x, b := y' line into separate statements. Keep max_bars_back=1000.
reviews.corrected_default_params: k=3.0 (E5 only), nAtr 50, K 8, Kmin 3, τ 4, smLen 1, ±70.
reviews.corrected_signals: Unchanged at bar close. 高値圏突入 = the major up-swing is older than about 70% of recent major up-swings and still making highs.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint: causal threshold-confirmed detector; past pivots only as bookkeeping; peak on the last new-extreme bar.
reviews.pine_api_uncertainties: Comma statements; 'for i = n-1 to 0' counting down; bool[1] false on bar 0 in v6; method on var UDT.

reviews.issues_found: RUNNER-UP. Saturates: |line|≥95 on 10–12% of bars after short previous legs. Single-leg yardstick is noise (consecutive durations uncorrelated). Same E6-twin problem, so use k=3.0 as for the pick.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Candidate sketch with k=3.0 and split comma statements.
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint.

reviews.issues_found: RUNNER-UP. It pins for 62–77 bars and jumps 70–80 points at confirmation. Fix the jump by multiplying with E6-extension's hand-off (1−u). Pinning remains, so it is a fallback only; corr 0.95 with E6-extension.
reviews.corrected_pine_v6_sketch: Candidate line plus: float u = math.max(0.0, math.min(1.0, sw.dir * (sw.eX - x) / th)); raw := raw * (1.0 - u)
reviews.repaint_verdict: No repaint.

reviews.issues_found: PICK for E6 (k=2). Lift: tops 1.30/1.33/1.39, bottoms 3.91/4.93/3.40; lag 0. Fixes: (1) the zone is top-heavy (17–18% top vs 5–6% bottom) with top runs of 33–40 bars in persistent legs. Asymmetric lines +65/−55 give 14/7, 14/6, 15/6% and raise top lift to 1.46/1.44 (NQ/SP). An optional hand-off at 0.6θ shortens top runs to 22–32. (2) Distinct from E5 only if E5 uses k=3 (see E5). (3) It still co-moves with E2 (level 0.76, daily change 0.73, Jaccard 0.25); that is acceptable.
