red_team.overlap_analysis:
Measured on 3x NQ, SP and GOOG (bars ≥300) with level corr, daily-change corr and same-side zone Jaccard.

(1) The designers' own 10 picks contain 4 near-duplicate pairs:
- E2-tsi vs E8-close-run: 0.88/0.84, J 0.40. Never measured by the designers.
- E1-bollinger vs E2-tsi: 0.86/0.83, J 0.44.
- E5-maturity vs E6-extension: 0.87, sign agreement 0.97, J 0.44. They share the swing detector's leg sign.
- E1-bollinger vs E5/E6: 0.84.

(2) Concrete de-correlating changes:
- E1: use the 75-bar log regression-channel z instead of Bollinger-20. Corr with E2 drops to 0.67, J 0.28.
- E8: use the higher-high/higher-low staircase instead of closing runs. Corr with E2 0.76/0.64, J 0.25; a dead zone on close-runs does not help.
- E5: run its detector at k=3 (major swings) while E6 stays at k=2. Corr 0.78, J 0.24, sign agreement 0.83, with no loss of lift.
- E6: use +65/−55 lines to balance its zones.

(3) Resulting set {E1-reg75, E2-tsi, E3-speed, E4-VCOG, E5-k3, E6-k2, E7-phase, E8-hhhl, E9-rev, E10-vol}:
- Max same-side zone Jaccard is 0.28 (E1–E2). Most pairs are ≤0.20.
- Remaining look-alikes (all share the price-direction sign, which is unavoidable on daily data):
  - E5–E6: level 0.78
  - E2–E6: 0.76/0.73
  - E2–E8: 0.76/0.64
  - E1–E6: 0.73/0.76
  - E1–E2: 0.67 level / 0.80 daily change
- E3, E4, E7, E9 and E10 are genuinely different: daily-change corr ≤0.5 with everything.

(4) Shapes differ by design and should be kept:
- E1: slow smooth line
- E2: fast smooth line
- E3: ramp that resets at leg flips
- E5: fades by time
- E6: tracks price and drops to 0 at confirmation
- E7: sine
- E8: staircase
- E9: pulses
- E10: spikes at panics

(5) If any pair still looks too similar on the TQQQ chart, the next levers are:
- E1 window 75→100.
- E5 k 3→3.5 (corr with E6 0.71–0.78).
- Validate the candle and H/L lines (E8, E9, E2-dmi) only on NQ, GOOG and SP 2007+, because SP 1999–2006 High/Low are contaminated by the fake open.

elements.element_ja: 乖離（平均からの行き過ぎ）
elements.recommendation_reason: E1-bollinger-z を推奨。In-memory validation used NASDAQ and S&P 500 1999-2018 plus GOOG 2004-2013, all synthesized to 3x, with the first 300 bars excluded and a 15% close zigzag as truth. With the same share of bars outside the lines (16-22%), it has the best top-side recall of the three kairi variants: 33-41% of 15% swing highs and 39-58% of 25%+ highs fall in the zone or within 5 bars after it. Bottom recall is solid at 50-64% and 58-76%. Its peaks line up with price highs (median offset 0 bars at tops). It never pins: the longest zone run is 10-14 bars, because sigma contains the trend's own dispersion and a steady 20-bar trend caps at z=1.65. The formula is SMA + population stdev + EMA3 only, so Pine and pandas match exactly. It is scale-free, so one set of defaults covers TQQQ/SOXL/SPXL and 1x, and users already know it as a Bollinger sigma line. E1-kama-kairi has the best bottom recall (25% lows up to 88%), but 11-23% of tops show a wrong-side reading and it is the most RSI-like (0.87 level / 0.84 daily-change correlation). E1-regression-channel-z is the least RSI-like (0.72) and the smoothest, but it catches only 20-24% of tops and pins for up to 27 bars. Caveat for the orchestrator: E1-bollinger-z still correlates 0.91 with RSI14 on 3x data. E2 should therefore be a faster, saturating type such as Laguerre RSI, not a plain RSI14. If E1 and E2 still look too alike, swap in E1-regression-channel-z.

candidates.name_ja: σ乖離ライン（ボリンジャー乖離）
candidates.concept: 終値が20本単純平均から何σ離れているか（σ＝同じ20本の終値の母標準偏差）を3本EMAでならし、tanhで±100に写した線。価格が平均から伸び切るほど線がじわじわ±60に近づき（そろそろ）、伸びが止まると価格より先に折り返す。σにはトレンド自体の広がりも入るため、一本調子の直線トレンドでは z が理論上 √3·√(19/21)=1.65σ で頭打ちとなり、トレンド中ずっと高値圏に張り付かない。±60超え＝平均からの行き過ぎが統計的に異常で、平均への引き戻し（反転）が近い。
candidates.element_purity: Inputs are only close, its 20-bar SMA and its 20-bar population stdev. 'Distance from the mean divided by dispersion around the mean' is 乖離 by definition: the sigma-normalised version of the classic 25日乖離率. It uses none of the other elements: no up-vs-down balance (E2), no change of momentum (E3), no volume (E4), no bars-since-swing or swing anchor (E5/E6), no cycle (E7), no run counts (E8), no wick or close-location geometry (E9), no vol expansion/compression (E10). Honest caveat: on 3x daily data every smoothed-return oscillator co-moves, and the measured correlation with RSI14 is 0.91 (level) / 0.80 (daily changes). It differs from RSI in two ways. (1) Trend dispersion sits in the denominator, so a steady trend is capped near 1.65 sigma, while RSI can sit above 70 for weeks. (2) It is a distance, so bigger swings print deeper values instead of saturating. ATR-normalised kairi was rejected because it is statistically the same line as RSI (corr 0.98 on all three datasets).
candidates.raw_formula:
All terms use confirmed values of bar t and the 19 bars before it.
basis_t = SMA(close,20) = (1/20)*sum_{i=0..19} close_{t-i}
sd_t = sqrt((1/20)*sum_{i=0..19}(close_{t-i} - basis_t)^2). This is the population stdev, i.e. ta.stdev(close,20) with its default biased=true.
z_t = (close_t - basis_t)/sd_t. Set z_t = 0 if sd_t = 0. z_t = na while sd_t is na (bars 0..18).
zs_t = EMA3(z) = 0.5*z_t + 0.5*zs_{t-1}, seeded with the first non-na z (bar 19). Use the custom f_ema, not the built-in ta.ema.
candidates.normalization:
osc_t = 100*tanh(zs_t/2.4), with tanh implemented as sign(x)*(1-exp(-2|x|))/(1+exp(-2|x|)).
±60 corresponds to zs = ±2.4*atanh(0.6) = ±1.664 sigma, and ±80 to ±2.64 sigma.
|osc| < 100 always. 0 means price is on its 20-bar mean.
candidates.thresholds:
Fixed lines: 高値圏ライン = +60 (red solid), 安値圏ライン = -60 (green solid), 0 = grey dotted. This equals a ±1.66 sigma, 20-bar Bollinger band on the smoothed z.
Measured share of bars beyond a line:
- NQ3x 17.8% (top 10.4 / bottom 7.4)
- SP3x 16.6% (8.7 / 7.9)
- GOOG3x 22.0% (13.7 / 8.3)
- GOOG1x 21.9%
All fall inside the 10-25% target.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E1 σ乖離ライン', shorttitle='E1乖離σ', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500)
len  = input.int(20, '平均・σの期間', minval=5)
smL  = input.int(3, '平滑EMA', minval=1)
k    = input.float(2.4, 'スケールk (±60=±0.693k σ)', minval=0.5, step=0.1)
upTh = input.float(60.0, '高値圏ライン')
loTh = input.float(-60.0, '安値圏ライン')
showExit = input.bool(true, '離脱ラベルを表示')
// EMA seeded with first valid value (= pandas ewm(adjust=False)); built-in ta.ema seeding may differ
f_ema(float x, simple int n) =>
    var float s = na
    float a = 2.0 / (n + 1)
    s := na(s) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s
    s
// assumption: no built-in tanh in Pine; if math.tanh exists it is identical
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e = math.exp(-2.0 * math.abs(x))
    math.sign(x) * (1.0 - e) / (1.0 + e)
float basis = ta.sma(close, len)
float sd    = ta.stdev(close, len)   // default biased=true -> population stdev
float z     = na(sd) ? na : sd > 0 ? (close - basis) / sd : 0.0
float osc   = 100.0 * f_tanh(f_ema(z, smL) / k)
bool topIn  = ta.crossover(osc, upTh)
bool topOut = ta.crossunder(osc, upTh)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(osc, loTh)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(osc, loTh)
plot(osc, '乖離σ', osc > upTh ? color.red : osc < loTh ? color.green : color.gray, 2)
hline(upTh, '高値圏ライン', color.red, hline.style_solid)
hline(loTh, '安値圏ライン', color.green, hline.style_solid)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 60), hline.style_dotted)
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '高値圏突入', style=label.style_label_down, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
    if botIn
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '安値圏突入', style=label.style_label_up, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
    if showExit and topOut
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '高値圏離脱', style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.red, 60), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
    if showExit and botOut
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '安値圏離脱', style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.green, 60), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '高値圏突入', 'E1 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(topOut and barstate.isconfirmed, '高値圏離脱', 'E1 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(botIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '安値圏突入', 'E1 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(botOut and barstate.isconfirmed, '安値圏離脱', 'E1 安値圏離脱')
candidates.default_params:
- len = 20: the standard Bollinger length. The median spacing between 15% pivots is 10 bars on NQ3x and 18 on SP3x, so 20 bars covers about 1-2 swings.
- Smoothing = EMA3: removes single-bar spikes at about 1 bar of lag.
- k = 2.4: puts ±60 at ±1.66 sigma, calibrated so 16-22% of bars sit outside the lines on NQ3x, SP3x, GOOG3x and GOOG1x.
- Threshold lines at ±60.
z is scale-free and almost leverage-invariant, so the same defaults work for TQQQ, SOXL, SPXL and 1x names.
Sensitivity knob: k = 2.3 puts 20-26% of bars outside (about +5 points of recall); k = 2.6 puts about 13-18% outside.
candidates.signals:
高値圏突入: osc > +60 and osc[1] <= +60 (ta.crossover).
高値圏離脱: osc < +60 and osc[1] >= +60 (ta.crossunder).
安値圏突入: osc < -60 and osc[1] >= -60 (ta.crossunder).
安値圏離脱: osc > -60 and osc[1] <= -60 (ta.crossover).
Labels and alerts are created only when barstate.isconfirmed. Entry labels are small and solid; exit labels are tiny and faded and can be switched off. The line is red above +60, green below -60, grey otherwise. No dots or triangles.
candidates.repaint: None. It uses only the close of the current and past bars: no request.security, negative offsets, pivots or future bars. The value on the still-forming bar moves intrabar, which is normal. Labels and alerts fire only on barstate.isconfirmed, so every historical label is exactly what printed live. Confirmation delay: 0 bars (the signal is final at the close of the crossing bar). Pine rolls back the var state inside f_ema on each realtime tick, so nothing is counted twice.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
Validation: NQ and SP 1999-2018 plus GOOG 2004-2013, all synthesized to 3x, first 300 bars excluded, 15% close zigzag as truth. A hit means the pivot bar is inside the zone or at most 5 bars after leaving it.
- Alignment: the median offset between line extreme and price extreme is 0 bars at tops and -1 to -2 bars at bottoms (sigma swells in waterfalls, so the trough comes 1-2 bars early). |offset| <= 2 bars for 54-63% of tops and 52-56% of bottoms.
- Hits on 15% swings: tops 33-41%, bottoms 50-64%. On 25%+ swings: tops 39-58%, bottoms 58-76%. GOOG1x: 92% / 67% on 15% swings, 100% / 80% on 25%.
- Never pinned: the longest zone run is 10-14 bars. The NQ3x Oct-1999 to Mar-2000 melt-up (+455%) split into 8 short top-zone visits (longest 9 bars). Calm 2017 SP3x split into 10 visits (longest 9). The 2008 crash gave 4 bottom-zone visits (longest 10).
- About 5.5-8 entries per side per year, roughly 2 labels a month.
- Smoothness: mean|diff| / stdev is about 0.2, similar to RSI. It typically approaches +60 over 2-5 bars (+30, +45, +60), which gives the 'そろそろ' feel.
NQ3x examples:
- 2000-03-10 top: inside the zone (+62 to +72) for 7 or more bars, exited the next bar.
- Lows: 2001-09-21 -68, 2008-11-20 -67, 2011-08-08 -82, 2015-08-24 -85, 2018-12-24 -72.
- 2009-03-09 low: entered at -64 five bars before, -56 on the low day (counts as 'just after').
candidates.failure_modes:
(1) Melt-ups produce repeated short 高値圏突入 entries. Only 23-41% of top-zone episodes are followed by a 15% top.
(2) In one-way crashes sigma expands, so the trough leads the low by 1-2 bars. The line can leave the bottom zone before the final low, and a W-bottom shows a higher-low divergence; 安値圏離脱 alone is not a buy signal.
(3) Squeeze breakouts: after a tight range sigma is tiny, so a modest breakout jumps z and gives a false 高値圏突入 at the start of a new up-leg.
(4) Rounded tops: the SMA catches up and z fades before the price high, so about 60% of 15% tops are missed.
(5) Bear-market rally tops only reach the mean (z about 0 to +1), so there is no top signal. In V-reversals, 13-16% of 15% tops still had the line in the bottom zone 5 or fewer bars earlier.
(6) The first ~22 bars are invalid.
candidates.python_replication:
c = df['Close']
sma = c.rolling(20).mean()
sd = c.rolling(20).std(ddof=0)
z = pd.Series(np.where(sd.isna(), np.nan, np.where(sd > 0, (c - sma)/sd, 0.0)), index=c.index)
zs = z.ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean()   # leading NaNs are skipped and the first valid value is the seed, matching Pine f_ema
osc = 100*np.tanh(zs/2.4)
top_in = (osc > 60) & (osc.shift(1) <= 60)
top_out = (osc < 60) & (osc.shift(1) >= 60)
bot_in = (osc < -60) & (osc.shift(1) >= -60)
bot_out = (osc > -60) & (osc.shift(1) <= -60)
# NaN comparisons are False, same as ta.crossover with na
Warm-up: NaN for bars 0-18. The seed's influence decays as 0.5^k, so evaluate from bar 60 or later (my numbers exclude 300 bars). Do not use Pine's built-in ta.ema, whose seeding may differ (likely an SMA seed).
My 3x synthesis: X3_t = C3_{t-1}*(1 + 3*(X_t/C_{t-1} - 1)) for X in {O,H,L,C}, with C3_0 = 100 and no fees or financing.
Data note: in the arch sp500 file, Open equals the previous Close on about 95% of days from 1999 to 2005. None of my six designs use Open.

candidates.name_ja: 適応平均乖離（KAMA乖離）
candidates.concept: カウフマン適応移動平均KAMA(10,2,30)からの終値の距離をATR14で割り（何ATR離れたか）、3本EMAでならして±100に写した線。KAMAは値動きの効率（10本の正味変化÷道のり）が高い一本調子のトレンドでは速く追随し、もみ合いでは止まるので、『トレンドには付いていき、行き過ぎた分だけ』が乖離として残る。±60（約1.6ATR）を超える行き過ぎは平均への引き戻しが近い合図。
candidates.element_purity: The main driver is the distance of close from an efficiency-adaptive, trend-following mean, i.e. 乖離. ATR is only the unit (normaliser), not a signal source. KAMA's efficiency ratio only sets how fast the mean follows and never enters the output directly. It uses no up/down balance, volume, swing anchors, cycles, counts or candle geometry. Honest caveat: ATR-normalised kairi is mathematically close to RSI (an EMA of returns divided by mean absolute move). Measured correlation with RSI14 is 0.87 (level) / 0.84 (daily change), making this the most E2-like of the three E1 options.
candidates.raw_formula:
mom_t = |close_t - close_{t-10}|
path_t = sum_{i=0..9} |close_{t-i} - close_{t-i-1}| (math.sum, valid from bar 10)
er_t = path_t > 0 ? mom_t/path_t : 0
fsc = 2/3, ssc = 2/31
sc_t = (er_t*(fsc - ssc) + ssc)^2
KAMA_t = close_t for t < 10 (sc is na); afterwards KAMA_t = KAMA_{t-1} + sc_t*(close_t - KAMA_{t-1})

candidates.default_params:
- KAMA(10,2,30): Kaufman's standard settings; 10 bars is about half to one 3x swing.
- ATR14, computed with the custom RMA.
- Smoothing = EMA3.
- k = 2.3: ±60 equals ±1.59 ATR, putting 17-21% of bars outside the lines.
Both the numerator and ATR scale about 3x under leverage, so the ratio and the defaults carry over from 1x to 3x.
candidates.signals: The same four crossings of ±60 as E1-bollinger-z: 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(osc,60), 高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(osc,60), 安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(osc,-60), 安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(osc,-60). Labels and alerts are created only on barstate.isconfirmed bars.
candidates.repaint: None. It is a causal recursion on close/high/low only. Pine rolls back KAMA's var state intrabar. Labels are created at bar close, with a 0-bar delay. No security calls and no offsets.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
- Alignment: median offset 0 bars at both tops and bottoms. |offset| <= 2 for 61-65% of tops and 59% of bottoms.
- Hits on 15% swings: tops 27-39%, bottoms 50-78%. On 25%+ swings: tops 32-52%, bottoms 58-88%. This is the best bottom recall of the three options (SP3x 25% lows: 88%).
- Longest zone run 9-17 bars; about 6.5-7.5 entries per side per year.
- In clean trends KAMA follows price, so the line relaxes toward 0 instead of pinning. In chop KAMA flattens and the line behaves like a range oscillator.
candidates.failure_modes:
(1) In very efficient blow-offs (efficiency ratio near 1) KAMA hugs price and under-reads the final stretch.
(2) In chop KAMA freezes, so zone touches become more frequent.
(3) Highest wrong-side rate at tops: 11-23% of 15% tops had the line in the bottom zone 5 or fewer bars earlier (crash followed by a V-rebound top).
(4) Closest to RSI, so it would overlap visually with E2.
(5) The first ~100 bars are affected by the KAMA and ATR seeds.

candidates.name_ja: 回帰トレンド乖離（回帰チャネル位置）
candidates.concept: 直近75本の対数終値に最小二乗の直線（遅れゼロのトレンド追随平均）を当て、今日の終値がその直線の現在値からどれだけ外れているかを、同じ75本の回帰残差の標準偏差（チャネル幅）で割った『回帰チャネル内の位置』。トレンドが直線的に続く限り0付近に留まり、直線を大きく上抜けて加速（吹き上げ）・下抜けて加速（投げ）した時だけ±60を超えるので、トレンド中に張り付きにくく3案中で最もなめらか。
candidates.element_purity: The 'mean' is the regression line itself (zero lag for linear trends), and the deviation is scaled by the residual dispersion. That makes it a pure distance-from-trend-mean measure: the causal endpoint of a linear-regression channel. The window is deliberately long. With 30-50 bars the residual turns into a curvature/acceleration measure; my tests gave a correlation of 0.85-0.93 with a MACD-histogram proxy, which is E3 territory. At 75 bars that correlation drops to 0.75. It has the lowest RSI14 correlation of the E1 options (0.72 level).
candidates.raw_formula:
y_t = ln(close_t).
Window = bars t-74..t, with x = 0 for the oldest bar and x = 74 for the current bar.
fit_t = ta.linreg(y,75,0) = mean(y) + b*(74 - 37), where b = cov(x,y)/var(x) using population moments.
rho_t = ta.correlation(y, bar_index, 75)
sy_t = ta.stdev(y,75) (population)
sres_t = sy_t*sqrt(max(1 - rho_t^2, 0)) (= population stdev of the OLS residuals)
zc_t = sres_t > 0 ? (y_t - fit_t)/sres_t : 0 (na for bars 0..73)
zs_t = EMA3(zc): alpha 0.5, seeded with the first valid value.
candidates.normalization:
osc = zs >= 0 ? 100*tanh(zs/2.3) : 100*tanh(zs/2.6).
±60 corresponds to zs = +1.594 / -1.802 residual-sigma.
The scale is asymmetric because 3x crash residuals are larger: raw quantiles are q09 about -1.94 and q91 about +1.55 to +1.8.

candidates.default_params:
- n = 75: about 3.5 months, or 4-7 typical 3x swings. That is long enough for the residual to mean 'stretch versus trend' rather than acceleration; do not go below 40.
- Log price, so exponential 3x price paths stay linear in logs.
- Smoothing = EMA3.
- kUp = 2.3 / kDn = 2.6.
candidates.signals: The same four crossings of ±60: 高値圏突入 / 高値圏離脱 / 安値圏突入 / 安値圏離脱, using ta.crossover and ta.crossunder. Labels and alerts are created only on barstate.isconfirmed bars.
candidates.repaint: None. Only the regression endpoint at the current bar (offset 0) is used, recomputed each bar from past data. Nothing is redrawn into the past, unlike TradingView's drawn 'Linear Regression Channel', which refits history. Labels are created at bar close, with a 0-bar delay.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
- Alignment: median offset 0 bars; |offset| <= 2 for 52-59% of pivots.
- Hits on 15% swings: tops 20-24%, bottoms 43-58%. On 25%+ swings: tops 23-35%, bottoms 47-55%.
- The smoothest E1 line (mean|diff| / stdev 0.1-0.2) with the fewest entries (about 3-5 per side per year), but zone runs last up to 18-27 bars.
- It fires mainly at the end of accelerations (blow-offs and capitulations) relative to the 3-month trend, so it leans toward confirmation.
candidates.failure_modes:
(1) Regime change: when a new trend starts, the 75-bar line still reflects the old trend, and the residual stays large for weeks (runs up to 27 bars).
(2) It misses most minor (15%) tops.
(3) Very tight fits (rho^2 near 1) shrink sres and amplify small wiggles. This is guarded by max(1-rho^2, 0) and sres > 0.
(4) Shortening the window turns it into an acceleration (E3) indicator.

y = np.log(df['Close'].to_numpy())
x = np.arange(75.0); xm = 37.0
vx = ((x-xm)**2).mean()
zc = np.full(len(y), np.nan)
for t in range(74, len(y)):
    w = y[t-74:t+1]
    ym = w.mean()
    cxy = ((x-xm)*(w-ym)).mean()
    b = cxy/vx
    fit = ym + b*(74-xm)

osc = np.where(zs >= 0, 100*np.tanh(zs/2.3), 100*np.tanh(zs/2.6))

elements.element_ja: 値動きの荒さ（ボラティリティの急変・恐怖指数の代わり）
elements.recommendation_reason:
E10-vol-term-gauge を推奨。It is the only E10 option that meets the user's top requirement that the 10 indicators must not resemble each other. Its amplitude comes purely from volatility (the fast/slow true-range% ratio), and direction is used only to sign an expansion. Averaged over NQ3x/SP3x/GOOG3x, its daily-change correlation with E1-bollinger-z is 0.45, versus 0.80 for E10-signed-semivol and 0.71 for E10-vixfix-bipolar. Against RSI14 it is 0.61 (level) / 0.46 (change), and top-zone overlap with E1 is about 0.1 (Jaccard).
It pinpoints capitulation lows: the median trough offset is 0 bars. Readings at known lows: 2000-04-14 -94, 2001-09-21 -93, 2011-08-08 -100, 2015-08-24 -99, SP 2018-02-08 -100, 2018-12-24 -85 (NQ) / -93 (SP). It also gives a calm-before-the-top complacency reading: SP 2007-10-09 sat at +73 to +86 and exited 2 bars after the top. The half-weighted blow-off branch keeps false jumps into the top zone right after panic lows to 6-13%, versus about 20-25% for E10-signed-semivol. Zone time is 17-20%, and the defaults are leverage-invariant.
Honest weakness: on tops it is mainly an early complacency warning, with 21-28% recall on 15% tops. It also misses 'quiet' lows made while volatility is already falling (2002-10, 2009-03).
If the project values hit rate over distinctness, E10-signed-semivol is the runner-up: bottoms 54-58% on 15% swings and 64-66% on 25%. However, it looks like E1/E2 on the chart and flips after V-bottoms. E10-vixfix-bipolar is the classic, but it overlaps conceptually with E6 (drawdown) and statistically with E1 (0.85).

candidates.name_ja: 恐怖・慢心ゲージ（ボラ拡大・収縮）
candidates.concept: 直近の真の値幅%（RMA3）が基準（RMA30）に比べてどれだけ広がったか/縮んだかの対数比を主役にした『体感ボラ（恐怖指数の代わり）』の線。値幅の拡大が下げ主導なら恐怖としてマイナス（安値圏）、値幅が縮んでいれば慢心としてプラス（高値圏）、上げ主導の拡大（吹き上げ）は半分の重みでプラス。投げ売りの値幅拡大は底の当日に最大になりやすいので、安値圏突入＝投げの最中、安値圏離脱＝恐怖が引き始めた合図。高値圏は『静かすぎる』先行警報で、離脱（値幅の再拡大）が天井確認寄りになる。
candidates.element_purity:
The line's amplitude comes only from the volatility term structure, ln(RMA3(TR%)/RMA30(TR%)). Direction is used only as a sign gate for expansions: the share of up-day versus down-day squared returns over 5 bars (realized semivariances), squashed by tanh. The gate never creates amplitude: if the fast range equals the base range, the line is 0 whatever the gate says.
It uses no distance from a mean (E1), no momentum magnitude (E2), no change of momentum (E3), no volume (E4), no bars-since-swing or swing size (E5/E6), no cycle (E7), no counts (E8), and no wick or close-location geometry (E9). TR includes the gap from the prior close; it does not use wicks.
Measured independence, averaged over NQ3x/SP3x/GOOG3x:
- vs E1-bollinger-z: 0.63 level / 0.45 daily change
- vs RSI14: 0.61 / 0.46
- vs a swing-amplitude proxy: 0.45
- vs close-location value (CLV): 0.31
candidates.raw_formula:
TR_t = max(high_t, close_{t-1}) - min(low_t, close_{t-1}) (= ta.tr(true)).
trp_t = TR_t/close_{t-1} (na at bar 0).
vf_t = RMA3(trp) = trp_t/3 + (2/3)*vf_{t-1}.
vs_t = RMA30(trp) = trp_t/30 + (29/30)*vs_{t-1}.
Both are seeded with trp_1 using the custom f_rma.
VR_t = ln(vf_t/vs_t): > 0 means expansion, < 0 compression. Set to 0 if either value is <= 0; na at bar 0.
r_t = ln(close_t/close_{t-1}), with r_0 = 0.
up2_t = EMA5(r_t > 0 ? r_t^2 : 0) and dn2_t = EMA5(r_t < 0 ? r_t^2 : 0), with alpha = 1/3, seeded at bar 0.
gate_t = tanh(4*(dn2_t - up2_t)/(up2_t + dn2_t)), or 0 if the sum is 0. +1 means the move is down-day driven, -1 up-day driven.
w_t = gate_t if gate_t > 0, else 0.5*gate_t.
x_t = VR_t > 0 ? -VR_t*w_t : -VR_t.
xs_t = EMA3(x): alpha 0.5, seeded at bar 1.
candidates.normalization:
osc = xs >= 0 ? 100*tanh(xs/0.45) : 100*tanh(xs/0.26).
+60 corresponds to xs = +0.312: the fast range is about 27% below base (complacency).
-60 corresponds to xs = -0.180: a down-driven fast range about 1.2x base after smoothing (fear).
The scale is asymmetric because log-vol ratios are right-skewed: median xs is about +0.08 to +0.10, q90 about +0.30 to +0.33, q08 about -0.17 to -0.19. |osc| < 100.
candidates.thresholds:
Fixed lines at ±60 (red/green solid). Share of bars outside:
- NQ3x 17.8% (top 10.1 / bottom 7.7)
- SP3x 20.1% (11.8 / 8.3)
- GOOG3x 17.4% (8.9 / 8.5)
- GOOG1x 16.7%

//@version=6
indicator('E10 恐怖・慢心ゲージ', shorttitle='E10ボラ', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500)
fL   = input.int(3, '短期値幅 RMA', minval=1)
sL   = input.int(30, '基準値幅 RMA', minval=5)
gL   = input.int(5, '上下判定 EMA', minval=2)
sh   = input.float(4.0, '上下判定の鋭さ', minval=0.5)
wb   = input.float(0.5, '吹き上げの重み', minval=0.0, maxval=1.0)
smL  = input.int(3, '平滑EMA', minval=1)
kUp  = input.float(0.45, 'スケール上側(慢心)', minval=0.05, step=0.01)
kDn  = input.float(0.26, 'スケール下側(恐怖)', minval=0.05, step=0.01)
upTh = input.float(60.0, '高値圏ライン')
loTh = input.float(-60.0, '安値圏ライン')
showExit = input.bool(true, '離脱ラベルを表示')
f_ema(float x, simple int n) =>
    var float s = na
    float a = 2.0 / (n + 1)
    s := na(s) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s
    s
f_rma(float x, simple int n) =>
    var float s = na
    float a = 1.0 / n
    s := na(s) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s
    s
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e = math.exp(-2.0 * math.abs(x))
    math.sign(x) * (1.0 - e) / (1.0 + e)
float trp  = na(close[1]) ? na : ta.tr(true) / close[1]          // true range %
float vf   = f_rma(trp, fL)
float vs   = f_rma(trp, sL)
float vr   = (na(vf) or na(vs)) ? na : (vf > 0 and vs > 0) ? math.log(vf / vs) : 0.0   // >0 expansion, <0 compression
float r    = na(close[1]) ? 0.0 : math.log(close / close[1])
float up2  = f_ema(r > 0 ? r * r : 0.0, gL)
float dn2  = f_ema(r < 0 ? r * r : 0.0, gL)
float gate = (up2 + dn2) > 0 ? f_tanh(sh * (dn2 - up2) / (up2 + dn2)) : 0.0   // +1 down-driven, -1 up-driven
float w    = gate > 0 ? gate : wb * gate
float x    = na(vr) ? na : vr > 0 ? -vr * w : -vr
float xs   = f_ema(x, smL)
float osc  = xs >= 0 ? 100.0 * f_tanh(xs / kUp) : 100.0 * f_tanh(xs / kDn)
bool topIn  = ta.crossover(osc, upTh)
bool topOut = ta.crossunder(osc, upTh)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(osc, loTh)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(osc, loTh)
plot(osc, '恐怖・慢心', osc > upTh ? color.red : osc < loTh ? color.green : color.gray, 2)
hline(upTh, '高値圏ライン', color.red, hline.style_solid)
hline(loTh, '安値圏ライン', color.green, hline.style_solid)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 60), hline.style_dotted)
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '高値圏突入', style=label.style_label_down, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.small)
    if botIn

candidates.default_params:
- Fast RMA 3: panic on a 3x ETF is a 2-5 session event.
- Base RMA 30: about 6 weeks, or 2-3 typical swings. It adapts within a regime, so even the 2008 crash split into 7 bottom-zone visits (longest 10 bars).
- Gate EMA 5: one week of signed squared returns.
- Gate sharpness 4: the gate reaches about ±0.96 at a 70/30 split.
- Blow-off weight 0.5: in my grid this cut post-panic rebound flips into the top zone from about 9-12% to about 4-8% of lows.
- Smoothing = EMA3.
- kUp = 0.45 / kDn = 0.26.
TR% roughly triples on a 3x series but cancels in the ratio, so the defaults are leverage-invariant (zone time is 16.7% on GOOG1x vs 17.4% on GOOG3x). Grid alternative: base 50 gives slightly better bottoms, but complacency runs stretch to 40-50 bars.
candidates.signals:
高値圏突入: ta.crossover(osc,+60). Meaning: ranges are unusually narrow (complacency) or the expansion is up-driven.
高値圏離脱: ta.crossunder(osc,+60). Meaning: ranges are re-expanding, the usual top confirmation.
安値圏突入: ta.crossunder(osc,-60). Meaning: a selling climax is in progress (fear near its peak).
安値圏離脱: ta.crossover(osc,-60). Meaning: fear is receding.
All four are evaluated, labelled and alerted only on barstate.isconfirmed bars. Exit labels can be switched off.
candidates.repaint: None. It uses only high/low/close of the current and past bars. Pine rolls back the custom RMA/EMA var states intrabar. Labels and alerts fire on barstate.isconfirmed, with a 0-bar delay. No request.security: no external VIX/VXN is used, so it works on any symbol and replicates exactly in pandas.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
- Pinpoint at panic lows: median trough offset 0 bars on NQ3x and SP3x; |offset| <= 2 for 53-55% of lows.
- Panic-low readings: 2000-04-14 -94, 2001-09-21 -93, 2011-08-08 -100, 2015-08-24 -99, SP 2018-02-08 -100, 2018-12-24 -85 (NQ) / -93 (SP). At 2008-11-20 it read -57 on the low and -62 the next bar.
- Complacency: the SP 2007-10-09 top sat at +73 to +86 for 2 or more weeks and exited 2 bars after the top.
- Hits on 15% swings: tops 21-28%, bottoms 35-58% (SP3x 58%). On 25%+ swings: tops 23-42%, bottoms 35-60%.
- Top-side peaks lead the price high by 0.5-3 bars (the calm before the top).
- Longest runs: 14-24 bars in the top zone (calm uptrends), 13-16 in the bottom zone. About 4-6 entries per side per year.
- After a 15% low, the line enters the top zone within 10 bars only 6-13% of the time.
- Strong trends: in the NQ3x Oct-1999 to Mar-2000 melt-up it spent 0% of bars in the top zone (the rise was volatile) and 6% in the bottom zone. SP3x 2017: 14% top zone in 9 short visits (longest 8). Sep-Dec 2008: 34% bottom zone in 7 visits (longest 10).
- Roughness is about 0.3, a little jumpier than E1 at shocks; vol jumps by nature.
candidates.failure_modes:
(1) Weak at tops: complacency is an early warning, not a pinpoint. Tops made in high volatility are not flagged (2000-03-10 NQ +10, 2018-01-26 +24/+26).
(2) 'Quiet' lows made while volatility is already high and falling are missed (2002-10-09 NQ +9; 2009-03-09 NQ -18 / SP -41).
(3) In long crises the 30-bar base catches up, so later lows in the same crisis print shallower.
(4) Violent rebounds right after a panic can push the line to +20 to +30, occasionally into the zone.
(5) Up-driven blow-offs are half-weighted, so they are under-read.
(6) Single stocks: earnings gaps expand ranges in either direction (GOOG1x bottom hits only 25%).
(7) The first ~150 bars are affected by seed influence.

pc = df['Close'].shift(1)

trp = tr/pc   # NaN at bar 0
vf = trp.ewm(alpha=1/3, adjust=False).mean()
vs = trp.ewm(alpha=1/30, adjust=False).mean()   # both start at bar 1
vr = np.log(vf/vs)   # keep NaN at bar 0

w = np.where(gate > 0, gate, 0.5*gate)
x = pd.Series(np.where(vr.isna(), np.nan, np.where(vr > 0, -vr*w, -vr)), index=df.index)

candidates.name_ja: 善玉・悪玉ボラ差
candidates.concept: 直近1.5週の『上昇日の二乗リターン』と『下落日の二乗リターン』の差を、約3か月の平常分散で割った『善玉ボラ−悪玉ボラ』の線。平常の何倍もの下げが続くと深いマイナス（パニック＝安値圏）、平常の何倍もの上げが続くとプラス（吹き上げ＝高値圏）。さらに短期分散が平常より縮んでいる分（慢心）を0.3倍で上乗せするので、静かな上昇では線が少しずつ高値圏へ近づく。
candidates.element_purity: It is built only from second moments: realized semivariances (squared returns split by sign, Patton & Sheppard's good/bad volatility) relative to a baseline variance, plus a variance-compression term ln(B/V). Because returns are squared, one -8% day weighs as much as about 16 days of -2%. That makes it a shock measure, not an up/down count. Honest caveat: in practice it moves with the price-direction family. Correlation with E1-bollinger-z is 0.84 (level) / 0.80 (daily change), and with RSI14 0.81 / 0.82, so on the chart it would look similar to E1/E2.
candidates.raw_formula:
r_t = ln(close_t/close_{t-1}), with r_0 = 0.
U_t = EMA7(r_t > 0 ? r_t^2 : 0) and D_t = EMA7(r_t < 0 ? r_t^2 : 0), alpha = 0.25.
B_t = EMA63(r_t^2), alpha = 2/64.
All are seeded at bar 0 with 0 (custom f_ema).
V_t = U_t + D_t (= EMA7(r^2)).
S_t = B_t > 0 ? (U_t - D_t)/B_t : 0.
comp_t = (B_t > 0 and V_t > 0) ? max(0, ln(B_t/V_t)) : 0.
xs_t = EMA3(S_t + 0.3*comp_t).
candidates.normalization: osc = xs >= 0 ? 100*tanh(xs/0.95) : 100*tanh(xs/1.08). ±60 corresponds to xs = +0.658 / -0.749. The scale is asymmetric because down-shocks are larger. |osc| < 100.
candidates.thresholds:
Fixed lines at ±60. Share of bars outside:
- NQ3x 16.3% (7.3 / 9.0)
- SP3x 16.2% (7.2 / 9.0)
- GOOG3x 24.7% (14.2 / 10.5)
- GOOG1x 24.8%

bL  = input.int(63, '基準分散 EMA', minval=20)
lam = input.float(0.3, '収縮(慢心)の加点', minval=0.0, step=0.05)
kUp = input.float(0.95, 'スケール上側', step=0.01)
kDn = input.float(1.08, 'スケール下側', step=0.01)
f_ema(float x, simple int n) =>
    var float s = na
    float a = 2.0 / (n + 1)
    s := na(s) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s
    s
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e = math.exp(-2.0 * math.abs(x))
    math.sign(x) * (1.0 - e) / (1.0 + e)
float r  = na(close[1]) ? 0.0 : math.log(close / close[1])
float U  = f_ema(r > 0 ? r * r : 0.0, uL)
float D  = f_ema(r < 0 ? r * r : 0.0, uL)
float B  = f_ema(r * r, bL)

float cp = (B > 0 and V > 0) ? math.max(0.0, math.log(B / V)) : 0.0
float xs = f_ema(S + lam * cp, 3)
float osc = xs >= 0 ? 100.0 * f_tanh(xs / kUp) : 100.0 * f_tanh(xs / kDn)

bool topOut = ta.crossunder(osc, 60.0)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(osc, -60.0)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(osc, -60.0)
plot(osc, '善玉-悪玉ボラ', osc > 60 ? color.red : osc < -60 ? color.green : color.gray, 2)
hline(60, '高値圏ライン', color.red)
hline(-60, '安値圏ライン', color.green)
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn

candidates.behavior_at_turns:

candidates.name_ja: VIXフィックス双極（恐怖／強欲）
candidates.concept: Larry WilliamsのVIXフィックス（22本の最高終値から今日の安値までの下落率＝合成VIX＝恐怖）と、その逆（22本の最安終値から今日の高値までの上昇率＝強欲）を、それぞれ自分自身の『20本ボリンジャー上限』と『50本最高値×0.85』の低い方（CM_Williams_Vix_Fixの発火水準）で割って『発火までの距離』に直し、強欲−恐怖で1本の線にしたもの。恐怖が発火水準に近づくほど安値圏、強欲が近づくほど高値圏。
candidates.element_purity: This is the TradingView-standard 'VIX substitute' (Williams VIX Fix) and its inverse, each judged against its own volatility band, and it is explicitly listed in the E10 brief. Honest caveat: algebraically, WVF is the drawdown from the 22-bar highest close, and the inverse is the run-up from the 22-bar lowest close. Conceptually that overlaps E6 (move size since a recent extreme), and statistically it is close to E1 (correlation 0.85) and to a MACD-histogram proxy (0.88). It has the lowest element purity of the three E10 options.
candidates.raw_formula:
hc_t = highest(close,22) over bars t-21..t; lc_t = lowest(close,22).
wdn_t = 100*(hc_t - low_t)/hc_t: the WVF (fear).
wup_t = 100*(high_t - lc_t)/lc_t: the inverse WVF (greed).
For each w in {wdn, wup}:
den_t = min(SMA(w,20) + 2.0*stdev_pop(w,20), 0.85*highest(w,50))
g_t(w) = den_t > 0 ? w_t/den_t : 0 (na until bar 70)
x_t = g(wup) - g(wdn)
xs_t = EMA3(x), seeded with the first valid value.
candidates.normalization: osc = 100*tanh(xs/1.10). ±60 corresponds to xs = ±0.762, i.e. 76% of the CM trigger level (g >= 1 is CM's original 'fire' condition).

- SP3x 20.3% (13.3 / 7.0)

elements.element_ja: 勢い（上昇と下落の強さ）

candidates.name_ja: 勢いバランス（TSI）
candidates.concept: 上げと下げの綱引き：直近の終値変化について『正味の動き ÷ 動いた総量』を二重EMAで平滑したもの（短期版 True Strength Index 6/3）。+100 = 最近の足がすべて上げ、−100 = すべて下げ、0 = 拮抗。日足3倍ETFのスイング高値は『一方的な買いが最も積み上がった足』になりやすく、実データでも線の山は高値の足に一致した（中央値のずれ0本）。線が赤ラインを上抜けたら上昇の勢いを使い切りつつある＝そろそろ高値、緑ラインを下抜けたら＝そろそろ安値。二重EMAなので、極値の2〜5本前からなだらかにラインへ近づく。
candidates.element_purity: Input is only the close-to-close change, split into up and down movement. The output is a pure net/gross ratio, so it is dimensionless and independent of volatility level (E10), distance from a mean (E1), volume (E4), bars or amplitude since a swing (E5/E6), cycle phase (E7), run counts (E8) and candle shape (E9). It is the momentum LEVEL, not its change (E3). Measured caveat: a momentum level is structurally close to a short-mean kairi (corr 0.91 with (C−EMA20)/ATR14, 0.95 with EMA10) but only 0.71 with (C−EMA50)/ATR14. E1 must therefore use a slow or de-pinned mean to stay visually distinct. Correlation with the recommended E3 (失速率) is 0.62–0.66.
candidates.raw_formula:
pc[t] = close[t] − close[t−1]; pc[0] = 0 (Pine: nz(ta.change(close))).
EMA_n(x): α = 2/(n+1); s[0] = x[0] (seeded with the bar-0 value, NOT an SMA); s[t] = α·x[t] + (1−α)·s[t−1].
N[t] = EMA_3(EMA_6(pc))[t]; D[t] = EMA_3(EMA_6(|pc|))[t] (inner length r1 = 6 is applied first, outer r2 = 3 second).
mom[t] = 100·N[t]/D[t] if D[t] > 0, else 0.
Only bar t and earlier closes are used.
candidates.normalization: EMA weights are positive, so |N| ≤ D (triangle inequality) and mom ∈ [−100, +100] exactly. A ±100 clamp is kept only for numeric safety. No further mapping: 0 = balanced, ±100 = completely one-sided.
candidates.thresholds:
Default 適応 (adaptive, drawn as lines):
upper[t] = clamp(PNR(mom, 120, 90), 35, 75)
lower[t] = clamp(PNR(mom, 120, 10), −75, −35)
PNR = nearest-rank percentile over the 120 values mom[t−119..t], current bar included: sort ascending and take rank ceil(p·120/100), i.e. the 108th value for 90 % and the 12th for 10 %. Before 120 values exist (or if PNR is na), use ±55.
Option 固定 (fixed): ±55.
Measured share of bars beyond the lines: adaptive gives 20.3–21.5 % on NAS3x, SPX3x, GOOG1x and GOOG3x alike (top 10.7–11.3 / bottom 9.7–10.3). Fixed ±55 gives 19.5 % on SPX3x, 21.5 % on NAS3x and 27 % on GOOG. The adaptive upper line typically sits at 41–75 (median 56–64), the lower at −35 to −66 (median −47 to −53).

//@version=6
indicator('E2 勢いバランス TSI', shorttitle='E2勢い', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500)
r1    = input.int(6, '1段目EMA', minval=2)
r2    = input.int(3, '2段目EMA', minval=1)
mode  = input.string('適応', 'しきい値', options=['適応', '固定'])
fixT  = input.float(55.0, '固定 ±', minval=10.0, maxval=95.0)
adN   = input.int(120, '適応 期間', minval=30)
adP   = input.float(90.0, '適応 上側%', minval=60.0, maxval=99.0)
showX = input.bool(true, '離脱ラベル')
// EMA seeded with the bar-0 value (= pandas ewm(span=n, adjust=False))
f_ema(float x, int n) =>
    float a = 2.0 / (n + 1)
    float s = 0.0
    s := na(s[1]) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s[1]
    s
float pc  = nz(ta.change(close))
float num = f_ema(f_ema(pc, r1), r2)
float den = f_ema(f_ema(math.abs(pc), r1), r2)
float mom = den > 0 ? math.max(-100.0, math.min(100.0, 100.0 * num / den)) : 0.0
float pu  = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(mom, adN, adP)
float pl  = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(mom, adN, 100.0 - adP)
bool  fx  = mode == '固定'
float upper = fx or na(pu) ? fixT : math.max(35.0, math.min(75.0, pu))
float lower = fx or na(pl) ? -fixT : math.min(-35.0, math.max(-75.0, pl))
// v6 and/or are lazy: evaluate ta.cross* on every bar first
bool cuT = ta.crossover(mom, upper)
bool cdT = ta.crossunder(mom, upper)
bool cdB = ta.crossunder(mom, lower)
bool cuB = ta.crossover(mom, lower)
bool ok  = barstate.isconfirmed
bool enterTop = cuT and ok
bool exitTop  = cdT and ok
bool enterBot = cdB and ok
bool exitBot  = cuB and ok
color cR = color.rgb(179, 38, 30)
color cG = color.rgb(27, 107, 58)
color cL = mom >= 0 ? color.from_gradient(mom, 0, 100, color.gray, cR) : color.from_gradient(mom, -100, 0, cG, color.gray)
plot(mom, '勢い', cL, 2)
plot(upper, '高値圏ライン', cR, 1)
plot(lower, '安値圏ライン', cG, 1)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 70), hline.style_dotted)
if enterTop
    label.new(bar_index, mom, '高値圏突入', style=label.style_label_down, color=cR, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
if enterBot
    label.new(bar_index, mom, '安値圏突入', style=label.style_label_up, color=cG, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
if showX and exitTop
    label.new(bar_index, upper, '高値圏離脱', style=label.style_none, textcolor=cR, size=size.tiny)
if showX and exitBot
    label.new(bar_index, lower, '安値圏離脱', style=label.style_none, textcolor=cG, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(enterTop, '高値圏突入', 'E2勢い 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(exitTop, '高値圏離脱', 'E2勢い 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(enterBot, '安値圏突入', 'E2勢い 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(exitBot, '安値圏離脱', 'E2勢い 安値圏離脱')
// UNVERIFIED API details: (a) ta.percentile_nearest_rank behaviour for the first adN-1 bars (na assumed, fixed fallback); (b) its rank convention (ceil(p*n/100) assumed). The built-in ta.tsi/ta.ema are avoided because their seeding (SMA vs first value) is not guaranteed.
candidates.default_params:
r1 = 6, r2 = 3; adaptive window 120 bars, 90/10 percentiles, clamps 35–75, fixed fallback ±55.
Why these lengths: on NASDAQ-3x a 15 % zigzag gives about 11 swings/yr with a median leg of only 10 bars (p25 5, p75 24); SPX3x gives 7.6/yr with an 18-bar median. The balance should therefore remember about half a leg. EMA6→EMA3 has a centre of mass of about 3.5 bars and peaks on the leg's final bar.
Alternatives tested:
- classic 25/13: no top information on 3x (AUC 0.51–0.56)
- 5/3 or 6/2: marginally better tops but jaggier (40–45 direction changes per 100 bars vs 39)
- 8/3: smoother but weaker tops
Threshold settings: 120 bars (about 6 months) keeps the lines regime-aware; 90/10 gives about 21 % zone time; the clamps keep the lines readable in long trends.
The ratio is scale-free, so the same defaults work on 1x stocks (GOOG1x zone 21.5 %).
candidates.signals:
Evaluated on the closed bar only (barstate.isconfirmed). A crossing compares the line with the threshold values of the same two bars.
高値圏突入: mom[t] > upper[t] and mom[t−1] ≤ upper[t−1]
高値圏離脱: mom[t] < upper[t] and mom[t−1] ≥ upper[t−1]
安値圏突入: mom[t] < lower[t] and mom[t−1] ≥ lower[t−1]
安値圏離脱: mom[t] > lower[t] and mom[t−1] ≤ lower[t−1]
Display: entries are small filled labels (red above, green below); exits are text-only labels that can be hidden; nothing else (no dots or triangles). Each event has an alertcondition (use 'Once per bar close').
Frequency: about 18 zone entries/yr on 3x indices (about 1.5 per month).
Reading: 突入 = the force is being used up in one direction, そろそろ (median lead 2 bars before the extreme). 離脱 = the imbalance is breaking down, the turn is under way.
candidates.repaint:
No repaint. Every term uses closes up to the current bar, recursions have fixed seeds, and the percentile window contains only past bars plus the current bar. The forming bar's line moves with price (normal), but labels and alerts require barstate.isconfirmed, so historical signals never change. Confirmation delay: 0 bars after the close of the crossing bar.
Pine v6 detail: and/or short-circuit in v6, so ta.crossover/ta.crossunder are stored in variables on every bar before being ANDed with barstate.isconfirmed.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
Alignment: the line's ±10-bar extreme falls on the price extreme (median offset 0 bars). 54 % of NAS3x, 58 % of SPX3x and 70 % of GOOG1x swing highs have it within ±2 bars.
Approach: mean line at NAS3x swing highs for t−6..t+3 is −3, +2, +7, +12, +16, +24, +39, +22, 0, −16; bottoms are the mirror image, reaching +54 at t (sign-flipped). Median lead from zone entry to the extreme is 2 bars.
Zone hits (zone active on any of t−5..t; chance in brackets):
- NAS3x: tops 44 % (26), bottoms 67 % (28)
- SPX3x: tops 43 % (27), bottoms 59 % (26)
- GOOG1x: tops 70 % (27), bottoms 81 % (28)
- swings of ≥25–30 % on 3x: tops 53–69 %, bottoms 60–77 %
AUC (bars t−3..t vs all other bars), NAS3x/SPX3x/GOOG1x: tops 0.62/0.66/0.78, bottoms 0.84/0.85/0.87.
Opposite-zone entry within 4 bars after an extreme: 13–19 % after highs, 4–6 % after lows. About 18 zone entries/yr. Smoothness: 38–40 direction changes per 100 bars.
Strong trends (top/bottom zone % of bars, adaptive lines):
- NAS3x bull 2003: 14.6/7.1; 2013: 12.7/6.0; 2017: 12.4/6.4 (fixed ±55 would be 22–26/0–1, i.e. pinned)
- 2008–09 bear: 8.4/10.7
- 2000 crash: 6.3/15.6
- SPX3x bulls: 10.8–17/4.7–7.1
candidates.failure_modes:
(1) Tops on 3x indices are only moderately caught (43–44 % vs 26–27 % chance). On rounded or distribution tops momentum fades first, so the line leaves the top zone before the final high (classic divergence) and 高値圏離脱 comes early.
(2) With fixed lines it pins in persistent trends, hence the adaptive default. Adaptive lines lag regime changes by weeks (120-bar memory); the ≥35 clamp stops them from labelling ordinary strength as 高値圏.
(3) Single gap days (±8–10 % on 3x) dominate the short EMAs and cause brief marginal crossings in chop.
(4) Sharp V reversals: 13–19 % of highs are followed within 4 bars by 安値圏突入 (usually a genuinely fast drop).
(5) Looks similar to any short-horizon kairi or RSI line (corr ≥0.9), so E1 must be coordinated.
(6) Laguerre RSI (the usual low-lag RSI) was tested and rejected: at γ 0.5–0.8 it sits exactly at ±100 on more than 20 % of bars and its peaks lead the extreme by 2–7 bars (only 13–31 % within ±2). Ehlers MyRSI on a SuperSmoother saturates the same way.
candidates.python_replication:
Inputs: 3x synthetic OHLC (volume unused); t = 0 is the first bar.
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, math
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view as swv
E = lambda x, n: pd.Series(x).ewm(span=n, adjust=False).mean().to_numpy()  # alpha 2/(n+1), seed x[0]; identical to f_ema
c = df['Close'].to_numpy(float)
pc = np.r_[0.0, np.diff(c)]  # nz(ta.change(close))
num = E(E(pc, 6), 3); den = E(E(np.abs(pc), 6), 3)
mom = np.clip(np.where(den > 0, 100*num/den, 0.0), -100, 100)
W = np.sort(swv(mom, 120), axis=1)  # window = bars t-119..t (current bar included)
pu = np.full(len(mom), np.nan); pu[119:] = W[:, math.ceil(90*120/100)-1]  # 108th smallest
pl = np.full(len(mom), np.nan); pl[119:] = W[:, math.ceil(10*120/100)-1]  # 12th smallest
upper = np.where(np.isnan(pu), 55.0, np.clip(pu, 35, 75)); lower = np.where(np.isnan(pl), -55.0, np.clip(pl, -75, -35))
prev = lambda x: np.r_[np.nan, x[:-1]]
enterTop = (mom > upper) & (prev(mom) <= prev(upper)); exitTop = (mom < upper) & (prev(mom) >= prev(upper))
enterBot = (mom < lower) & (prev(mom) >= prev(lower)); exitBot = (mom > lower) & (prev(mom) <= prev(lower))
(NaN comparisons are False, so t = 0 never signals.) Fixed mode: upper = 55, lower = −55.
Warm-up: score from bar 300 (seed transients die within about 50 bars; the percentile needs 120). If Pine's built-in ta.ema/ta.tsi were used instead of f_ema, differences would be confined to the first ~50 bars.

candidates.name_ja: 上げ下げ綱引き（RSI7）
candidates.concept: Wilder の RSI を共通スケールに直したもの：100·(平滑した上げ幅 − 下げ幅)/(上げ幅 + 下げ幅) = 2·RSI − 100。3倍ETFの5〜24本のスイングに合わせて期間は7。脚の中で上げ優勢が積み上がるほど+側に伸び、脚の最終足（高値）で山になる。±45 は RSI 72.5/27.5 に当たるので、RSIに慣れた人にも直感的。
candidates.element_purity: Same pure up-vs-down balance of closes as E2-tsi-balance, but with single Wilder (RMA) smoothing; no level, volume, time, range or candle input. It is another implementation of the same idea (corr 0.97 with E2-tsi-balance) and is even closer to a short kairi (corr 0.97 with (C−EMA20)/ATR). Offered for familiarity, not for diversity.
candidates.raw_formula:
d[t] = close[t] − close[t−1]; d[0] = 0.
RMA_n(x): α = 1/n; s[0] = x[0]; s[t] = α·x[t] + (1−α)·s[t−1].
U[t] = RMA_7(d)[t]; G[t] = RMA_7(|d|)[t]; bal[t] = 100·U[t]/G[t] if G[t] > 0, else 0.
Identity: RMA(d) = RMA(max(d,0)) − RMA(max(−d,0)) and RMA(|d|) is their sum, so bal = 2·RSI_7 − 100 when both RMAs share the seed. TradingView's ta.rsi seeds its RMA with an SMA of the first 7 values; the difference disappears after about 50 bars.
candidates.normalization: |U| ≤ G, so bal ∈ [−100, +100] exactly; no mapping.
candidates.thresholds:
Default 固定 ±45 (≡ RSI 72.5/27.5).
Option 適応: upper = clamp(PNR(bal,120,90), 30, 70), lower = clamp(PNR(bal,120,10), −70, −30), fallback ±45.
Measured zone share at ±45: 21.0 % NAS3x (top 14.1 / bottom 7.0), 17.9 % SPX3x (11.6/6.4), 27.5 % GOOG1x, 26.8 % GOOG3x. Adaptive: 20.6–21.2 % everywhere.

candidates.name_ja: 方向性バランス（高値更新vs安値更新）
candidates.concept: 終値ではなく『値幅が伸びた方向』で勢いの綱引きを測る。今日の高値が昨日の高値をどれだけ上回ったか（+DM）と、今日の安値が昨日の安値をどれだけ下回ったか（−DM）を Wilder のルールで振り分け、二重EMA（6→3）で平滑して 100·(+DM − −DM)/(+DM + −DM) とする。終値には表れない日中の上抜け・下抜けの圧力も拾う。
candidates.element_purity: Still the up-vs-down movement balance, but the raw input is the directional extension of highs and lows (Wilder +DM/−DM). candidates.raw_formula:

−DM[t] = dn[t] if (dn[t] > up[t] and dn[t] > 0), else 0.
A = EMA_3(EMA_6(+DM)); B = EMA_3(EMA_6(−DM)) (EMAs seeded with the bar-0 value).
bal[t] = 100·(A[t] − B[t])/(A[t] + B[t]) if A[t] + B[t] > 0, else 0.
candidates.normalization: A, B ≥ 0, so bal ∈ [−100, +100]; no mapping.

AUC (t−3..t), NAS3x/SPX3x/GOOG1x: tops 0.61/0.65/0.76, bottoms 0.82/0.84/0.86.
Top and bottom zone time are more symmetric than for close-based balances.

elements.recommendation_reason:
Recommend E2-tsi-balance.
Test setup (in-memory replication): NASDAQ and S&P 500 1999–2018 synthesized to 3x with daily reset (L_X[t] = L_C[t−1]·(1+3·(X[t]/C[t−1]−1)), no fees), plus GOOG 2004–2013. Swings are a close-based 15 % zigzag on the 3x close (10 % on GOOG 1x). First 300 bars ignored.
Why it wins:
(1) Pinpoint: the line's peak falls on the extreme bar (median offset 0; 54–70 % of swing highs within ±2 bars), and it climbs over the 2–5 bars before (NAS3x mean at highs: t−3 +12, t−1 +24, t +39, t+2 0).
(2) Smoothest high-information E2 variant: 38–40 direction changes per 100 bars vs 50–53 for RSI7.
(3) Best top information among the smooth variants: AUC (t−3..t) tops 0.62/0.66/0.78, bottoms 0.84/0.85/0.87 on NAS3x/SPX3x/GOOG1x.
(4) The clamped adaptive lines keep a stable ~21 % zone share on every dataset and do not pin in bull years (12–17 % top-zone time vs 16–26 % with fixed lines), while still showing buy-the-dip zones (5–7 %).
Realistic hit rates: ≥15 % swing bottoms 59–67 % (chance 26–28 %), tops 43–44 % (chance 26–27 %); on ≥25–30 % swings, tops rise to 53–69 %.
Rejected in testing: Laguerre RSI (saturates at ±100 on more than 20 % of bars and peaks 2–7 bars early), Ehlers MyRSI (same saturation), classic TSI 25/13 and RSI14 (no top information on 3x, AUC 0.51–0.57).
Cross-element warning for the orchestrator: every momentum-level line correlates 0.90–0.97 with a short-mean kairi ((C−EMA10/20)/ATR) but only about 0.71 with (C−EMA50)/ATR. To honour 「似通ってはいけない」, E1 should be built on a slow mean (≥50) or a de-pinned/detrended construction. E2-tsi-balance vs the recommended E3 (失速率): corr 0.62–0.66.
Note: the only code in the repo, /home/user/1/research/turn_proximity_sample.py, mixes RSI14 with EMA20 stretch, stochastic and deceleration in proximity() — exactly the ingredient mixing the user rejected. The validation harness should replace proximity() with these single-element lines and reuse its zigzag/evaluate scaffolding.

elements.element_ja: 加速・失速（勢いの変化）

candidates.name_ja: 失速率
candidates.concept: 今の脚（上昇脚か下落脚）で一番速かった時の速度に対して、今の速度がどれだけ落ちたか（％）。速度 = 日々の対数リターンを SuperSmoother(4) で平滑した値、脚 = 速度の符号が同じ区間。上昇脚は0より上、下落脚は0より下に描く。加速している間は0付近。上昇が続いているのに速度がピークの45%以上落ちる＝価格と勢いの連続的なダイバージェンス→『高値圏突入：上昇が失速、そろそろ天井（または天井の直後）』。速度の符号が変わると脚が終わって線は0へ戻る（高値圏離脱＝失速完了・反転）。
candidates.element_purity: Uses only the CHANGE of momentum: current speed relative to the leg's own peak speed. The momentum level enters only through its sign (which leg we are in). While a move is still accelerating — exactly where E2 is highest — this line stays near 0, so it is logically and visually different from E2. No price level or mean distance (E1), volume (E4), bar count (E5), price amplitude (E6), cycle phase (E7), run counts (E8) or candle shape (E9). The typical speed σ is only a floor that mutes insignificant legs; it does not drive the signal. Measured correlations: 0.62–0.66 with E2-tsi-balance, 0.50–0.55 with (C−EMA20)/ATR, 0.41–0.44 with (C−EMA50)/ATR, 0.50–0.54 with a MACD-histogram accelerometer.
candidates.raw_formula:
r[t] = ln(close[t]/close[t−1]); r[0] = 0.
SuperSmoother SS_P: a1 = exp(−√2·π/P), c2 = 2·a1·cos(√2·π/P), c3 = −a1², c1 = 1 − c2 − c3.
  y[0] = x[0], y[1] = x[1]; y[t] = c1·(x[t] + x[t−1])/2 + c2·y[t−1] + c3·y[t−2].
  For P = 4: a1 ≈ 0.32932, c1 ≈ 0.81600, c2 ≈ 0.29245, c3 ≈ −0.10845.
v = SS_4(r) (speed); σ = RMA_100(|v|) (α = 1/100, seed |v[0]|).
Leg sign: s[t] = +1 if v[t] > 0, −1 if v[t] < 0, otherwise the previous side (+1 at the very start).
If s[t] ≠ side[t−1]: side = s[t], pk = |v[t]| (new leg); otherwise pk = max(pk, |v[t]|).
raw[t] = side[t]·(pk[t] − |v[t]|)/max(pk[t], 1.0·σ[t]) (0 if the denominator is 0).
stall = EMA_3(100·raw) (α = 0.5, seed = first value).
candidates.normalization:
0 ≤ pk − |v| ≤ pk ≤ max(pk, σ), so |raw| < 1 and stall ∈ (−100, +100) with no clipping. +100 would mean an up-leg whose speed has dropped to zero after a significant peak. Legs whose peak speed is below the typical speed σ are scaled down by pk/σ, so chop stays near 0. The ratio is scale-free (same behaviour on 1x and 3x shapes).
Distribution, measured with a 2-bar finishing EMA: median |line| ≈ 11, 80th percentile ≈ 42, 95th ≈ 72; the 3-bar default is slightly tighter.
candidates.thresholds:
Fixed ±45. Upper = 『上昇脚がピーク速度の45%以上を失った』; lower is the same for down-legs. Fixed lines are natural here because the line is already a percentage of the leg's own peak, so there is no regime drift.
Measured zone share: 13.5 % NAS3x (top 9.7 / bottom 3.8), 12.8 % SPX3x (9.0/3.7), 12.1 % GOOG1x (7.7/4.3). Option ±40 → 15–17 %.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E3 失速率', shorttitle='E3失速', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500)
P     = input.int(4, '速度スムーザー期間', minval=2)
sigN  = input.int(100, '平均速度の期間', minval=20)
flr   = input.float(1.0, '小さな脚のフロア(σ倍)', minval=0.1, step=0.1)
post  = input.int(3, '仕上げEMA', minval=1)
T     = input.float(45.0, 'しきい値 ±', minval=10.0, maxval=95.0)
showX = input.bool(true, '離脱ラベル')
f_ema(float x, int n) =>
    float a = 2.0 / (n + 1)
    float s = 0.0
    s := na(s[1]) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s[1]
    s
f_rma(float x, int n) =>
    float a = 1.0 / n
    float s = 0.0
    s := na(s[1]) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s[1]
    s
// Ehlers 2-pole SuperSmoother; the first two bars pass through
f_ss(float x, int p) =>
    float a1 = math.exp(-math.sqrt(2.0) * math.pi / p)
    float c2 = 2.0 * a1 * math.cos(math.sqrt(2.0) * math.pi / p)
    float c3 = -a1 * a1
    float c1 = 1.0 - c2 - c3
    float y = 0.0
    y := bar_index < 2 ? x : c1 * (x + x[1]) / 2.0 + c2 * y[1] + c3 * y[2]
    y
float r   = nz(math.log(close / close[1]))
float v   = f_ss(r, P)
float sig = f_rma(math.abs(v), sigN)
var int   side = 0
var float pk   = 0.0
int s = v > 0 ? 1 : v < 0 ? -1 : side == 0 ? 1 : side
if s != side
    side := s
    pk   := math.abs(v)
else
    pk   := math.max(pk, math.abs(v))
float den   = math.max(pk, flr * sig)
float raw   = den > 0 ? side * (pk - math.abs(v)) / den : 0.0
float stall = f_ema(100.0 * raw, post)
bool cuT = ta.crossover(stall, T)
bool cdT = ta.crossunder(stall, T)
bool cdB = ta.crossunder(stall, -T)
bool cuB = ta.crossover(stall, -T)
bool ok  = barstate.isconfirmed
color cR = color.rgb(179, 38, 30)
color cG = color.rgb(27, 107, 58)
color cL = stall >= 0 ? color.from_gradient(stall, 0, 100, color.gray, cR) : color.from_gradient(stall, -100, 0, cG, color.gray)
plot(stall, '失速率', cL, 2)
hline(T, '高値圏ライン', cR, hline.style_solid)
hline(-T, '安値圏ライン', cG, hline.style_solid)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 70), hline.style_dotted)
if cuT and ok
    label.new(bar_index, stall, '高値圏突入', style=label.style_label_down, color=cR, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
if cdB and ok
    label.new(bar_index, stall, '安値圏突入', style=label.style_label_up, color=cG, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
if showX and cdT and ok
    label.new(bar_index, T, '高値圏離脱', style=label.style_none, textcolor=cR, size=size.tiny)
if showX and cuB and ok
    label.new(bar_index, -T, '安値圏離脱', style=label.style_none, textcolor=cG, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(cuT and ok, '高値圏突入', 'E3失速 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(cdT and ok, '高値圏離脱', 'E3失速 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(cdB and ok, '安値圏突入', 'E3失速 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(cuB and ok, '安値圏離脱', 'E3失速 安値圏離脱')
// UNVERIFIED: hline(-T) with a negated input (if rejected, use plot(-T)). var state is rolled back on each realtime tick by Pine, so the leg/peak state is committed only at bar close.
candidates.default_params:
SuperSmoother period 4 on log returns: removes 2–3-bar noise with about 1 bar of lag. Alternatives: an EMA-3 speed gave corr 0.71 with E2 and a jumpier line; SS5–SS6 are smoother but later.
σ window: 100 bars. Floor: 1.0·σ (0.5 gives near-identical results).
Finishing EMA: 3 (EMA 2 has the same lift but about 23 entries/yr instead of 16–17).
±45 gives 12–13.5 % zone time and 16–17 zone entries per year.
candidates.signals:
Confirmed bars only, constant lines ±45:
高値圏突入: stall crosses above +45 → 『上昇の勢いがピークから45%以上失速＝そろそろ天井（天井直後のことも多い）』.
高値圏離脱: stall crosses back below +45. Two possible causes, which the line's shape tells apart:
  - the speed turned negative (leg flipped): the line collapses toward 0 and then goes negative = 失速完了・反落
  - the rally re-accelerated: the line eases down while staying positive = 失速解消・上昇継続
安値圏突入: stall crosses below −45 → 『下落の勢いが鈍化＝そろそろ底』.
安値圏離脱: stall crosses back above −45.
Small labels at these four events only, one alertcondition each; about 16–17 entries/yr.
candidates.repaint: No repaint. Recursions (SuperSmoother, RMA, EMA) are causal, and the leg/peak state lives in var variables. Pine rolls var variables back to the last confirmed bar on every realtime tick, so the state is committed only at bar close; labels and alerts require barstate.isconfirmed. The leg split uses only the sign of the current smoothed speed — no pivots and no look-back redraw. Delay: 0 bars after the close of the crossing bar. (The concept itself peaks about 1 bar after the price extreme; see behaviour.)
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
Mean line around ≥15 % swing highs, t−6..t+3 (t = extreme bar):
- NAS3x: +1, +4, +4, +10, +12, +12, +15, +19, +11, −3
- SPX3x: +6, +8, +7, +13, +17, +20, +21, +26, +14, −3
So it climbs through the last ~6 bars of the leg and peaks about 1 bar after the extreme (median offset of the ±10-bar maximum −1..0; 46–54 % within ±2 bars).
Zone hits at ±45, zone active in t−5..t / t−5..t+2 (chance for t−5..t in brackets):
- NAS3x: tops 32/40 % (30), bottoms 32/40 % (14)
- SPX3x: tops 44/51 % (29), bottoms 45/51 % (15)
- GOOG1x: tops 44/52 % (26), bottoms 37/56 % (17)
AUC, NAS3x/SPX3x/GOOG1x:
- t−3..t: tops 0.57/0.64/0.66, bottoms 0.70/0.72/0.71
- t−1..t+2: tops 0.63/0.69/0.69, bottoms 0.78/0.79/0.81
Opposite-zone flips 4–11 %. Smoothness: 31–32 direction changes per 100 bars, the smoothest of the six candidates.
Strong trends (top/bottom zone %):
- NAS3x bull 2003: 15.6/2.8; 2013: 14.3/2.0; 2017: 10.4/0.8
- SPX3x bulls: 8–17/2–3
- 2008–09 bear: 3.7/5.6; 2000 crash: 2.9/2.4
It never pins, because speed has to fall from its own peak. Crashes rarely trigger the bottom side, because down-legs usually end in a V rather than a gradual slowdown.
candidates.failure_modes:
(1) Blow-off/V tops: price accelerates into the high, so the speed loss is about 0 until the first down day and the top zone is often entered 1–2 bars after the high. On NAS3x tops: 32 % within t−5..t vs 30 % chance, i.e. almost no lead.
(2) V bottoms in crashes: the down-leg rarely decelerates gradually, so the bottom side fires late or not at all (bear-period bottom-zone time only 2–6 %).
(3) Chop: frequent speed sign flips create short legs. The σ floor mutes most of them, but about 16–17 entries/yr remain.
(4) 高値圏離脱 has two meanings (leg flip vs re-acceleration) that the user must read from the line's shape.
(5) The leg reset makes the line drop quickly at the turn (softened by the 3-bar EMA). This is a deliberate 'the turn happened' cue, but less gentle than E2.
(6) σ needs about 300 bars to settle (RMA-100 seeded with 0).
candidates.python_replication:
r = np.r_[0.0, np.diff(np.log(c))]  # nz(log(close/close[1]))
def ss(x, P):
    a1 = math.exp(-math.sqrt(2)*math.pi/P); c2 = 2*a1*math.cos(math.sqrt(2)*math.pi/P); c3 = -a1*a1; c1 = 1 - c2 - c3
    y = np.array(x, float).copy()  # y[0] = x[0], y[1] = x[1]
    for t in range(2, len(x)): y[t] = c1*(x[t] + x[t-1])/2 + c2*y[t-1] + c3*y[t-2]
    return y
v = ss(r, 4)
sig = pd.Series(np.abs(v)).ewm(alpha=1/100, adjust=False).mean().to_numpy()
raw = np.zeros(len(v)); side = 0; pk = 0.0
for t in range(len(v)):
    s = 1 if v[t] > 0 else (-1 if v[t] < 0 else (side if side != 0 else 1))
    if s != side: side, pk = s, abs(v[t])
    else: pk = max(pk, abs(v[t]))
    den = max(pk, 1.0*sig[t]); raw[t] = side*(pk - abs(v[t]))/den if den > 0 else 0.0
stall = pd.Series(100*raw).ewm(span=3, adjust=False).mean().to_numpy()
Thresholds: fixed ±45; crossings as in E2-tsi-balance with constant lines.
Warm-up: score from bar 300 (σ is an RMA-100 seeded with |v[0]| = 0; 0.99^300 ≈ 5 %). No pivots and no look-ahead: the leg split uses only the sign of v[t].

candidates.name_ja: 加速度ヒストグラム
candidates.concept: MACDヒストグラム（＝MACDの変化率＝勢いの加速度）を対数価格で計算し、自分自身の二乗平均で標準化して tanh で ±100 に収めたもの。上昇の加速が極端（最後のひと伸び）＝高値圏、下落の加速が極端（投げ）＝安値圏。日足3倍ETFは天井・底に『加速して』到達することが多いので、線の山はちょうど転換足に来る。
candidates.element_purity: Measures the rate of change of an EMA-spread momentum (MACD minus its own EMA), i.e. acceleration. It uses no level of price vs a mean directly, and no volume, time, range or candle data. Caveat: being a band-pass of price, it partly overlaps E2 (corr 0.76–0.78 with E2-tsi-balance) and a short kairi (0.54–0.57 with (C−EMA20)/ATR). A trend-gated version reaches 0.85 with E2. It is the least pure-looking of the three E3 options.
candidates.raw_formula:
lc[t] = ln(close[t]).
m = EMA_6(lc) − EMA_15(lc); h = m − EMA_5(m).
rms = sqrt(EMA_100(h²)); z = h/rms; acc = 100·tanh(z/2).
All EMAs use α = 2/(n+1), seeded with the bar-0 value.
candidates.normalization:
z is h in units of its own 100-bar RMS, which is stationary across 1x/3x and across regimes. 100·tanh(z/2) maps z = ±1 → ±46, ±1.24 → ±55, ±2 → ±76; the result is bounded in (−100, 100).
Pine has no built-in tanh: f_tanh(x) = (e^(2x) − 1)/(e^(2x) + 1) with x clipped to ±20.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±55. Zone share: 21.1 % NAS3x (top 10.1 / bottom 11.0), 20.0 % SPX3x, 19.2 % GOOG1x, 19.3 % GOOG3x. About 16–18 entries/yr.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E3 加速度ヒストグラム', shorttitle='E3加速', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500)
fN   = input.int(6, '短期EMA', minval=2)
sN   = input.int(15, '長期EMA', minval=3)
gN   = input.int(5, 'シグナルEMA', minval=2)
T    = input.float(55.0, 'しきい値 ±', minval=10.0, maxval=95.0)
useF = input.bool(true, '逆側ラベル抑制(MACD符号)')
f_ema(float x, int n) =>
    float a = 2.0 / (n + 1)
    float s = 0.0
    s := na(s[1]) ? x : a * x + (1.0 - a) * s[1]
    s
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e = math.exp(2.0 * math.max(-20.0, math.min(20.0, x)))
    (e - 1.0) / (e + 1.0)
float lc  = math.log(close)
float m   = f_ema(lc, fN) - f_ema(lc, sN)
float h   = m - f_ema(m, gN)
float rms = math.sqrt(f_ema(h * h, 100))
float acc = rms > 0 ? 100.0 * f_tanh(h / rms / 2.0) : 0.0
bool cuT = ta.crossover(acc, T)
bool cdT = ta.crossunder(acc, T)
bool cdB = ta.crossunder(acc, -T)
bool cuB = ta.crossover(acc, -T)
bool ok  = barstate.isconfirmed
bool enterTop = cuT and ok and (not useF or m > 0)
bool enterBot = cdB and ok and (not useF or m < 0)
plot(acc, '加速度', acc >= 0 ? color.rgb(179, 38, 30) : color.rgb(27, 107, 58), 2)
hline(T, '高値圏ライン', color.rgb(179, 38, 30))
hline(-T, '安値圏ライン', color.rgb(27, 107, 58))
// labels/alerts as in E3-speed-retention using enterTop, cdT and ok, enterBot, cuB and ok
candidates.default_params:
6/15/5 rather than 5/13/4: equal AUC, fewer direction changes (36–38 vs 40–45 per 100 bars). The classic 12/26/9 peaks 4–8 bars late on 3x swings.
RMS window 100 (50–200 changes AUC by less than 0.01). tanh scale 2, so ±55 gives about 20 % zone time.
Label filter ON by default: 高値圏突入 only when m > 0, 安値圏突入 only when m < 0.
candidates.signals:
Confirmed bars only, constant lines ±55:
高値圏突入 = crossover(acc, 55), and (filter) m > 0
高値圏離脱 = crossunder(acc, 55)
安値圏突入 = crossunder(acc, −55), and (filter) m < 0
安値圏離脱 = crossover(acc, −55)
The filter removes most wrong-side LABELS, but the line itself still dips through the opposite line right after many reversals.
candidates.repaint: No repaint: causal EMAs, confirmed-bar signals, 0-bar delay.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
Best pre-extreme information of all E3 designs. AUC (t−3..t), NAS3x/SPX3x/GOOG1x: tops 0.665/0.697/0.654, bottoms 0.725/0.748/0.750.
Mean line at NAS3x highs, t−6..t+3: −3, +2, +7, +11, +14, +21, +37, +22, −3, −22 — a peak on the extreme bar, then a fast fall. Its own ±10-bar maximum often comes 2–4 bars before the extreme.
Hits in t−5..t (chance in brackets):
- NAS3x: tops 37 % (24), bottoms 64 % (31)
- SPX3x: tops 43 % (24), bottoms 65 % (27)
- GOOG1x: tops 30 % (24), bottoms 59 % (26)
BUT the reversal itself is a strong opposite acceleration: within 4 bars after an extreme the line enters the opposite zone after 26–44 % of highs and 33–45 % of lows.
Strong trends: bull years show 6–11 % 'bottom zone' on pullback accelerations; bears show 15–17 % bottom zone.
candidates.failure_modes:
(1) Opposite-zone flips (26–45 %): 安値圏突入 is printed 2–4 bars after a top unless labels are filtered, and the line still visually crosses.
(2) Corr 0.76–0.78 with E2-tsi-balance, so it looks like a faster E2; a trend-gated variant reaches 0.85 (a copy).
(3) Its band-pass character can resemble an E7 band-pass/cycle line (corr 0.52–0.62 with an Ehlers band-pass at 10–15 bars).
(4) RMS normalization inflates small moves after long quiet periods.

rms = np.sqrt(E(h*h, 100)); acc = np.where(rms > 0, 100*np.tanh(np.clip(h/rms/2.0, -20, 20)), 0.0)
Label filter (default on): 高値圏突入 requires m[t] > 0 and 安値圏突入 requires m[t] < 0; lines and exits are unfiltered. Fixed ±55.
Pine f_tanh, (e^(2x)−1)/(e^(2x)+1) with x clipped to ±20, equals np.tanh to about 1e-15. Score from bar 300.

candidates.name_ja: 減速確認（ゲート付き減速度）
candidates.concept: 教科書どおりの『動いている方向への減速』だけを取り出した線。SuperSmoother(10)で滑らかにした対数価格の速度vと加速度aのうち、速度と逆向きの加速度（＝減速）だけを残して標準化し、±100に収める。上昇中の減速＝プラス（高値圏）、下落中の減速＝マイナス（安値圏）、加速中は0。日足3倍では減速は転換の1〜2本後に最大になるので『転換確認』型。
candidates.element_purity: Pure deceleration: only accelerations opposite to the current velocity survive (−a when v·a < 0), scaled by their own RMS. The momentum level is used only as the sign/gate. It has the lowest correlation with every other line tested: 0.45–0.50 with E2-tsi-balance, 0.33–0.34 with the MACD-histogram, 0.40–0.45 with (C−EMA20)/ATR. It is the most visually distinct E3 option.
candidates.raw_formula:
s = SS_10(ln close), using the SuperSmoother of E3-speed-retention. For P = 10: a1 ≈ 0.64128, c1 ≈ 0.25320, c2 ≈ 1.15805, c3 ≈ −0.41124; y[0] = x[0], y[1] = x[1].
v[t] = s[t] − s[t−1] (v[0] = 0); a[t] = v[t] − v[t−1] (a[0] = 0).
σ = RMA_100(|v|); w = min(1, |v|/(0.3·σ)) (0 if σ = 0).
dec[t] = −a[t]·w[t] if v[t]·a[t] < 0, else 0.
rms = sqrt(EMA_100(dec²)); x = 100·tanh(dec/rms/1.5) (0 if rms = 0); line = EMA_2(x).
candidates.normalization: dec is expressed in units of its own 100-bar RMS, mapped with 100·tanh(z/1.5) (z = 1 → 56, z = 2 → 87), then smoothed with a 2-bar EMA; the result is bounded in (−100, 100). Positive = an up-move decelerating; negative = a down-move decelerating. The line is about 0 on roughly 60 % of bars (the accelerating phases).
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±50. Zone share: 16.5 % NAS3x (top 8.4 / bottom 8.1), 15.7 % SPX3x, 15.6 % GOOG1x, with 24–28 entries/yr. Raising the lines to ±60 gives about 10–11 % and about 19 entries/yr.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E3 減速確認', shorttitle='E3減速', overlay=false, precision=0, max_labels_count=500)
P    = input.int(10, '価格スムーザー期間', minval=4)
gate = input.float(0.3, 'ゲート(σ倍)', minval=0.05, step=0.05)
k    = input.float(1.5, 'tanh尺度', minval=0.5, step=0.1)
T    = input.float(50.0, 'しきい値 ±', minval=10.0, maxval=95.0)
// f_ema, f_rma, f_ss exactly as in E3-speed-retention; f_tanh as in E3-macd-accel
float sm  = f_ss(math.log(close), P)
float v   = nz(sm - sm[1])
float a   = nz(v - v[1])
float sig = f_rma(math.abs(v), 100)
float w   = sig > 0 ? math.min(1.0, math.abs(v) / (gate * sig)) : 0.0
float dec = v * a < 0 ? -a * w : 0.0
float rms = math.sqrt(f_ema(dec * dec, 100))
float gd  = f_ema(rms > 0 ? 100.0 * f_tanh(dec / rms / k) : 0.0, 2)
bool cuT = ta.crossover(gd, T)
bool cdT = ta.crossunder(gd, T)
bool cdB = ta.crossunder(gd, -T)
bool cuB = ta.crossover(gd, -T)
bool ok  = barstate.isconfirmed
plot(gd, '減速度', gd >= 0 ? color.rgb(179, 38, 30) : color.rgb(27, 107, 58), 2)
hline(T, '高値圏ライン', color.rgb(179, 38, 30))
hline(-T, '安値圏ライン', color.rgb(27, 107, 58))
// labels/alerts as in E3-speed-retention with cuT/cdT/cdB/cuB and ok
candidates.default_params: SuperSmoother 10 (SS 6–8 is noisier, with more wrong-side flips). The soft gate at 0.3σ suppresses 'deceleration' of a near-zero velocity in chop. tanh scale 1.5. The 2-bar EMA halves jaggedness (58 → 29 direction changes per 100 bars). ±50 gives about 16 % zone time.
candidates.signals:
Confirmed bars only, constant lines ±50:
高値圏突入 = crossover(line, 50) → 『上昇の減速を確認（天井打ちの確認）』
高値圏離脱 = crossunder(line, 50)
安値圏突入 = crossunder(line, −50) → 『下落の減速を確認（底打ちの確認）』
安値圏離脱 = crossover(line, −50)
One label and one alertcondition per event.
candidates.repaint: No repaint: causal SuperSmoother/EMA/RMA and confirmed-bar signals. Inherent concept delay: the line peaks 1–2 bars AFTER the price extreme (it is a confirmation indicator); the 2-bar EMA adds about 0.5 bar.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
Confirmation-type, stated plainly.
Mean line at NAS3x highs, t−6..t+3: −3, −6, −1, −3, +2, +5, +3, +20, +30, +14 — the peak is at t+2 (SPX3x: t+1..t+2).
AUC, NAS3x/SPX3x/GOOG1x:
- t−3..t: tops 0.50/0.54/0.65, bottoms 0.64/0.65/0.66
- t+1..t+3: tops 0.70/0.70/0.76, bottoms 0.84/0.86/0.83 — the strongest 'the turn just happened' signal tested
Hits, zone active in t−5..t / t−5..t+2 (chance for t−5..t in brackets):
- NAS3x: tops 22/62 % (34), bottoms 41/88 % (35)
- SPX3x: tops 33/67 % (35), bottoms 46/87 % (30)
- GOOG1x: tops 41/74 % (34), bottoms 41/81 % (28)
Opposite-zone flips 0–7 %.
Strong trends: bull years 9–13 % top / 3–6 % bottom zone; bears 4–7 % / 7–12 %.

Because it is zero most of the time, it looks spiky even after smoothing. In grinding trends every pause registers as a deceleration (top zone on 9–13 % of bull-year bars).
