elements.recommendation_reason:
Recommend E3-speed-retention (失速率).
Key finding on daily 3x data: price usually ACCELERATES into swing extremes. A pure 'deceleration before the extreme' (the negative 2nd derivative of SuperSmoothed log price) scores AUC 0.33–0.45 at t−3..t, i.e. the opposite of what was expected, and the strongest deceleration arrives 1–2 bars after the turn. Consequences:
(a) Linear accelerometers peak on the extreme bar but then swing into the OPPOSITE zone within 4 bars after 26–78 % of extremes (MACD-histogram 26–45 %, 3-bar Δvelocity 53–78 %). That would print 安値圏突入 right after a top.
(b) Gating them by trend sign turns them into 0.85-correlated copies of E2.
(c) Gated deceleration (E3-decel-confirm) is clean and the most distinct from E2 (corr 0.45–0.50), but it is purely confirmation-type: AUC 0.70–0.86 for the 1–3 bars after the extreme, about chance before it.
Why 失速率: it is the only design that is all of the following:
- pure change-of-momentum
- direction-consistent (opposite-zone flips 4–11 %)
- the smoothest of the six candidates (31–32 direction changes per 100 bars)
- visibly different from E2: it stays near 0 while a move is still accelerating and ramps up only as speed decays (corr 0.62–0.66 with E2, 0.50–0.55 with a 20-EMA kairi, 0.50–0.54 with the MACD-histogram)
- still builds into the extreme: the mean line rises over the last ~6 bars and peaks about 1 bar after; AUC (t−1..t+2) tops 0.63–0.69, bottoms 0.78–0.81
Candid limits: before NASDAQ-3x tops it has almost no edge (32 % in zone vs 30 % chance — those tops are mostly blow-offs). It does better on SPX3x/GOOG tops (44 % vs 26–29 %) and on bottoms (32–45 % vs 14–17 %), and reaches 40–56 % when 2 confirmation bars are allowed.
Intended reading with E2: E2 says 『そろそろ』 (median 2 bars of lead); E3 says 『失速した＝転換が近い／始まった』.
Alternatives: if the orchestrator prefers a strictly confirming E3, use E3-decel-confirm. Do not use E3-macd-accel as the default, because of the opposite-zone flips and its similarity to E2.

candidates.name_ja: 出来高重心オシレーター（VCOG）
candidates.concept: 直近約10本で「どの価格帯に売買代金が集中したか」を測る。出来高加重の指数平均価格（EMA版VWAP）と出来高を使わない指数平均価格の差で、正なら直近の高い価格帯に大商いが集中（高値での飛びつき・分配＝天井型の出来高）、負なら安い価格帯に集中（投げ・底での集積）。高値圏ライン超え＝「高値帯に大商い＝天井警戒期間」、安値圏ライン割れ＝「安値帯に大商い＝底警戒期間」。
candidates.element_purity: 出来高が一定なら vwp=ewp で恒等的に0になり、線の動きはすべて出来高の価格帯配分から生じる（上げ日/下げ日の符号は一切使わない）。検証: 出来高を時系列シャッフルすると精度がランダム水準に落ちる（NDX3 天井/底 0.30/0.33→0.16-0.17/0.18-0.21、SPX3 0.20/0.32→0.11-0.15/0.10-0.12、GOOG 0.22/0.23→0.10-0.15/0.11-0.20）＝本当に出来高の情報で動いている。他要素の代理指標との相関: RSI14 0.29-0.38、EMA20乖離/ATR 0.29-0.43、加速(Δモメンタム) 0.04-0.18、MACDヒスト変化 0.06-0.26、TDカウント 0.18-0.32、VIXフィックス 0.13-0.26、E9各案 0.07-0.28。RSIとのゾーン重複(Jaccard) 0.15-0.19（参考: RSI14とEMA20乖離は0.61-0.75でほぼ同じ時期に点灯）。対照的に上げ下げ出来高比・MFI・OBV型やSVAは出来高を壊しても成績が変わらず（実体は価格の上げ下げ）、RSIと0.65-0.81相関でE2と似通うため不採用。
candidates.raw_formula: 確定足 t について: v_t = nz(volume_t)×close_t（金額出来高。入力で株数のみも可）、tp_t = (high_t+low_t+close_t)/3。vwp_t = EMA(v×tp,10)_t ÷ EMA(v,10)_t（EMA(v,10)=0 なら na）、ewp_t = EMA(tp,10)_t。EMA は Pine ta.ema（α=2/(n+1)、最初の n 本の単純平均で初期化）。ATR_t = ta.atr(14) = RMA(TR,14)（TR_0 = high−low、TR_t = max(H−L, |H−C_{t−1}|, |L−C_{t−1}|)、RMA は α=1/14・最初の14本SMAで初期化）。raw_t = (vwp_t − ewp_t) ÷ ATR_t。当日足と過去足のみ使用。
candidates.normalization: z_t = raw_t ÷ √SMA(raw²,252)_t（直近252本の二乗平均平方根で自己正規化。RMSが0・未定義なら na）。line_t = 100×tanh(z_t/1.5)（tanh は exp で自作: (e^{2x}−1)/(e^{2x}+1)、x を ±20 でクリップ）。raw/ATR の散らばりは銘柄で2.5倍違う（指数 sd 0.074、GOOG 0.187）ため固定スケールでは不可、自己正規化で銘柄差を吸収。
candidates.thresholds: 固定（既定）: 高値圏ライン +60、安値圏ライン −60（z≈±1.04に相当）。実測滞在率 NDX3 13%/7%、SPX3 8%/11%、GOOG 12%/5% → 合計16-20%。適応オプション: 上 = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(line[1],252,90)、下 = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(line[1],252,10)（合計約22-24%）。
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E4 出来高重心オシレーター VCOG', 'E4 VCOG', overlay = false, precision = 0, max_labels_count = 500)
len      = input.int(10, '期間(EMA)', minval = 2)
atrLen   = input.int(14, 'ATR期間', minval = 1)
normLen  = input.int(252, '正規化期間(RMS)', minval = 50)
k        = input.float(1.5, 'tanhスケール', minval = 0.1, step = 0.1)
useDV    = input.bool(true, '金額出来高(volume×close)')
upTh     = input.float(60.0, '高値圏ライン', minval = 0, maxval = 100)
dnTh     = input.float(-60.0, '安値圏ライン', minval = -100, maxval = 0)
adaptive = input.bool(false, '適応ライン(過去252本の90/10%点)')
cool     = input.int(3, '同種ラベルの最小間隔(本)', minval = 0)
showExit = input.bool(true, '離脱ラベル')
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e2 = math.exp(2.0 * math.max(math.min(x, 20.0), -20.0))
    (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0)
float v    = nz(volume) * (useDV ? close : 1.0)
float evh  = ta.ema(v * hlc3, len)
float ev   = ta.ema(v, len)
float vwp  = ev > 0 ? evh / ev : na          // 出来高加重のEMA価格
float ewp  = ta.ema(hlc3, len)                // 等加重のEMA価格
float raw  = (vwp - ewp) / ta.atr(atrLen)
float rms  = math.sqrt(ta.sma(raw * raw, normLen))
float line = na(rms) or rms == 0 ? na : 100.0 * f_tanh(raw / rms / k)
float pU   = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(line[1], 252, 90)
float pL   = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(line[1], 252, 10)
float U    = adaptive ? pU : upTh
float L    = adaptive ? pL : dnTh
plot(U, '高値圏ライン', color.red, 1)
plot(L, '安値圏ライン', color.green, 1)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 70), hline.style_dotted)
plot(line, 'VCOG', line >= U ? color.red : line <= L ? color.green : color.from_gradient(line, L, U, color.new(color.green, 50), color.new(color.red, 50)), 2)
bool topIn  = ta.crossover(line, U)
bool topOut = ta.crossunder(line, U)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, L)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(line, L)
var int lastT = na
var int lastB = na
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn and (na(lastT) or bar_index - lastT > cool)
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏突入', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.red, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
        lastT := bar_index
    if botIn and (na(lastB) or bar_index - lastB > cool)
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏突入', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.green, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
        lastB := bar_index
    if showExit and topOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.new(color.red, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if showExit and botOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.new(color.green, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
float cumV = ta.cum(nz(volume))
if barstate.islast and cumV == 0
    label.new(bar_index, 0, '出来高データなし', style = label.style_label_left, color = color.gray, textcolor = color.white)
alertcondition(topIn, '高値圏突入', 'VCOG 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(topOut, '高値圏離脱', 'VCOG 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(botIn, '安値圏突入', 'VCOG 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(botOut, '安値圏離脱', 'VCOG 安値圏離脱')
// 要確認(未検証のAPI詳細): ta.ema の初期化がSMA種か初値か(先頭~3×len本のみ影響), percentile_nearest_rank の na 扱い, TradingViewのETF出来高の分割調整
candidates.default_params: len=10（約2週間。価格帯ごとの出来高の偏りが出るのに十分で、8/10/14で成績はほぼ同じ＝頑健）、ATR=14、正規化252本（1年。TQQQ・SOXL・SPXLは2010年以前から履歴があり足りる）、tanhスケール1.5（zの上位/下位8%点≈±1.0〜1.4 → ±60付近）、金額出来高ON（3倍ETFは値下がりすると同じ売買代金でも株数が機械的に増えるため volume×close で歪みを除く）、ラベル間隔3本。
candidates.signals: 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, U)（line[1]≤U かつ line>U）を barstate.isconfirmed の足で確定。高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, U)。安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, L)。安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, L)。U/L は固定 ±60 または適応線。同種の突入ラベルは3本以上空けて表示。4種の alertcondition。
candidates.repaint: 非リペイント。当日と過去のOHLCVのみ使用し、request.security・将来参照・オフセット表示なし。リアルタイム足では価格・出来高が更新されるため線は引けまで動くが、シグナルとラベルは barstate.isconfirmed の足でのみ生成し、過去足は全て確定足なので再読込しても同一。確定遅れ0本。注意: データ配信側が引け後に当日出来高を修正すると最終足の値がわずかに変わり得る（計算上のリペイントではなくデータ修正）。
candidates.behavior_at_turns: 警戒期間型（極値当日を指すタイミング型ではない）。捕捉できた転換では高値圏突入が天井の中央値3本前(NDX3)/5本前(SPX3)/0本(GOOG)、安値圏突入は底の2本前。1回の滞在は平均3.6-4.4本、突入は年5-7回(高値側)/4-6回(安値側)と疎で、線はなめらか。15%スイング前後の平均線は平坦（NDX3天井付近 +18〜+26、SPX3底付近 −18〜−24）＝「転換が起きやすい出来高の地合い」を示す。固定±60での成績（窓[p−5,p+1]）: 捕捉率 天井/底 NDX3 0.40/0.24、SPX3 0.24/0.53、GOOG 0.44/0.37；精度（ゾーン終了後5本以内に同種転換） 0.35/0.32、0.18/0.32、0.26/0.29（平滑ランダム線の精度0.04-0.20、RSI14は天井0.17-0.40/底0.52-0.66）。強いトレンド: 参加者が増えながらの上昇で高値圏に張り付く（NDX 2003年は年の34%、2009年26%、SPX 2009年21%）。
candidates.failure_modes: (1) 出来高を伴う健全な上昇（大底からの回復相場）で偽の天井警戒が長く続く。(2) 平均プロファイルが平坦で、天井当日を指す力は弱い（ピンポイントは他要素の役割）。(3) 出来高のない指数（SPX等）では無効 → 出来高データなしを表示。(4) 決算・指数入替・SQ・ETFリバランスなど機械的な大商いで符号が振れる。(5) 過去の分割で出来高が未調整だと窓内約10本が歪む（TradingViewのETF出来高の分割調整は要確認）。(6) 検証は指数構成銘柄の出来高で行うため、TQQQ自身の出来高（レバETFの押し目買い・ヘッジ）では挙動が異なる可能性があり、実データで再確認が必要。
candidates.python_replication: 共通ヘルパー: pine_ema(x,n,alpha=None): a=2/(n+1)（alphaがあればそれ）; s=NaN; 各iで、sがNaNなら x[i−n+1..i] が全て有限になった最初のiで s=その単純平均、そうでなければ s=a*x[i]+(1−a)*s（x[i]がNaNならsもNaNになり、次に有限値がn本そろった所で再初期化＝Pineのna伝播）。pine_rma(x,n)=pine_ema(x,n,1/n)。pandasの ewm(adjust=False) は初値で初期化するので先頭だけ異なる（最初の300本を評価から除けば一致）。TR_0=H_0−L_0、TR_t=max(H_t−L_t,|H_t−C_{t−1}|,|L_t−C_{t−1}|)、ATR=pine_rma(TR,14)。本案: tp=(H+L+C)/3（3倍合成OHLCで計算）; raw=(pine_ema(v*tp,10)/pine_ema(v,10) − pine_ema(tp,10))/ATR; rms=np.sqrt(pd.Series(raw**2).rolling(252).mean())（窓内にNaNがあればNaN）; line=100*np.tanh(raw/rms/1.5)。3倍合成時の出来高: v=指数Volume×指数Close（原資産の金額出来高）。指数Volume×3倍合成Closeは価格水準バイアスを生む（NDXで天井捕捉0.26→0.40、底0.26→0.16に歪んだ）ので使わない。出来高0の日（NASDAQデータに2日）は重み0のまま補完しない。シグナル: topIn=(line>U)&(line.shift(1)<=U)、topOut=(line<U)&(line.shift(1)>=U)、botIn=(line<L)&(line.shift(1)>=L)、botOut=(line>L)&(line.shift(1)<=L)。適応線: line.shift(1) の直近252本を昇順ソートし index=ceil(p/100*252)−1 の値。本提案の数値の評価手順: 3倍合成 C3_t=C3_{t−1}(1+3(C_t/C_{t−1}−1))、X3_t=C3_{t−1}(1+3(X_t/C_{t−1}−1))（X=O,H,L）、初日除外; 正解=3倍終値の15%反転ZigZag（GOOGは1倍10%）、先頭300本除外; 捕捉=極値pの[p−5,p+1]でゾーン点灯; 確認捕捉=[p,p+3]; 精度=各ゾーン区間[s,e]について[s−1,e+5]に同種極値がある割合; ランダム基準=白色ノイズのEMA8を8%/92%分位で切った線。

candidates.name_ja: 出来高の偏り（上げ日 vs 下げ日、VSKEW）
candidates.concept: 直近約10本で、上げた日と下げた日のどちらに「日数の割合以上の」出来高が付いたかを測る。出来高加重の上げ下げバランスから日数ベースの上げ下げバランスを差し引くので、価格がどちらへ動いたか（モメンタム）は相殺され、出来高の偏りだけが残る。正＝上げ日の方が重い（買いクライマックス・飛びつき）→高値圏、負＝下げ日の方が重い（投げ売り）→安値圏。
candidates.element_purity: 出来高が一定なら恒等的に0。RSI14との相関は指数で0.06-0.14（GOOG 0.40）と、価格モメンタムから最も独立した出来高線。出来高シャッフルでNDX3の天井精度 0.34→0.17-0.18 に低下＝情報は出来高由来。VCOGとの相関0.20-0.31（VCOG=価格帯への出来高配分、本案=上げ日/下げ日への出来高配分という別の切り口）。
candidates.raw_formula: s_t = sign(close_t − close_{t−1})（変わらず0、初日0）、v_t = nz(volume_t)×close_t。raw_t = EMA(v×s,10)_t ÷ EMA(v,10)_t − EMA(s,10)_t（Pine ta.ema、最初の10本SMAで初期化）。EMA(v,10)=0 なら na。
candidates.normalization: VCOGと同じ: z_t = raw_t ÷ √SMA(raw²,252)_t、line_t = 100×tanh(z_t/1.5)。
candidates.thresholds: 固定 ±70（分布の裾が厚いため。実測滞在率 NDX3 9%/8%、SPX3 9%/8%、GOOG 12%/9% → 合計17-21%）。±60だと合計26-30%で多すぎる。適応: 252本の90/10%点（line[1]で計算）。
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E4b 出来高の偏り VSKEW', 'E4b VSKEW', overlay = false, precision = 0, max_labels_count = 500)
len     = input.int(10, '期間(EMA)', minval = 2)
normLen = input.int(252, '正規化期間(RMS)', minval = 50)
k       = input.float(1.5, 'tanhスケール', minval = 0.1, step = 0.1)
upTh    = input.float(70.0, '高値圏ライン')
dnTh    = input.float(-70.0, '安値圏ライン')
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e2 = math.exp(2.0 * math.max(math.min(x, 20.0), -20.0))
    (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0)
float v    = nz(volume) * close
float s    = nz(math.sign(close - close[1]))   // 上げ日+1 / 下げ日-1 / 変わらず0
float ev   = ta.ema(v, len)
float evs  = ta.ema(v * s, len)                 // 出来高加重の上げ下げバランス
float es   = ta.ema(s, len)                     // 日数ベースの上げ下げバランス
float raw  = ev > 0 ? evs / ev - es : na        // 差 = 出来高の偏りだけ
float rms  = math.sqrt(ta.sma(raw * raw, normLen))
float line = na(rms) or rms == 0 ? na : 100.0 * f_tanh(raw / rms / k)
hline(upTh, '高値圏ライン', color.red)
hline(dnTh, '安値圏ライン', color.green)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 70), hline.style_dotted)
plot(line, 'VSKEW', line >= upTh ? color.red : line <= dnTh ? color.green : color.gray, 2)
bool topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upTh)
bool topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upTh)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, dnTh)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(line, dnTh)
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏突入', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.red, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if botIn
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏突入', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.green, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if topOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.new(color.red, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if botOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.new(color.green, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn, '高値圏突入', 'VSKEW 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(topOut, '高値圏離脱', 'VSKEW 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(botIn, '安値圏突入', 'VSKEW 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(botOut, '安値圏離脱', 'VSKEW 安値圏離脱')
candidates.default_params: len=10（VCOGと同じ2週間窓）、正規化252本、tanhスケール1.5、ライン±70。窓を20にするとゾーンはさらに減るが成績は改善しない。
candidates.signals: 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +70)、高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +70)、安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −70)、安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −70)。いずれも barstate.isconfirmed の足でのみラベル化。
candidates.repaint: 非リペイント・確定遅れ0本（VCOGと同じ理由）。当日の騰落符号と当日出来高は引けで確定。データ配信側による出来高の事後修正のみ注意。
candidates.behavior_at_turns: 地合い型で、転換前後の平均線はほぼ平坦（NDX3天井付近 +15〜+23）。捕捉時の突入は極値の1-4本前、滞在約3本、±60で年10-13回/側。8%分位（≈±70）での成績: 捕捉率 天井/底 NDX3 0.37/0.23、SPX3 0.34/0.30、GOOG 0.30/0.30；精度 0.34/0.18、0.20/0.16、0.17/0.14（ランダム0.04-0.20）→ NDX系の天井側でのみ明確な上積みがあり、他はランダム近傍。強いトレンドでの張り付き: NDX 2001年に年の27%が高値圏、2014年に20%が安値圏。
candidates.failure_modes: (1) 全体に弱く、ランダムに近い局面が多い。(2) 小さな上げ下げ（±0.1%）にも符号が付くため、横ばい日の出来高に左右される。(3) 単発の大商い（決算・指数イベント）が約10本残る。(4) 個別株(GOOG)ではRSI相関が0.40まで上がり純度が落ちる。(5) 出来高のない銘柄では無効。
candidates.python_replication: s=np.sign(C−C.shift(1)).fillna(0); v=Volume×Close（検証は指数Volume×指数Close）; raw=pine_ema(v*s,10)/pine_ema(v,10) − pine_ema(s,10); rms=np.sqrt(pd.Series(raw**2).rolling(252).mean()); line=100*np.tanh(raw/rms/1.5)。pine_emaヘルパー・3倍合成・評価手順はVCOGと同じ。ゾーンは line>70 / line<−70。

candidates.name_ja: 出来高異常の方向（クライマックス/枯渇、SVA）
candidates.concept: グランビルの出来高法則を1本にした比較案。異常な大商い（クライマックス）も異常な薄商い（枯渇）も転換の前触れとみなし、その日が上げなら高値側、下げなら安値側に加点する。対数売買代金の50日Zスコアが±0.5σを超えた分だけを、その日の騰落の符号付きで5日EMAに積む。平均線が天井当日・底当日にピークを付けるピンポイント型のプロファイルを持つ。
candidates.element_purity: 概念は出来高だが純度は低い（非推奨の理由）。出来高を定数やシャッフルに置き換えても一致度が同等以上（NDX3 実データ 天井/底捕捉0.35/0.47・精度0.21/0.28 → 定数出来高 0.32/0.72・0.20/0.37）＝一致度は日々の上げ下げ符号（価格モメンタム）から来ている。RSI14相関0.34-0.49、E9終値位置プレッシャーと約0.4。同じ理由で、上げ日/下げ日出来高比（Volume RSI・OBV型）はRSI相関0.65-0.73・E9終値位置と0.65-0.72、MFIは0.76-0.81でいずれも不採用とした。ピンポイント型の出来高案が必要な場合の参考として残す。
candidates.raw_formula: v_t = nz(volume_t)×close_t；lv_t = ln(v_t)（v_t≤0の日は lv_{t−1} を持ち越す）；z_t = (lv_t − SMA(lv,50)_t) ÷ max(STDEV(lv,50)_t, 1e−10)（ta.stdev は母標準偏差、当日を含む50本）；e_t = sign(close_t − close_{t−1}) × max(|z_t| − 0.5, 0)（初日の符号は0）；raw_t = EMA(e,5)_t（ta.ema、SMA初期化）。
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E4c 出来高異常の方向 SVA', 'E4c SVA', overlay = false, precision = 0, max_labels_count = 500)
zLen  = input.int(50, '出来高Zの期間', minval = 10)
dead  = input.float(0.5, '不感帯(σ)', minval = 0, step = 0.1)
sm    = input.int(5, '平滑(EMA)', minval = 1)
scale = input.float(0.6, 'tanhスケール', minval = 0.1, step = 0.1)
upTh  = input.float(55.0, '高値圏ライン')
dnTh  = input.float(-55.0, '安値圏ライン')
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e2 = math.exp(2.0 * math.max(math.min(x, 20.0), -20.0))
    (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0)
float v = nz(volume) * close
var float lv = na
if v > 0
    lv := math.log(v)                        // 出来高0の日は前日値を持ち越し
float mu   = ta.sma(lv, zLen)
float sdv  = ta.stdev(lv, zLen)               // 母標準偏差(biased=true)
float z    = (lv - mu) / math.max(sdv, 1e-10)
float e    = nz(math.sign(close - close[1])) * math.max(math.abs(z) - dead, 0.0)
float line = 100.0 * f_tanh(ta.ema(e, sm) / scale)
hline(upTh, '高値圏ライン', color.red)
hline(dnTh, '安値圏ライン', color.green)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 70), hline.style_dotted)
plot(line, 'SVA', line >= upTh ? color.red : line <= dnTh ? color.green : color.gray, 2)
bool topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upTh)
bool topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upTh)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, dnTh)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(line, dnTh)
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏突入', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.red, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if botIn
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏突入', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.green, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if topOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.new(color.red, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if botOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.new(color.green, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn, '高値圏突入', 'SVA 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(topOut, '高値圏離脱', 'SVA 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(botIn, '安値圏突入', 'SVA 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(botOut, '安値圏離脱', 'SVA 安値圏離脱')
// 要確認: math.max(na, x) が na を返すこと(ウォームアップ中に z を na に保つため)
candidates.default_params: zLen=50（約2.5か月の出来高水準）、不感帯0.5σ（普通の日を0にして異常日だけ数える）、平滑EMA5、tanhスケール0.6、ライン±55。
candidates.signals: 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +55)、高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +55)、安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −55)、安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −55)。いずれも barstate.isconfirmed の足のみ。
candidates.repaint: 非リペイント・確定遅れ0本。リアルタイム足では途中出来高が少ないため z が大きく負に振れ（＝枯渇扱い）線が大きく動くので、必ず確定足のシグナルのみを使う。出来高の事後修正リスクはVCOGと同じ。
candidates.behavior_at_turns: 平均線は極値当日にピーク（NDX3天井: p−5 −4 → p−1 +16 → p +35 → p+1 +5 → p+2 −9；底: p −36 → p+1 −7）で翌日に崩れる。捕捉時の突入は極値の1-2本前（GOOG天井は4本前）。固定±55の成績: 捕捉率 天井/底 NDX3 0.41/0.50、SPX3 0.33/0.51、GOOG 0.48/0.56；精度 0.20/0.29、0.12/0.23、0.15/0.20（天井側はランダム並み）。年11-14回/側、平均2本滞在。トレンドでの張り付きは小さい（年最大21%）。
candidates.failure_modes: (1) 純度不足: E2（勢い）と同じ時期に点灯しやすい。(2) 異常日が1日でもEMAで約5本残る。(3) 決算・指数イベント・休場前後の出来高でダマシ。(4) 出来高水準の急変（新規上場・分割・構造変化）で z が歪む。(5) リアルタイム足の途中値は無意味。
candidates.python_replication: v=Volume×Close（検証は指数Volume×指数Close）; lv=np.log(v.where(v>0)).ffill(); z=(lv−lv.rolling(50).mean())/np.maximum(lv.rolling(50).std(ddof=0),1e−10); e=np.sign(C−C.shift(1)).fillna(0)*np.maximum(np.abs(z)−0.5,0); line=100*np.tanh(pine_ema(e,5)/0.6)。純度チェック: 同じ式で v を定数または np.random.permutation(v) にすると成績が変わらないことを再現できる。ヘルパー・評価手順はVCOGと同じ。

elements.recommendation_reason: VCOGを推奨する。(1) 出来高を時系列シャッフルすると精度がランダム水準まで落ちる唯一のタイプで、本当に出来高の情報で動いている。上げ下げ出来高比・MFI・OBV・SVAは出来高を壊しても成績が変わらず、実体は価格の上げ下げで、RSIと0.65-0.81相関でE2と似通う。(2) 他要素の代理指標とE9各案との相関がすべて0.43以下、RSIとのゾーン重複15-19%で最も独立。(3) 平均約4本の滞在・年5-8回の突入とラベルが疎で、線がなめらか。捕捉した転換では2-5本前に高値/安値圏へ入る。正直な限界: 極値当日を指すタイプではなく「転換が起きやすい出来高の地合い」を示す警戒期間型で、捕捉率は0.24-0.53と控えめ。参加者が増えながらの上昇相場（2003・2009年型）では偽の天井警戒が続く。出来高要素の役割は「価格系とは独立の裏付け」と割り切るのがよい。検証上の注意: 3倍合成では出来高に指数の金額出来高（指数Volume×指数Close）を使うこと。TQQQ自身の出来高でも実データで再確認が必要。

elements.element_ja: ローソク足の形（ヒゲ・終値の位置）

candidates.name_ja: 反転インパルス（引け位置の切り返し、REV）
candidates.concept: 「高値引けが続いた後に安値引けの足」＝大陰線・包み線・かぶせ線型の天井反転、「安値引けが続いた後に高値引けの足」＝大陽線・切り込み線型の底反転を1本の線にする。直前5本の値幅加重の引け位置（引け圧力P）と、当日足の逆方向の引け位置の積を3本EMAで平滑する。高値圏ラインを越えた足＝天井確認足、安値圏ラインを割った足＝底確認足。
candidates.element_purity: 各足の高値・安値・終値の位置関係（終値位置CLV）だけで計算し、前日比や移動平均との差は使わない。始値も使わないので、S&P500の1999-2006年（始値=前日終値が96%）のような始値欠陥データでも同じ値で、1倍と3倍でも同じ値になる（ローソク形状はレバレッジ合成で不変）。他要素の代理指標との相関: EMA20乖離0.27-0.30、RSI14 0.28-0.31、加速 −0.18〜−0.23、MACDヒスト変化 −0.24〜−0.33、TDカウント0.35-0.37、VIXフィックス0.30-0.34、終値位置プレッシャー(CLP)と約0.0 → 最も似通わない。RSIとのゾーン重複(Jaccard)0.04-0.09。正直な注記: 日足の終値位置は当日の騰落で約6割説明できる（R² 0.56-0.67）。当日騰落から予測したCLVで作っても同成績（相関0.70-0.77）なので、情報源は「反転日の値動き」をローソク構造で読んだもの。日足スイング規模では、ローソク固有の情報（騰落で説明できない残差）だけでは転換の時期をほぼ当てられなかった。だからこそ水準型オシレーターと形の全く違う「反転イベント型」を選んだ。
candidates.raw_formula: rng_t = high_t − low_t；clv_t = (2·close_t − high_t − low_t) ÷ rng_t（rng=0なら0、範囲−1..+1）；P_t = EMA(2·close−high−low, 5)_t ÷ EMA(high−low, 5)_t（値幅加重の終値位置、Pine ta.ema・SMA初期化、分母0ならna）；r_t = max(P_{t−1},0)·max(−clv_t,0) − max(−P_{t−1},0)·max(clv_t,0)（P_{t−1}がnaならna）；raw_t = EMA(r,3)_t。Pは前日までの値（t−1）を使い、当日足と重ならない。
candidates.normalization: line_t = 100×tanh(raw_t/0.25)（raw の上位/下位8%点 ≈ ±0.12 → ±45付近）。
candidates.thresholds: 固定 ±45（実測滞在率 NDX3 8%/8%、SPX3 8%/7%、GOOG 5%/5% → 合計10-16%）。適応: 上 = ta.percentile_nearest_rank(line[1],252,90)、下 = 同10（合計20%で捕捉率は上がる: NDX3 0.51/0.75、SPX3 0.69/0.83、GOOG 0.70/0.89、精度はほぼ同じ）。
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E9 反転インパルス REV', 'E9 REV', overlay = false, precision = 0, max_labels_count = 500)
pLen     = input.int(5, '直前の引け圧力の期間(EMA)', minval = 2)
sm       = input.int(3, '平滑(EMA)', minval = 1)
scale    = input.float(0.25, 'tanhスケール', minval = 0.05, step = 0.05)
upTh     = input.float(45.0, '高値圏ライン')
dnTh     = input.float(-45.0, '安値圏ライン')
cool     = input.int(5, '同側の突入ラベル最小間隔(本)', minval = 0)
showExit = input.bool(false, '離脱ラベル')
f_tanh(float x) =>
    float e2 = math.exp(2.0 * math.max(math.min(x, 20.0), -20.0))
    (e2 - 1.0) / (e2 + 1.0)
float rng  = high - low
float clv  = rng > 0 ? (2 * close - high - low) / rng : 0.0   // 当日足の終値位置 -1..+1
float pNum = ta.ema(2 * close - high - low, pLen)
float pDen = ta.ema(rng, pLen)
float P    = pDen > 0 ? pNum / pDen : na                      // 値幅加重の引け圧力
float Pp   = P[1]                                             // 前日までの圧力
float r    = na(Pp) ? na : math.max(Pp, 0.0) * math.max(-clv, 0.0) - math.max(-Pp, 0.0) * math.max(clv, 0.0)
float line = 100.0 * f_tanh(ta.ema(r, sm) / scale)
hline(upTh, '高値圏ライン', color.red)
hline(dnTh, '安値圏ライン', color.green)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 70), hline.style_dotted)
plot(line, 'REV', line >= upTh ? color.red : line <= dnTh ? color.green : color.new(color.gray, 30), 2, plot.style_area)
bool topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upTh)
bool topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upTh)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, dnTh)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(line, dnTh)
var int lastT = na
var int lastB = na
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn and (na(lastT) or bar_index - lastT > cool)
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏突入(天井確認)', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.red, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
        lastT := bar_index
    if botIn and (na(lastB) or bar_index - lastB > cool)
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏突入(底確認)', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.green, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
        lastB := bar_index
    if showExit and topOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.new(color.red, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if showExit and botOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.new(color.green, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn, '高値圏突入', 'REV 高値圏突入(天井確認)')
alertcondition(topOut, '高値圏離脱', 'REV 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(botIn, '安値圏突入', 'REV 安値圏突入(底確認)')
alertcondition(botOut, '安値圏離脱', 'REV 安値圏離脱')
// 要確認: ta.ema の初期化(先頭数本のみ影響)
candidates.default_params: pLen=5（直前1週間の引け圧力。8にすると天井捕捉が下がる）、平滑EMA3（5にすると滞在1.6-1.8本でなめらかになるが、天井捕捉が0.47→0.39に下がる）、tanhスケール0.25、ライン±45、突入ラベルは間隔5本、離脱ラベルは既定OFF（パルス型のため）。ローソク形状はレバレッジ合成で不変なので、QQQで調整した値をTQQQにそのまま使える。
candidates.signals: 高値圏突入（天井確認）= ta.crossover(line, +45) を barstate.isconfirmed の足で確定。高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +45)（通常1-2本後に自動で起きるので既定はアラートのみ）。安値圏突入（底確認）= ta.crossunder(line, −45)。安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −45)。同側の突入ラベルは5本以内に再表示しない。
candidates.repaint: 非リペイント・確定遅れ0本（当日足の引けで確定）。ただし設計上「確認型」で、極値の翌足で反応する（極値から+1本）。前日までの引け圧力 P[1] と当日足だけを使い、将来参照はない。リアルタイム足では当日の引け位置が動くので線は揺れるが、シグナルは barstate.isconfirmed の足のみ。
candidates.behavior_at_turns: 確認型のパルス。15%スイング前後の平均線: 天井では p−5..p が ≈0（−7〜+10）→ p+1 +30〜+39 → p+2 +20〜+29 → p+3 +7〜+10、底は鏡像（p+1 で −38〜−47）。捕捉できた転換での突入は中央値で極値の1本後。固定±45の成績: 捕捉率 天井/底 NDX3 0.48/0.69、SPX3 0.61/0.76、GOOG 0.48/0.56；確認窓[p,p+3] 0.52/0.64、0.60/0.69、0.41/0.41（3案中最良）；精度 0.20/0.34、0.19/0.28、0.21/0.23。突入は年15-17回/側（GOOG 10回）、平均1.3本滞在。トレンド中は反転足が出ない限り0付近で張り付かない（年最大: 高値圏13%、安値圏17%）。
candidates.failure_modes: (1) 事前警告はほぼ出ない（「そろそろ」は他要素で担う）。(2) パルス状（平均1.3本滞在）なので、そのままではラベルが多い → 突入ラベルのみ・5本間隔を既定にした。(3) レンジ相場の往復でダマシ。(4) 決定的な反転足を作らない丸天井・だらだら下げの底は見逃す。(5) 強い上昇中の一時的な安値引け（1本で戻す押し目）でも点灯し、トレンド継続中のダマシになる。(6) 寄り付きの窓で反転するケースは終値位置に一部しか反映されない。
candidates.python_replication: rng=H−L; clv=np.where(rng>0,(2*C−H−L)/rng,0.0); P=pine_ema(2*C−H−L,5)/pine_ema(rng,5); P1=P.shift(1); r=np.where(P1.isna(),np.nan,np.maximum(P1,0)*np.maximum(−clv,0) − np.maximum(−P1,0)*np.maximum(clv,0)); line=100*np.tanh(pine_ema(r,3)/0.25)。pine_ema はSMA初期化の自作ループ（VCOG参照）で、先頭300本は評価から除外。ローソク形状は3倍合成（各足のOHLCが前日終値基準の正の一次変換）で不変なので、1倍の指数で計算しても同じ値になる（分位点で確認済み）。始値は使わないので、SPXの始値欠陥（1999-2006年は始値=前日終値）の影響を受けない。評価手順はVCOGと同じ（3倍終値の15%反転ZigZag、捕捉窓[p−5,p+1]、確認窓[p,p+3]）。

candidates.name_ja: 終値位置プレッシャー（CLP）
candidates.concept: 直近4本のローソクで、終値が足の高値寄りか安値寄りかを値幅加重で平均する。高値引けが続く＝買い圧力が天井に向けて高まる、安値引けが続く＝売り圧力が底に向けて高まる。平均線は極値当日にピークを付けて翌日に崩れるので、高値圏離脱がほぼ反転当日の合図になる（先行型）。
candidates.element_purity: 入力は足内の終値位置のみ（前日比なし、始値不使用）。しかし市場の性質上、価格モメンタム系と似通う: EMA20乖離0.58-0.74、RSI14 0.52-0.68、TDカウント0.56-0.66、加速0.40-0.48、RSIとのゾーン重複0.20-0.26。当日騰落から予測したCLVで作っても同成績（相関0.79-0.86）＝実質は足単位のモメンタム。上げ下げ出来高比(E4代替)とも0.65-0.72相関。
candidates.raw_formula: num_t = EMA(2·close−high−low, 4)_t、den_t = EMA(high−low, 4)_t（Pine ta.ema、SMA初期化）、clp_t = num_t ÷ den_t（den=0なら0、未定義ならna、範囲−1..+1）；line_t = 100·EMA(clp,2)_t。
candidates.normalization: line = 100×EMA(clp,2)（もともと−1..+1の比率なので非線形変換は不要）。
candidates.thresholds: 非対称の固定値 +50/−40（株価指数は上昇トレンドで高値引けが多く、平均CLVが+0.08あるため）。実測滞在率 NDX3 10%/7%、SPX3 9%/7%、GOOG 4%/7% → 合計11-17%。適応: 252本の90/10%点（合計21%、捕捉率 NDX3 0.49/0.72、SPX3 0.59/0.74、GOOG 0.67/0.78）。
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E9b 終値位置プレッシャー CLP', 'E9b CLP', overlay = false, precision = 0, max_labels_count = 500)
len  = input.int(4, '終値位置の期間(EMA)', minval = 2)
sm   = input.int(2, '平滑(EMA)', minval = 1)
upTh = input.float(50.0, '高値圏ライン')
dnTh = input.float(-40.0, '安値圏ライン')
float num  = ta.ema(2 * close - high - low, len)   // (終値−足の中心)×2 の指数平均
float den  = ta.ema(high - low, len)               // 値幅の指数平均
float clp  = na(den) ? na : den > 0 ? num / den : 0.0
float line = 100.0 * ta.ema(clp, sm)
hline(upTh, '高値圏ライン', color.red)
hline(dnTh, '安値圏ライン', color.green)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 70), hline.style_dotted)
plot(line, 'CLP', line >= upTh ? color.red : line <= dnTh ? color.green : color.gray, 2)
bool topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upTh)
bool topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upTh)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, dnTh)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(line, dnTh)
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏突入', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.red, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if botIn
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏突入', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.green, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if topOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.new(color.red, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if botOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.new(color.green, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn, '高値圏突入', 'CLP 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(topOut, '高値圏離脱', 'CLP 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(botIn, '安値圏突入', 'CLP 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(botOut, '安値圏離脱', 'CLP 安値圏離脱')
candidates.default_params: len=4（3なら最も純度が高いが出入りが増え、8ならなめらかだがRSI相関0.75に上がる）、平滑EMA2、ライン+50/−40。3倍と1倍で同値なので、QQQで決めた値をTQQQにそのまま使える。
candidates.signals: 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +50)、高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +50)（多くは天井の翌足）、安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −40)、安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −40)（多くは底の翌足）。いずれも barstate.isconfirmed の足のみ。
candidates.repaint: 非リペイント・確定遅れ0本。当日足のH/L/Cと過去足のみ使用。リアルタイム足では引け位置が動くので線が揺れるが、シグナルは確定足のみ。
candidates.behavior_at_turns: 先行・ピーク一致型。平均線: NDX3天井 p−5 +4 → p−2 +16 → p−1 +23 → p +34 → p+1 +13 → p+2 −6、SPX3天井 p で +39、底 p で −33〜−34 → p+1 で −8〜−13。捕捉時の突入は極値の1-2本前、離脱はほぼ翌足。固定+50/−40の成績: 捕捉率 天井/底 NDX3 0.40/0.63、SPX3 0.46/0.60、GOOG 0.37/0.74；精度 0.22/0.42、0.17/0.27、0.29/0.38。年10回/側（GOOG 5-8回）、平均2本滞在。一本調子の上昇では早めに高値圏へ入る（2017年は年の18%）。
candidates.failure_modes: (1) E1/E2/E8と同じ時期に点灯しやすく、10案の中で似通う（最大の欠点）。(2) 強い上昇トレンドで高値引けが続くと高値圏突入が早すぎる。(3) 平均2本で出入りしやすい。(4) 個別株(GOOG)では分布が狭く、高値圏に届きにくい。(5) 寄り付きの窓（ギャップ）は終値位置に反映されない。
candidates.python_replication: num=pine_ema(2*C−H−L,4); den=pine_ema(H−L,4); clp=np.where(np.isnan(den),np.nan,np.where(den>0,num/den,0.0)); line=100*pine_ema(clp,2)。3倍合成でも1倍でも同値。ヘルパー・評価手順はVCOG/REVと同じ。ゾーンは line>50 / line<−40。

candidates.name_ja: 高値・安値更新の押し戻し（FER）
candidates.concept: 前日の高値を上抜いた足で、終値がどれだけ押し戻されたか（上ヒゲ＋陰線部分＝高値の拒否）、前日の安値を割った足でどれだけ戻したか（下ヒゲ＝安値の拒否）を値幅加重で5本平均する。高値更新が売り返されるほど高値圏、安値更新が買い戻されるほど安値圏。
candidates.element_purity: 高値・安値・終値と前日高安だけを使う（始値不使用、ヒゲ/拒否という形の要素）。他要素の代理指標との相関は最大0.39（RSI14 0.21-0.33、EMA20乖離0.23-0.36、TD 0.25-0.39）で似通いにくい。ただし情報量は少なくノイズが多い。
candidates.raw_formula: up_t = high_t − close_t（high_t > high_{t−1} のとき、それ以外0）；dn_t = close_t − low_t（low_t < low_{t−1} のとき、それ以外0）；raw_t = EMA(up−dn, 5)_t ÷ EMA(high−low, 5)_t（Pine ta.ema、SMA初期化、分母0ならna、範囲−1..+1）。初日は前日値がないので up=dn=0。
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E9c 高値安値更新の押し戻し FER', 'E9c FER', overlay = false, precision = 0, max_labels_count = 500)
len  = input.int(5, '期間(EMA)', minval = 2)
upTh = input.float(50.0, '高値圏ライン')
dnTh = input.float(-50.0, '安値圏ライン')
float upRej = not na(high[1]) and high > high[1] ? high - close : 0.0   // 前日高値を上抜いたのに押し戻された幅
float dnRej = not na(low[1]) and low < low[1] ? close - low : 0.0       // 前日安値を割ったのに戻した幅
float num   = ta.ema(upRej - dnRej, len)
float den   = ta.ema(high - low, len)
float line  = den > 0 ? math.max(math.min(200.0 * num / den, 100.0), -100.0) : na
hline(upTh, '高値圏ライン', color.red)
hline(dnTh, '安値圏ライン', color.green)
hline(0, '0', color.new(color.gray, 70), hline.style_dotted)
plot(line, 'FER', line >= upTh ? color.red : line <= dnTh ? color.green : color.gray, 2)
bool topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upTh)
bool topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upTh)
bool botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, dnTh)
bool botOut = ta.crossover(line, dnTh)
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if topIn
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏突入', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.red, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if botIn
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏突入', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.green, textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if topOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '高値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_up, color = color.new(color.red, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
    if botOut
        label.new(bar_index, line, '安値圏離脱', style = label.style_label_down, color = color.new(color.green, 70), textcolor = color.white, size = size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn, '高値圏突入', 'FER 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(topOut, '高値圏離脱', 'FER 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(botIn, '安値圏突入', 'FER 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(botOut, '安値圏離脱', 'FER 安値圏離脱')
candidates.default_params: len=5（8にすると出入りは減るが天井捕捉が0.38→0.31に下がる）、倍率200とクリップ±100、ライン±50。
candidates.signals: 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +50)、高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +50)、安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −50)、安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −50)。いずれも barstate.isconfirmed の足のみ。
candidates.repaint: 非リペイント・確定遅れ0本。当日足と前日の高安のみ使用し、将来参照なし。リアルタイム足ではその日の高値更新や引け位置が変わるので、シグナルは確定足のみ。
candidates.behavior_at_turns: 捕捉率は高めだがダマシも多い。固定±50の成績: 捕捉率 天井/底 NDX3 0.44/0.73、SPX3 0.30/0.67、GOOG 0.59/0.81；精度 0.17/0.23、0.11/0.17、0.12/0.20（天井側はランダム並み）。突入は極値の0-1本前、年14-22回/側、平均1.5本滞在。平均プロファイルは天井側で弱く（p+1 で +6〜+17）、底側は p+1 で −21〜−36 の確認寄り。トレンドでの張り付きは年最大19%。
candidates.failure_modes: (1) ダマシが多い: 下落トレンドでは安値割れからの戻しが頻発して安値圏に入りやすく、上昇トレンドでは上ヒゲが日常的に出る。(2) 前日高値を窓で上抜けた日は押し戻し幅が過大評価される。(3) パルスが多くラベルが増える。(4) 3倍合成では H>H[1] の比較が足をまたぐため、1倍と厳密には一致しない（差は小）。
candidates.python_replication: up=np.where(H>H.shift(1),H−C,0.0); dn=np.where(L<L.shift(1),C−L,0.0)（NaNとの比較はFalse→0）; line=np.clip(200*pine_ema(up−dn,5)/pine_ema(H−L,5),−100,100)。ヘルパー・評価手順はVCOGと同じ。ゾーンは line>50 / line<−50。

elements.recommendation_reason: 反転インパルス(REV)を推奨する。(1) 「10案が似通わない」という最優先条件で最も優れる。乖離・RSI・加速・TDカウント・VIXフィックスの代理指標との相関が最大0.37、RSIとのゾーン重複は4-9%。終値位置プレッシャー(CLP)は乖離0.58-0.74・RSI0.52-0.68・TD0.56-0.66で価格系と似通う。参考: RSI14とEMA20乖離はゾーン重複61-75%で、E1とE2の最終案同士が似通う危険が大きい点にも注意。(2) 高値・安値・終値だけで計算し始値を使わないので、始値欠陥データでも1倍/3倍でも同一値で、トレンドに張り付かない（年最大13%）。(3) 確認窓[p,p+3]の捕捉率0.41-0.60/0.41-0.69が3案中最良で、精度もCLPと同等。正直な制約: 天井・底の翌足で反応する確認型（+1本）で、事前の「そろそろ」表示は出ない。パルス状なので、突入ラベルのみ・5本間隔を既定にした。また日足スイング規模では、ローソク固有の情報（当日騰落で説明できない部分）だけでは転換時期をほぼ当てられず、どのローソク案も実質は足単位の値動きを読んでいる。先行性を最優先するなら、最終的なE1/E2/E8の線との相関が0.6未満であることを確認した上で、CLP（極値当日にピーク、1-2本前に突入）を代替にできる。

candidates.name_ja: 日柄カウンター（経過日数パーセンタイル）
candidates.concept: A pure clock. It counts the bars since the last confirmed swing pivot and expresses that age as a smoothed percentile of the recent same-direction swing durations. The line climbs steadily while a swing ages (+ during up-swings, − during down-swings) and resets when the swing detector confirms the reversal. The idea is that once the swing is older than most recent swings in the same direction, a turn is due in time terms (日柄的にそろそろ).
candidates.element_purity: The magnitude comes only from bar counts: the age t−pB against past leg durations. Price enters only through the shared detector's bookkeeping (which bar is the pivot, which leg we are in). No price distance, rate, moving average, volatility or volume affects the value. It differs from E8 (run-length of consecutive closes) and from E7 (no periodicity or phase estimation). The legs are θ-confirmed swings and the yardstick is this symbol's own swing-duration distribution.
candidates.raw_formula: Shared detector SD: exactly as defined in E5-extreme-age-maturity (log close, 50-bar Wilder log-ATR, θ=2.0·atrL, 8-leg buffers per direction). Per bar, with s=dir, age=t−pB and D_s = buffer of the last ≤8 completed durations in direction s: raw_t = 100·s·KC(age; D_s; ρ=0.15, c=1.0), where KC(v;a_1..a_m;ρ,c) = (1/m)Σ_j 1/(1+exp(−clamp((v−a_j)/(ρ·a_j+c),−50,50))). raw=na if dir=0 or size(D_s)<3. No fade, no smoothing (smLen=1).
candidates.normalization: KC is in (0,1), so the line is already bounded in (−100,+100). 0 means neutral (a leg just confirmed). +85 means the current up-swing is older than about 85% of the last 8 up-swings, after kernel smoothing. No clamp is needed.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed: 高値圏ライン +85 (red), 安値圏ライン −85 (green). Measured share of bars beyond ±85: 21% on 3x NASDAQ, 21% on 3x S&P, 25% on GOOG. Use ±88 for about 17–20%.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
// [SD block + f_kcdf + common plot/signal block: identical to E5-extreme-age-maturity]
hiTh = input.float(85, '高値圏ライン')
loTh = input.float(-85, '安値圏ライン')
float raw = na
if sw.dir != 0
    array<float> Ds = sw.dir == 1 ? sw.dU : sw.dD
    if Ds.size() >= Kmin
        raw := 100.0 * sw.dir * f_kcdf(bar_index - sw.pB, Ds, 0.15, 1.0)
float osc = raw   // smLen = 1
// plot(osc) + hline(hiTh/0/loTh) + crossings exactly as in E5-extreme-age-maturity
candidates.default_params: SD: k=2.0, nAtr=50, K=8, Kmin=3. On 3x indices this gives about 18 legs per year, median θ ≈ 9.3% on 3x NASDAQ, and median leg duration 10 bars (up) / 8 bars (down). Kernel ρ=0.15 with +1 bar avoids a staircase CDF. Thresholds ±85: anything lower puts more than 25% of bars in a zone, because the clock keeps rising until confirmation.
candidates.signals: Evaluated at bar close (barstate.isconfirmed). 高値圏突入: osc_t ≥ +85 and not(osc_{t−1} ≥ +85). 高値圏離脱: osc_{t−1} ≥ +85 and not(osc_t ≥ +85). In practice the exit almost always happens at the reversal confirmation. 安値圏突入: osc_t ≤ −85 and not(osc_{t−1} ≤ −85). 安値圏離脱: osc_{t−1} ≤ −85 and not(osc_t ≤ −85). na compares as false.
candidates.repaint: No repaint. Every quantity at bar t uses data ≤ t, and no pivot is drawn back in time. CONFIRMATION-TYPE PEAK: the clock keeps rising after the real extreme until the reversal is confirmed. Median peak lag vs the hindsight swing extreme was +3 to +4 bars for tops and +1 to +3 for bottoms. On the forming bar the value can change intrabar; labels and alerts fire only at close.
candidates.behavior_at_turns: Sawtooth. It ramps up almost linearly in time, then drops about 100 points at each confirmation, because the new leg starts at −KC(confirmation delay). The zone means 'time window reached or already passed'. In my check at ±85, raw: tops caught 0.15/0.21/0.28 and bottoms 0.22/0.25/0.19 (3x NASDAQ / 3x S&P / GOOG). That is below the RSI14 baseline at the same share of bars in zone (tops 0.24/0.29/0.49). There are only about 1.5–2 zone entries per year. In strong trends it sits in the zone for the whole late part of long legs. Roughness is 7–9 points/bar, about as smooth as RSI14.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) Time alone does not anticipate the extreme. P(extreme within the next 0–5 bars) was flat at about 0.2 across age ratios 0–3. What age does predict is that the extreme has already passed: P(past) rose from 3% to about 38%. So most zone time is after the top. (2) Short V-turns never reach the zone. (3) Big reset jumps at confirmation. (4) Durations from calm periods mis-scale fast markets for about 8 legs. (5) Warm-up needs 3 completed legs per direction (about 100–140 daily bars).
candidates.python_replication: Use the SD loop from E5-extreme-age-maturity. Inside the loop, when d≠0 and len(D[d])≥3: raw[t] = 100*d*kc(t-pB, D[d], 0.15, 1.0), with kc(v,a,rho,c0) = mean(1/(1+exp(clip(-(v-a)/(rho*a+c0), -50, 50)))). No smoothing. Signals: inHi = nan_to_num(raw, nan=-inf) >= 85; hiIn = inHi & ~r_[False, inHi[:-1]]; hiOut = ~inHi & r_[False, inHi[:-1]]. Same for inLo = nan_to_num(raw, nan=+inf) <= -85.

candidates.name_ja: 日柄成熟度（高値更新日柄×停滞減衰）
candidates.concept: It measures how mature the current swing is in time. Maturity is the age the swing had when it made its latest new extreme, expressed as a smoothed percentile of recent same-direction swing durations. It is then faded by how many bars have passed without a new extreme. The line rises gradually while an old swing keeps printing new highs or lows, peaks on the bar of the last new extreme, and decays when time passes with no new extreme. It crosses 高値圏ライン when the up-swing is older than about 70% of recent up-swings and is still making highs.
candidates.element_purity: The value is built only from bar counts: ae = eB−pB (bars from the pivot to the latest extreme), sb = t−eB (bars since that extreme), and the past leg durations. Price only decides which bars are pivots or new extremes (shared detector). No price distance, slope, average, volatility or volume enters the magnitude. That keeps it separate from E6 (amplitude), E2 and E3 (rates), E8 (consecutive-close runs) and E7 (spectral phase).
candidates.raw_formula:
SD, the shared causal swing detector (close-based, log space):
1. x_t = ln(close_t).
2. trL_t = lnH−lnL on the first bar; otherwise max(lnH_t−lnL_t, |lnH_t−x_{t−1}|, |lnL_t−x_{t−1}|).
3. atrL = Wilder RMA(trL, 50) seeded with the SMA of the first 50 values (first defined at bar 49); then atrL_t = atrL_{t−1} + (trL_t−atrL_{t−1})/50.
4. θ_t = 2.0·atrL_t.
5. State, from the first bar with θ defined: dir ∈ {0,+1,−1}, where +1 = up-leg (last confirmed pivot is a LOW); pivot (pX,pB); running extreme (eX,eB); counter-extreme since eB (cX,cB).
6. Init (dir=0): track the running max hX/hB with the min since it (hcX/hcB), and the running min lX/lB with the max since it (lcX/lcB). A new max or min resets its counter to the same bar. If hX−x_t ≥ θ_t: dir=−1, (pX,pB)=(hX,hB), (eX,eB)=(hcX,hcB). Else if x_t−lX ≥ θ_t: dir=+1, (pX,pB)=(lX,lB), (eX,eB)=(lcX,lcB). Then (cX,cB) = earliest max (dir=−1) or min (dir=+1) of x over [eB,t]. No leg is recorded.
7. Running (dir=d): if d(x_t−eX) > 0, set (eX,eB,cX,cB) = (x_t,t,x_t,t); else if d(x_t−cX) < 0, set (cX,cB) = (x_t,t).
8. Reversal: if d(eX−x_t) ≥ θ_t, append dur=eB−pB and amp=|eX−pX| to the direction-d buffers (keep the last 8, drop the oldest), lastAmp=amp. Then (pX,pB)=(eX,eB), (eX,eB)=(cX,cB), (cX,cB) = earliest max (d=+1) or min (d=−1) of x over [max(eB,t−999),t], dir=−d.
9. All comparisons are strict, so ties keep the earliest bar.

This line: s=dir, ae=eB−pB, sb=t−eB, D_s = last ≤8 same-direction durations.
raw_t = 100·s·KC(ae; D_s; 0.15, 1.0)·exp(−(sb/τ)²), with τ=4, where KC(v;a;ρ,c) = (1/m)Σ 1/(1+exp(−clamp((v−a_j)/(ρa_j+c),−50,50))).
raw = na if dir=0 or size(D_s)<3. osc = WMA(raw, smLen), default smLen=1, i.e. osc=raw.
candidates.normalization: KC ∈ (0,1) is a percentile. The fade exp(−(sb/4)²) ∈ (0,1], then sign and ×100, so osc is in (−100,+100) with no clamp. 0 = neutral (a stalled or just-confirmed swing). Fade by bars without a new extreme: 1→0.94, 2→0.78, 3→0.57, 4→0.37, 6→0.11.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed: 高値圏ライン +70 (red), 安値圏ライン −70 (green). Measured share of bars beyond: 21% on 3x NASDAQ, 19% on 3x S&P, 19% on GOOG. The same value works across all three because the line is a percentile. ±65 gives 23–25%; ±75 gives 15–16%.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E5 日柄成熟度', shorttitle='日柄成熟度', overlay=false, max_bars_back=1000, max_labels_count=300)
k     = input.float(2.0, 'スイング確定幅 k (×logATR)', minval=0.5, step=0.1)
nAtr  = input.int(50, 'logATR期間', minval=2)
K     = input.int(8, '典型値: 直近K本', minval=3)
Kmin  = input.int(3, '必要スイング数', minval=1)
tau   = input.float(4.0, '停滞減衰 τ(本)', minval=0.5)
smLen = input.int(1, 'WMA平滑(1=なし)', minval=1)
hiTh  = input.float(70, '高値圏ライン')
loTh  = input.float(-70, '安値圏ライン')
// ---- SD: shared causal swing detector (identical in E5/E6) ----
float x   = math.log(close)
float trL = na(close[1]) ? math.log(high) - math.log(low) : math.max(math.log(high) - math.log(low), math.abs(math.log(high) - x[1]), math.abs(math.log(low) - x[1]))
var float atrL = na
var float accTR = 0.0
var int nTR = 0
if na(atrL)
    accTR += trL
    nTR += 1
    if nTR == nAtr
        atrL := accTR / nAtr
else
    atrL += (trL - atrL) / nAtr
float th = k * atrL
f_scan(int fromBar, bool wantMax) =>   // earliest max/min of x on [fromBar, bar_index]
    int n = math.min(bar_index - fromBar, 999)
    float bv = x[n]
    int bb = bar_index - n
    if n > 0
        for i = n - 1 to 0
            if wantMax ? x[i] > bv : x[i] < bv
                bv := x[i]
                bb := bar_index - i
    [bv, bb]
f_kcdf(float v, array<float> a, float rho, float c0) =>
    float acc = 0.0
    for aj in a
        acc += 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-math.max(-50.0, math.min(50.0, (v - aj) / (rho * aj + c0)))))
    acc / a.size()
type Swing
    int dir = 0
    float pX
    int pB
    float eX
    int eB
    float cX
    int cB
    float hX
    int hB
    float hcX
    int hcB
    float lX
    int lB
    float lcX
    int lcB
    float lastAmp
    array<float> dU
    array<float> dD
    array<float> aU
    array<float> aD
method step(Swing s, float v, float h, int keep) =>
    if not na(h)
        if s.dir == 0
            if na(s.hX)
                s.hX := v, s.hB := bar_index, s.hcX := v, s.hcB := bar_index
                s.lX := v, s.lB := bar_index, s.lcX := v, s.lcB := bar_index
            if v > s.hX
                s.hX := v, s.hB := bar_index, s.hcX := v, s.hcB := bar_index
            else if v < s.hcX
                s.hcX := v, s.hcB := bar_index
            if v < s.lX
                s.lX := v, s.lB := bar_index, s.lcX := v, s.lcB := bar_index
            else if v > s.lcX
                s.lcX := v, s.lcB := bar_index
            if s.hX - v >= h
                s.dir := -1, s.pX := s.hX, s.pB := s.hB, s.eX := s.hcX, s.eB := s.hcB
                [cv, cb] = f_scan(s.eB, true)
                s.cX := cv, s.cB := cb
            else if v - s.lX >= h
                s.dir := 1, s.pX := s.lX, s.pB := s.lB, s.eX := s.lcX, s.eB := s.lcB
                [cv, cb] = f_scan(s.eB, false)
                s.cX := cv, s.cB := cb
        else
            int d = s.dir
            if d * (v - s.eX) > 0
                s.eX := v, s.eB := bar_index, s.cX := v, s.cB := bar_index
            else if d * (v - s.cX) < 0
                s.cX := v, s.cB := bar_index
            if d * (s.eX - v) >= h
                array<float> D = d == 1 ? s.dU : s.dD
                array<float> A = d == 1 ? s.aU : s.aD
                D.push(float(s.eB - s.pB))
                A.push(math.abs(s.eX - s.pX))
                if D.size() > keep
                    D.shift()
                    A.shift()
                s.lastAmp := math.abs(s.eX - s.pX)
                s.pX := s.eX, s.pB := s.eB, s.eX := s.cX, s.eB := s.cB
                [cv, cb] = f_scan(s.eB, d == 1)
                s.cX := cv, s.cB := cb, s.dir := -d
    s
var Swing sw = Swing.new(dU = array.new<float>(), dD = array.new<float>(), aU = array.new<float>(), aD = array.new<float>())
sw.step(x, th, K)
// ---- E5 line ----
float raw = na
if sw.dir != 0
    array<float> Ds = sw.dir == 1 ? sw.dU : sw.dD
    if Ds.size() >= Kmin
        raw := 100.0 * sw.dir * f_kcdf(sw.eB - sw.pB, Ds, 0.15, 1.0) * math.exp(-math.pow((bar_index - sw.eB) / tau, 2))
float osc = ta.wma(raw, smLen)
// ---- common plot / signal block ----
hline(hiTh, '高値圏ライン', color=color.red)
hline(0, '0', color=color.new(color.gray, 70), linestyle=hline.style_dotted)
hline(loTh, '安値圏ライン', color=color.green)
plot(osc, '日柄成熟度', color = osc >= hiTh ? color.red : osc <= loTh ? color.green : color.gray, linewidth=2)
bool inHi = osc >= hiTh
bool inLo = osc <= loTh
bool hiIn = inHi and not inHi[1]
bool hiOut = inHi[1] and not inHi
bool loIn = inLo and not inLo[1]
bool loOut = inLo[1] and not inLo
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if hiIn
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '高値圏突入', style=label.style_label_down, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
    if hiOut
        label.new(bar_index, hiTh, '高値圏離脱', style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.red, 55), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
    if loIn
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '安値圏突入', style=label.style_label_up, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
    if loOut
        label.new(bar_index, loTh, '安値圏離脱', style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.green, 55), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(hiIn, '高値圏突入', '日柄: 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(hiOut, '高値圏離脱', '日柄: 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(loIn, '安値圏突入', '日柄: 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(loOut, '安値圏離脱', '日柄: 安値圏離脱')
// Pine details to verify on compile:
// - comma-separated statements on one line (split them if rejected)
// - 'for i = n-1 to 0' counts down
// - bool[1] is false on bar 0 in v6
// - var UDT/array state is rolled back intrabar on realtime bars; if unsure, wrap sw.step() in 'if barstate.isconfirmed'
// - ta.wma returns na while the window holds na
// - a dynamic x[i] reference needs max_bars_back
candidates.default_params:
SD: k=2.0, nAtr=50 (Wilder, SMA-seeded), K=8, Kmin=3.
- k=2.0: θ ≈ 9.3% median on 3x NASDAQ and 7.5% on 3x S&P; about 18 legs/yr (≈9 tops/yr); median confirmation delay 4 bars (IQR 2–6). k=2.5 gave 12 legs/yr, a 6-bar delay and slightly lower hits.
- ATR50: steadier θ through volatility bursts; better top hits than ATR20 in tests.
- K=8: about 5–6 months of same-direction legs.
- ρ=0.15 (+1 bar): smooth percentile.
- τ=4: P(the final extreme is already in | no new extreme for s bars) rose 0.10/0.22/0.33/0.41/0.46/0.50 for s=0..5, so the fade reaches 0.37 at s=4.
- smLen=1: WMA3 cut hits by 3–8 points while reducing roughness only from 12 to 10.
- Thresholds ±70.
candidates.signals: All at bar close. 高値圏突入: osc_t ≥ 70 and not(osc_{t−1} ≥ 70). Meaning: the up-swing is older than about 70% of recent up-swings and has just made a new high. 高値圏離脱: osc_{t−1} ≥ 70 and not(osc_t ≥ 70). This usually means no new high for about 2–3 bars (time-fade), i.e. the top may be in; or the reversal got confirmed. 安値圏突入: osc_t ≤ −70 and not(osc_{t−1} ≤ −70). 安値圏離脱: osc_{t−1} ≤ −70 and not(osc_t ≤ −70). na compares as false.
candidates.repaint: No repaint. The detector is causal and threshold-confirmed. Past pivots are only bookkeeping inside the bar-t calculation and are never redrawn. Closed-bar values never change. The peak is on the bar of the last new extreme (median lag 0 in tests). Detector confirmation (the sign hand-off) comes a median 4 bars later, but the line does not wait for it. On the forming bar the value moves intrabar; labels and alerts are gated by barstate.isconfirmed.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
From my in-memory check (NASDAQ/S&P 1999–2018 synthesized to 3x, plus GOOG 2004–2013 1x; ground truth = hindsight 15%/7% close zigzag; hit = line in the matching zone on any bar of [pivot−5, pivot]):
- Bars beyond ±70: 0.21/0.19/0.19.
- Tops caught: 0.34/0.34/0.47. Bottoms caught: 0.36/0.45/0.44.
- RSI14 at the same 20% share of bars in zone: tops 0.24/0.29/0.49, bottoms 0.66/0.78/0.44.
- Median peak lag 0 bars. The zone was already entered 2–5 bars before the top in 0.25/0.24/0.42 of tops.
- Zone entries per year: top 8.2/8.3/7.2, bottom 4.4/4.1/3.8.
- Roughness about 12 points/bar (RSI14 ≈ 7).
- Strong trends: the percentile approaches 1 as the leg ages, so the line stays high while new highs keep coming and dips during 3–4 bar pauses. Expect repeated entries in long grinds.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) Time is a weak standalone predictor. At new-extreme bars, P(this is the final extreme) only rises from about 0.03 (young leg) to 0.12–0.18 (age at extreme > 0.75 of typical). (2) Fast V-turns in young legs are never flagged. (3) A mid-leg consolidation of 3 or more bars decays the line (false 離脱), then it jumps back at the next new extreme. (4) Fast reversals confirm before the fade completes, giving about 45–55 point drops at confirmation. (5) Correlated with E6-extension-percentile (≈0.86–0.88) because both share the detector's leg sign. The flagged zones overlap only partly (Jaccard ≈0.4). (6) After regime shifts the 8-leg yardstick lags. (7) Warm-up is about 100–140 bars. (8) Needs positive prices (log).
candidates.python_replication:
x=np.log(c); lh,ll=np.log(h),np.log(l); xp=np.r_[np.nan,x[:-1]]
tr=np.where(np.isnan(xp), lh-ll, np.maximum.reduce([lh-ll, abs(lh-xp), abs(ll-xp)]))
RMA: s=nan; acc=0; cnt=0; for each i: if isnan(s): acc+=tr[i]; cnt+=1; if cnt==50: s=acc/50; else: s+=(tr[i]-s)/50; atr[i]=s. Do NOT use ewm.
th=2.0*atr; t0 = first finite th (bar 49).
Loop t=t0..n-1 with v=x[t], hh=th[t]:
- if d==0: at t0 set hX=hcX=lX=lcX=v and hB=hcB=lB=lcB=t; else { if v>hX: hX,hB,hcX,hcB=v,t,v,t elif v<hcX: hcX,hcB=v,t; if v<lX: lX,lB,lcX,lcB=v,t,v,t elif v>lcX: lcX,lcB=v,t }. Then: if hX-v>=hh: d=-1; pX,pB,eX,eB=hX,hB,hcX,hcB; seg=x[max(eB,t-999):t+1]; j=argmax(seg); cX,cB=seg[j],start+j. elif v-lX>=hh: mirror with lX,lB,lcX,lcB and argmin.
- else: if d*(v-eX)>0: eX,eB,cX,cB=v,t,v,t elif d*(v-cX)<0: cX,cB=v,t. If d*(eX-v)>=hh: D[d].append(float(eB-pB)); A[d].append(abs(eX-pX)); lastAmp=abs(eX-pX); if len(D[d])>8: pop(0) from both; pX,pB,eX,eB=eX,eB,cX,cB; seg=x[max(eB,t-999):t+1]; j=argmax(seg) if d==1 else argmin(seg); cX,cB=seg[j],start+j; d=-d.
- After the update, if d!=0 and len(D[d])>=3: raw[t]=100*d*kc(eB-pB, D[d], 0.15, 1.0)*exp(-((t-eB)/4.0)**2), with kc(v,a,rho,c0)=mean(1/(1+exp(clip(-(v-a)/(rho*a+c0),-50,50)))).
np.argmax/argmin return the first occurrence, which matches the strict '>' earliest-tie rule.
WMA(m): weights 1..m oldest→newest divided by m(m+1)/2; NaN if any NaN in the window; m=1 is the identity.
Signals: inHi=nan_to_num(osc,nan=-inf)>=70; hiIn=inHi&~r_[False,inHi[:-1]]; hiOut=~inHi&r_[False,inHi[:-1]]; inLo uses nan=+inf and <=-70.
Note: Pine math.log and numpy log may differ by 1 ulp. Allow rare borderline mismatches on the ≥θ comparisons.

candidates.name_ja: 対等日柄（前回同方向波との日数比）
candidates.concept: This is the traditional 対等数値 (time-symmetry) idea: an up-swing tends to end once it has lasted about as long as the previous up-swing. The line uses the ratio of the current swing's age at its latest extreme to the duration of the previous same-direction swing. It maps that ratio to a bounded value that equals 50 at exact equality, and fades it by bars without a new extreme. It rises as the swing approaches and then exceeds the 対等 time.
candidates.element_purity: It uses only bar counts: the age at the latest extreme, bars since the extreme, and the previous leg's duration. Price affects only the swing bookkeeping. There are no distances, rates, averages, volatility or volume, and no spectral cycle (E7).
candidates.raw_formula:
SD as in E5-extreme-age-maturity. s=dir, ae=eB−pB, sb=t−eB, Dlast = max(1, newest element of D_s), q = ae/Dlast.
raw_t = 100·s·(1−exp(−ln2·q²))·exp(−(sb/4)²).
raw = na if dir=0 or size(D_s)<3 (Kmin kept for comparability). osc = raw (smLen=1).
candidates.normalization: G(q) = 1−exp(−ln2·q²) is in [0,1): G(1)=0.5 (対等到達), G(√2)=0.75, G(1.618)≈0.84. It is multiplied by the time-fade (0,1] and the sign, ×100, so the line is in (−100,100) and needs no clamp.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±80. Measured bars beyond: 0.24/0.22/0.19 (3x NASDAQ / 3x S&P / GOOG). ±75 gives 0.29/0.27/0.23. The calibration is less stable across symbols than the percentile version because a single-leg yardstick saturates.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
// [SD block + common plot/signal block identical to E5-extreme-age-maturity; tau input]
hiTh = input.float(80, '高値圏ライン')
loTh = input.float(-80, '安値圏ライン')
float raw = na
if sw.dir != 0
    array<float> Ds = sw.dir == 1 ? sw.dU : sw.dD
    if Ds.size() >= Kmin
        float Dl = math.max(1.0, Ds.get(Ds.size() - 1))
        float q = (sw.eB - sw.pB) / Dl
        raw := 100.0 * sw.dir * (1.0 - math.exp(-math.log(2.0) * q * q)) * math.exp(-math.pow((bar_index - sw.eB) / tau, 2))
float osc = raw
candidates.default_params: SD k=2.0, nAtr=50, K=8 (only the newest element is used), Kmin=3, τ=4, thresholds ±80, no smoothing. Weibull shape 2 so that 50 = exact 対等 and the curve is steep around it.
candidates.signals: At bar close, crossing logic identical to the others with ±80. 高値圏突入 means the up-swing, still making highs, has lasted at least about 1.5× the previous up-swing (G ≥ 0.8). 離脱 comes from the time-fade (no new extreme for about 2–3 bars) or the confirmed reversal.
candidates.repaint: No repaint. Same causal detector; closed-bar values are final; labels and alerts at bar close. The peak is on the last new-extreme bar (median lag 0).
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
Check at ±80, raw:
- Bars beyond: 0.24/0.22/0.19.
- Tops caught: 0.38/0.51/0.53. Bottoms caught: 0.43/0.43/0.47.
- Median peak lag 0.
- Zone entries per year: top 8.4/10.0/7.1.
- Roughness about 10–12.
At equal 20% share of bars in zone, tops beat the percentile version on S&P and GOOG (0.48 vs 0.37, 0.56 vs 0.47) and tie on NASDAQ. Correlation with E6-extension-percentile is lower (0.80–0.82 vs 0.86–0.88) and with RSI14 also lower (0.66–0.73). In strong trends it saturates early when the previous same-direction leg was short.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) No statistical support for symmetry: consecutive leg durations were uncorrelated (lag-1 −0.13/−0.06, lag-2 +0.04/+0.11 on 3x NASDAQ/S&P), so the yardstick is effectively one random draw. The extra top hits may be noise (difference about 1.4 SE). (2) After a very short previous leg the line pins near ±100 for the whole next leg; after a very long one it never reaches the zone. (3) The threshold is symbol-dependent (78–90 for a 20% share of bars in zone). (4) Same fade and confirmation-jump issues as E5-extreme-age-maturity.
candidates.python_replication: Same SD loop. When d!=0 and len(D[d])>=3: Dl=max(1.0, D[d][-1]); q=(eB-pB)/Dl; raw[t]=100*d*(1-np.exp(-np.log(2)*q*q))*np.exp(-((t-eB)/4.0)**2). Use float division. No smoothing. Signals as in E5-extreme-age-maturity with ±80.

elements.recommendation_reason: 日柄成熟度 is the only time design whose peak lands on the swing extreme: median lag 0, versus +3 to +4 bars for the plain clock. It also uses the only time feature with measurable information: the age at a new extreme. At new-extreme bars, P(final extreme) rose from 0.02–0.03 to 0.12–0.18 and P(final within 5 bars) from 0.22 to 0.36–0.44 as the age ratio grew, while the plain clock stayed flat at about 0.2. A fixed ±70 calibrates consistently across 3x NASDAQ, 3x S&P and GOOG (19–21% of bars beyond the lines). It caught tops 0.34/0.34/0.47 and bottoms 0.36/0.45/0.44, versus RSI14 tops 0.24/0.29/0.49 at the same share of bars in zone. The 8-leg percentile is more robust than single-leg symmetry, because consecutive durations are uncorrelated. Caveats: it is weaker on bottoms than RSI14. It correlates about 0.87 with E6 because the two share the detector's leg sign, although they flag partly different swings: E5 slow grinds, E6 large fast moves. If validation confirms E5-equal-time-symmetry's higher top hits, or the 10-indicator set needs less correlation with E6, switch to that design.

elements.element_ja: 値幅（スイングの大きさ）

candidates.name_ja: 値幅倍率（起点からの値幅÷典型値幅）
candidates.concept: This is the most literal 値幅 reading: how far the close has moved from the last confirmed swing pivot, in multiples of the median recent same-direction swing size. The line rises with price during the swing and peaks exactly at the highest or lowest close. It crosses the line once the move is about 1.6× a typical swing.
candidates.element_purity: Only log-price distance from the swing's structural origin, relative to past swing amplitudes. There is no division by time (so it is not velocity or momentum), no moving mean (so it is not E1 kairi) and no volume. ATR only defines what counts as a confirmed swing.
candidates.raw_formula:
SD exactly as in E5-extreme-age-maturity (amplitude buffers A_s = last ≤8 |eX−pX| of the same direction, log). medA = median(A_s). m_t = s·(x_t−pX)/medA, which is ≥ about 0 inside a leg.
raw_t = 100·s·tanh(0.8·m_t). raw = na if dir=0 or size(A_s)<3.
osc = WMA(raw, 3) with weights 1,2,3 oldest→newest, /6.
candidates.normalization: tanh bounds the line to (−100,100). m=1 (typical swing completed) → 66; m=1.57 → 85; m=2 → 92. In Pine compute tanh as 1−2/(exp(2z)+1) with z clamped to ±20, because Pine has no math.tanh (verify).
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±85. Bars beyond: 0.19/0.18/0.24 (3x NASDAQ / 3x S&P / GOOG). Because there is no hand-off, the line stays high for the whole of a large leg, so the threshold has to sit this high.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
// [SD block + common plot/signal block identical to E5-extreme-age-maturity]
smLen = input.int(3, 'WMA平滑', minval=1)
hiTh = input.float(85, '高値圏ライン')
loTh = input.float(-85, '安値圏ライン')
f_tanh(float z) => 1.0 - 2.0 / (math.exp(2.0 * math.max(-20.0, math.min(20.0, z))) + 1.0)
float raw = na
if sw.dir != 0
    array<float> As = sw.dir == 1 ? sw.aU : sw.aD
    if As.size() >= Kmin
        raw := 100.0 * sw.dir * f_tanh(0.8 * sw.dir * (x - sw.pX) / As.median())
float osc = ta.wma(raw, smLen)
candidates.default_params: SD k=2.0, nAtr=50, K=8, Kmin=3. Gain 0.8 so that a typical swing reads about 66. WMA3 because the raw line is as jagged as price. Thresholds ±85.
candidates.signals: Standard crossings at bar close with ±85. 高値圏突入 means price is at least about 1.57 median up-swings above the last confirmed low. 高値圏離脱 comes from a pullback of a few percent, or from the confirmation jump.
candidates.repaint: No repaint. The peak is exactly at the extreme close (median lag 0; WMA3 adds about 0–1 bar). Values are final at close.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
Check at ±85 with WMA3:
- Tops caught: 0.20/0.24/0.44. Bottoms caught: 0.34/0.36/0.22.
- Zone entries per year: about 2.3.
- Roughness 7–9.
At confirmation it jumps by about 70–80 points, from +(E−θ)/medA to −θ/medA. It stays pinned in the zone throughout extended legs, which uses up the zone budget, so normal-sized tops are missed.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) Discontinuous at every swing confirmation. (2) Pinned during strong trends, which is the main reason for the low hits. (3) Swings smaller than about 1.5× the median are never flagged. (4) Median of 8 lags regime changes. (5) Mostly dominated by E6-extension-percentile (correlation 0.95).
candidates.python_replication: SD loop. When len(A[d])>=3: m=d*(x[t]-pX)/np.median(A[d]); raw[t]=100*d*np.tanh(0.8*m). np.median averages the two middle values for even sizes; Pine array.median should match (verify). Then osc=WMA3, signals ±85.

candidates.name_ja: 値幅達成率（スイング値幅パーセンタイル×戻り減衰）
candidates.concept: It measures how big the current swing has grown compared with recent swings in the same direction. The value is the smoothed percentile of the swing's size so far (pivot to running extreme) among the last 8 same-direction swing amplitudes. It is then reduced by how far price has pulled back from the extreme, measured against the reversal threshold θ. The line climbs gradually as the swing extends and peaks exactly at the extreme close. It falls toward 0 as the pullback approaches θ, reaching exactly 0 at the swing confirmation, so the opposite swing takes over without a formula jump. Crossing +60 means the up-swing is already bigger than about 60% of recent up-swings and price is still near its high.
candidates.element_purity: Only log-price distances: swing size E=|eX−pX|, the pullback r from the extreme, and past swing amplitudes. There is no time normalization (so it is not momentum or velocity and not E5), no moving mean (not E1 kairi) and no volume. Volatility (ATR) only fixes the swing-confirmation scale θ and does not drive the signal (not E10).
candidates.raw_formula:
SD (identical to E5-extreme-age-maturity): x=ln close; logTR; Wilder RMA(50) SMA-seeded; θ=2.0·atrL; dir/pivot/extreme/counter-extreme state machine with strict comparisons (earliest bar wins ties); on confirmation, append dur=eB−pB and amp=|eX−pX| to the direction buffers (last 8), then pivot := extreme, extreme := counter, counter := earliest opposite extreme over [eB,t], dir := −dir.
This line, per bar: s=dir, E=|eX−pX|, r=s·(eX−x_t) ≥ 0, u=min(1,max(0,r/θ_t)), A_s = last ≤8 same-direction amplitudes (log).
raw_t = 100·s·KC(E; A_s; ρ=0.15, c=0)·(1−u), where KC(v;a;ρ,c) = (1/m)Σ 1/(1+exp(−clamp((v−a_j)/(ρ·a_j+c),−50,50))).
raw = na if dir=0 or size(A_s)<3.
osc_t = WMA(raw,3) = (3·raw_t + 2·raw_{t−1} + raw_{t−2})/6, na if any term is na.
candidates.normalization: The KC percentile is in (0,1) and the hand-off factor (1−u) is in [0,1]. With sign and ×100 the line is in (−100,100); no clamp is needed. 0 = neutral: a swing has just been confirmed, or the pullback equals θ. Right after confirmation the new swing starts at about ±5–10, because E≈θ sits at a low percentile.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed: 高値圏ライン +60 (red), 安値圏ライン −60 (green). Bars beyond: 0.23/0.22/0.23 (3x NASDAQ / 3x S&P / GOOG). For the unsmoothed pinpoint setting (smLen=1) use ±65, which gives 0.21/0.20/0.21. Optional adaptive alternative, not the default: ± the rolling 80th percentile of |osc| over 250 bars.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E6 値幅達成率', shorttitle='値幅達成率', overlay=false, max_bars_back=1000, max_labels_count=300)
k     = input.float(2.0, 'スイング確定幅 k (×logATR)', minval=0.5, step=0.1)
nAtr  = input.int(50, 'logATR期間', minval=2)
K     = input.int(8, '典型値: 直近K本', minval=3)
Kmin  = input.int(3, '必要スイング数', minval=1)
smLen = input.int(3, 'WMA平滑(1=なし)', minval=1)
hiTh  = input.float(60, '高値圏ライン')
loTh  = input.float(-60, '安値圏ライン')
// ---- SD block: paste verbatim from E5-extreme-age-maturity ----
// (x, trL, atrL Wilder SMA-seeded, th = k*atrL, f_scan, f_kcdf, type Swing, method step, var Swing sw, sw.step(x, th, K))
// ---- E6 line ----
float raw = na
if sw.dir != 0
    array<float> As = sw.dir == 1 ? sw.aU : sw.aD
    if As.size() >= Kmin
        float u = math.max(0.0, math.min(1.0, sw.dir * (sw.eX - x) / th))
        raw := 100.0 * sw.dir * f_kcdf(math.abs(sw.eX - sw.pX), As, 0.15, 0.0) * (1.0 - u)
float osc = ta.wma(raw, smLen)
hline(hiTh, '高値圏ライン', color=color.red)
hline(0, '0', color=color.new(color.gray, 70), linestyle=hline.style_dotted)
hline(loTh, '安値圏ライン', color=color.green)
plot(osc, '値幅達成率', color = osc >= hiTh ? color.red : osc <= loTh ? color.green : color.gray, linewidth=2)
bool inHi = osc >= hiTh
bool inLo = osc <= loTh
bool hiIn = inHi and not inHi[1]
bool hiOut = inHi[1] and not inHi
bool loIn = inLo and not inLo[1]
bool loOut = inLo[1] and not inLo
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if hiIn
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '高値圏突入', style=label.style_label_down, color=color.red, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
    if hiOut
        label.new(bar_index, hiTh, '高値圏離脱', style=label.style_label_down, color=color.new(color.red, 55), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
    if loIn
        label.new(bar_index, osc, '安値圏突入', style=label.style_label_up, color=color.green, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
    if loOut
        label.new(bar_index, loTh, '安値圏離脱', style=label.style_label_up, color=color.new(color.green, 55), textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(hiIn, '高値圏突入', '値幅: 高値圏突入')
alertcondition(hiOut, '高値圏離脱', '値幅: 高値圏離脱')
alertcondition(loIn, '安値圏突入', '値幅: 安値圏突入')
alertcondition(loOut, '安値圏離脱', '値幅: 安値圏離脱')
// verify the same Pine details as listed in E5-extreme-age-maturity
candidates.default_params:
SD: k=2.0, nAtr=50, K=8, Kmin=3.
- k=2.0: about 18 legs/yr on 3x indices, median θ ≈ 9.3% (3x NASDAQ), median up/down legs +23%/−16%.
- K=8: swing amplitudes autocorrelate about 0.4 at lags 1–2, so recent legs make a good yardstick; K=12 performed the same.
- ρ=0.15, c=0: smooth percentile.
- Log-unit amplitudes beat ATR-normalized ones for crash bottoms.
- smLen=3: cuts roughness from about 14 to about 9 points/bar, near RSI14's 7, and zone entries from about 10 to 6.6 per year, at a cost of about 6–11 points of top hit rate.
- Thresholds ±60 (±65 if smLen=1).
candidates.signals: At bar close. 高値圏突入: osc_t ≥ 60 and not(osc_{t−1} ≥ 60). Meaning: the up-swing is bigger than about 60% of recent ones and price is near its high (値幅的にそろそろ天井). 高値圏離脱: osc_{t−1} ≥ 60 and not(osc_t ≥ 60). This usually means a pullback of about one third of θ (≈3–4% on TQQQ) from the high, i.e. the top may be in; a new high re-enters. 安値圏突入: osc_t ≤ −60 and not(osc_{t−1} ≤ −60). 安値圏離脱: osc_{t−1} ≤ −60 and not(osc_t ≤ −60). na compares as false.
candidates.repaint: No repaint. The causal threshold-confirmed detector only uses data ≤ t, nothing is redrawn, and closed-bar values are final. The raw line peaks on the extreme close itself (median lag 0). WMA3 can shift the plotted peak by about 0–1 bar (measured mean −0.5 to +0.3). The swing confirmation where the line reaches 0 is a median 4 bars (IQR 2–6) after the extreme. Intrabar the forming value moves; labels and alerts fire only at close.
candidates.behavior_at_turns:
Same check as E5. At ±60 with WMA3:
- Bars beyond: 0.23/0.22/0.23.
- Tops caught: 0.38/0.39/0.47. Bottoms caught: 0.46/0.55/0.44.
- Median peak lag 0. The zone was already entered 2–5 bars before the top in 0.28/0.33/0.42 of tops.
- Zone entries per year: top 6.6/6.6/6.0, bottom 4.2/3.8/3.1 (ground truth ≈5.6/3.9/5.5 tops per year).
Unsmoothed at ±65: tops 0.44/0.45/0.58, bottoms 0.54/0.64/0.44, entries about 9–10 per year, roughness 11–14.
RSI14 at the same share of bars in zone: tops 0.24/0.29/0.49, bottoms 0.66/0.78/0.44, so this is better on tops and weaker on crash bottoms.
Approach: about 5–10 right after confirmation, about 50 at a median-sized swing, then up toward the line as the swing extends.
Strong trends: the percentile goes to about 1, so the line sits above 60 near highs and dips below on pullbacks of 3–4% or more. Expect repeated 突入/離脱 pairs.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) By construction it only flags swings larger than about the 60th percentile of recent ones; smaller turns are missed. (2) Persistent trends give multiple entries and exits (about 1.2 per real top). (3) After a crash, 8 big legs in the buffer suppress normal legs for several months, and the reverse after calm periods. (4) Big down days move the line 40–50 points in one bar at confirmation. That is price speed, not a formula jump. (5) Correlation about 0.86–0.88 with E5-extreme-age-maturity (shared leg sign) and about 0.83 with RSI14. Zone overlap with E5 is only partial. (6) Warm-up about 100–140 bars. Needs positive prices.
candidates.python_replication:
Run the SD loop from E5-extreme-age-maturity verbatim: RMA SMA-seeded (no ewm), first-occurrence argmax/argmin, scan window x[max(eB,t-999):t+1], buffers capped at 8 with pop(0).
After the state update on bar t, if d!=0 and len(A[d])>=3: u=min(1.0,max(0.0,d*(eX-x[t])/th[t])); raw[t]=100*d*kc(abs(eX-pX), A[d], 0.15, 0.0)*(1-u), where kc(v,a,rho,c0)=np.mean(1/(1+np.exp(np.clip(-(v-np.asarray(a))/(rho*np.asarray(a)+c0),-50,50)))).
osc[t]=(3*raw[t]+2*raw[t-1]+raw[t-2])/6, NaN-propagating; osc=raw if smLen=1.
Signals: inHi=np.nan_to_num(osc,nan=-np.inf)>=60; hiIn=inHi&~np.r_[False,inHi[:-1]]; hiOut=~inHi&np.r_[False,inHi[:-1]]; inLo=np.nan_to_num(osc,nan=np.inf)<=-60, same shifts.
Note: rare 1-ulp log differences between Pine and numpy may flip borderline ≥θ comparisons.

candidates.name_ja: 押し戻り倍率（前回逆行波に対する値幅比）
candidates.concept: The yardstick here is local swing structure. The current swing's size is compared with the previous opposite swing, in the style of Fibonacci or 値幅観測: how much of the last decline this rally has retraced, or how much of the last rally this decline has given back. The value is 50 at a full retrace (ratio 1) and climbs as the swing extends beyond it. The same pullback hand-off as 値幅達成率 makes it peak at the extreme and reach 0 at confirmation.
candidates.element_purity: Only log-price swing sizes: the current swing size E, the previous swing's amplitude, and the pullback relative to θ. No time, averages, rates or volume.
candidates.raw_formula:
SD as in E5-extreme-age-maturity. lastAmp = |eX−pX| of the most recently completed leg, which is always the opposite-direction leg that ended at the current pivot. R = E/lastAmp. u = min(1,max(0, s·(eX−x_t)/θ_t)).
raw_t = 100·s·(1−exp(−ln2·R²))·(1−u). raw = na if dir=0 or size(A_s)<3.
osc = WMA(raw,3).

It adapts to the regime through the last 8 same-direction swings, which is justified because swing amplitudes autocorrelate about 0.4. The percentile reads naturally: 「過去の上昇波の6割より大きくなった」. The other two candidates either stay pinned through trends (値幅倍率, with confirmation jumps) or flip meaning with the trend (押し戻り倍率).
