candidates.name_ja: 相関サイクル位相
candidates.concept: Every day the indicator asks how closely the last P closes resemble one full cycle whose crest is today. It correlates log-close with a crest-now cosine template (Real) and with a rising-phase -sine template (Imag); together the two form a phasor whose angle is the current cycle phase. The main line is the cosine of that phase: +100 means the crest is now, -100 means the trough is now. The line rises like a sine wave as the cycle top approaches, crosses the 高値圏ライン about 2 bars before the crest, and turns down on the crest itself, so it works as a visual cycle clock for そろそろ高値 / そろそろ安値.
candidates.element_purity: The line depends only on position inside a cycle, i.e. waveform shape and phase. Pearson correlation does not change with price level or swing size: a 2% and a 20% oscillation of the same shape give the same value. So no 乖離, 値幅 or volatility information enters. The coherence term (mag) only measures how sinusoidal the window is. A straight trend projects almost nothing onto a full-period cosine: for a pure ramp, Real = √24/(2√(P²−1)) = 0.12 and Imag = −0.77, so the line is about +16. Unlike momentum, it therefore does not stay high through a rally. It uses no swing pivots and no time-since-swing (≠ E5), no run counting (≠ E8), and no up/down magnitude balance (≠ E2). Measured on the 3x-synthesized NASDAQ / S&P 500 / GOOG series: line corr with RSI14 is 0.37-0.39 and with EMA20/ATR kairi 0.44-0.46. Overlap of its zones with RSI zones (Jaccard, at equal 15% zone time) is only 0.03-0.07, versus 0.52-0.73 between RSI and kairi. Corr with the recommended E8 line is 0.42-0.43, with zone Jaccard 0.10-0.17.
candidates.raw_formula: Bar t, P = 20. x_i = ln(close[t−i]) for i = 0..P−1 (current bar included; i = bars ago). Templates: c_i = cos(2π·i/P) (crest at i = 0) and s_i = −sin(2π·i/P) (rising phase). Raw sums with n = P: Sx = Σx, Sxx = Σx², Sc = Σc, Scc = Σc², Sxc = Σx·c, Ss = Σs, Sss = Σs², Sxs = Σx·s. Vx = n·Sxx − Sx². Real = (n·Sxc − Sx·Sc) / √(Vx·(n·Scc − Sc²)). Imag = (n·Sxs − Sx·Ss) / √(Vx·(n·Sss − Ss²)). If Vx ≤ 0, Real = Imag = 0. mag = √(Real² + Imag²), range [0, √2]. The phase φ = atan2(−Imag, Real) (0° = crest now, ±180° = trough now) is informational only and not needed for the line. No smoothing, no recursion, no seeds. First valid bar index = P−1.
candidates.normalization: line = 100 · Real / max(mag, z0), with z0 = 0.5. Because |Real| ≤ mag, the result always lies in [−100, +100] and needs no clamp. If the window is a coherent cycle (mag ≥ 0.5), line = 100·cos φ, a pure phase reading. If the window is not cycle-like (mag < 0.5), the line shrinks proportionally toward 0 (soft coherence gate).
candidates.thresholds: Fixed. 高値圏ライン = +85 and 安値圏ライン = −85. cos φ > 0.85 means within ±32° of the crest, about ±1.8 bars at P = 20. Measured share of bars beyond the lines: 18.3% / 17.4% / 16.8% (NAS3 / SPX3 / GOOG3), split evenly between top and bottom. Tighter options: ±90 gives about 14%, ±95 about 11%.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E7-A 相関サイクル位相', shorttitle='E7A', overlay=false, max_bars_back=300, max_labels_count=500)
P   = input.int(20, 'サイクル長 P', minval=6, maxval=120)
z0  = input.float(0.5, '位相確度の下限 z0', minval=0.05, maxval=1.0, step=0.05)
upT = input.float(85.0, '高値圏ライン')
loT = input.float(-85.0, '安値圏ライン')
float n = P
float sx = 0.0
float sxx = 0.0
float sc = 0.0
float scc = 0.0
float sxc = 0.0
float ss = 0.0
float sss = 0.0
float sxs = 0.0
for i = 0 to P - 1
    float x = math.log(close[i])
    float cv = math.cos(2.0 * math.pi * i / P)
    float sv = -math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * i / P)
    sx += x
    sxx += x * x
    sc += cv
    scc += cv * cv
    sxc += x * cv
    ss += sv
    sss += sv * sv
    sxs += x * sv
float vx = n * sxx - sx * sx
float re = vx > 0 ? (n * sxc - sx * sc) / math.sqrt(vx * (n * scc - sc * sc)) : 0.0
float im = vx > 0 ? (n * sxs - sx * ss) / math.sqrt(vx * (n * sss - ss * ss)) : 0.0
float mag = math.sqrt(re * re + im * im)
float line = bar_index < P - 1 ? na : 100.0 * re / math.max(mag, z0)
// ---- zones / signals / display (same block in every candidate) ----
topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upT)
topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upT)
botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, loT)
botOut = ta.crossover(line, loT)
plot(line, 'メインライン', line > upT ? #d32f2f : line < loT ? #2e7d32 : #78909c, 2)
hline(upT, '高値圏ライン', #d32f2f, hline.style_solid)
hline(loT, '安値圏ライン', #2e7d32, hline.style_solid)
hline(0, '0', #b0bec5, hline.style_dotted)
if barstate.isconfirmed and (topIn or topOut or botIn or botOut)
    label.new(bar_index, line, topIn ? '高値圏突入' : topOut ? '高値圏離脱' : botIn ? '安値圏突入' : '安値圏離脱', style=(topIn or topOut) ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color=(topIn or topOut) ? #d32f2f : #2e7d32, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '高値圏突入', '高値圏突入')
alertcondition(botIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '安値圏突入', '安値圏突入')
// Unverified API details (no tradingview.com access): a dynamic close[i] in a loop needs max_bars_back >= P; in v6 a comparison with na returns false, so warm-up is guarded explicitly; math.atan2 is avoided because I am not sure it exists.
candidates.default_params: P = 20 bars (about 1 trading month), z0 = 0.5, lines ±85, source ln(close). Why: on 3x-synthesized NASDAQ 1999-2018, the hindsight 15% zigzag has a median full cycle of about 20 bars (half-cycle median 10, IQR 5-24). Ehlers' homodyne dominant cycle measured on all three test series has a median of 21-22 bars (IQR about 18-27). P = 18 tested marginally better (+2-4 points of recall); 16-24 is the sensible range (16-18 for SOXL, 20-24 for SPXL). Log price stops a 3x ETF's 100× multi-year price range from distorting the correlation. z0 = 0.5 keeps pure-phase behaviour while the window is reasonably cyclic and damps the line otherwise; at equal zone time this gave higher recall than pure phase.
candidates.signals: Evaluated on confirmed bars only (barstate.isconfirmed). 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +85), i.e. line > 85 and line[1] ≤ 85. 高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +85). 安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −85). 安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −85). Equivalent zone states: inTop = line > 85, inBot = line < −85. One small label per event and nothing else is drawn; alertconditions are set on the two 突入 events. Typical sequence at a cycle top: 突入 2-3 bars before the high, 離脱 on the bar after the high.
candidates.repaint: No repaint. Only closes up to the current bar are used. The realtime bar's line moves until the close, so labels and alerts are gated by barstate.isconfirmed (set alerts to 'Once Per Bar Close'). Historical values are a pure function of the last P closes (no recursion, no pivots), so they never change and do not depend on where chart history starts. Confirmation delay: 0 bars.
candidates.behavior_at_turns: Slightly leading. Within ±10 bars of each hindsight 15% zigzag extreme, the line's own extreme comes a median 2 bars BEFORE the price extreme. For pivots that are hit, zone entry is a median 2-3 bars before the extreme and zone exit is on the extreme bar (離脱 fires the next bar). Pivot in zone or ≤3 bars after exit: 25 / 31 / 18% (NAS3 / SPX3 / GOOG3). Any zone bar within ±5 bars: 43 / 45 / 41%. Zone only 1-3 bars late: 7-11%. Precision (zone episode with a same-side pivot within −2..+3 bars): 23 / 19 / 29%, because every cycle crest gets a visit, including minor ones. For comparison, the RSI14 70/30 baseline has recall 22 / 22 / 31%. The path is smooth and sine-like: about 15 direction changes per 100 bars (RSI14 about 50). It is never pinned: the longest zone episode is 5-6 bars. In strong trends a steady ramp reads about +16 / −16 (neutral), so the line does not sit in a zone through a trend, but it still makes counter-trend visits at minor cycle crests. NAS3 examples: 2018-10-01 top, in zone 09-26..09-28 (92-99) and exited one bar before the high. 2007-10-31 top, 62 on the high and 97-100 on the next three bars (late). 2000-03-10 blow-off top (max 61) and the 2002-10 and 2009-03 capitulation lows: no zone, because there was no cycle shape.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) Trend-end extremes after long one-way runs (blow-off tops, capitulation lows) are often missed because the window holds no cosine shape. (2) With a fixed P, swings much shorter or longer than P shift the measured phase, so peaks come early or late; 3x swings range from 5 to 40 bars. (3) Precision is low by construction: every cycle crest or trough visits the zone, including 5% wiggles on a 3x ETF. (4) A single gap bar can swing Imag and make the phase jump. (5) Needs P bars of history before the first value.
candidates.python_replication:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view as swv
x = np.log(df['Close'].to_numpy(float)); P, z0, T = 20, 0.5, 85.0
i = np.arange(P); yc = np.cos(2*np.pi*i/P); ys = -np.sin(2*np.pi*i/P)
W = swv(x, P)[:, ::-1]          # row r -> bar r+P-1, column i = i bars ago
n = float(P); sx = W.sum(1); sxx = (W*W).sum(1); vx = n*sxx - sx*sx
def corr(y):
    sy = y.sum(); vy = n*(y*y).sum() - sy*sy
    return np.where(vx > 0, (n*(W@y) - sx*sy)/np.sqrt(vx*vy), 0.0)
re, im = corr(yc), corr(ys); mag = np.sqrt(re*re + im*im)
line = np.full(len(x), np.nan); line[P-1:] = 100*re/np.maximum(mag, z0)
s = pd.Series(line, index=df.index)
topIn = (s > T) & (s.shift() <= T); topOut = (s < T) & (s.shift() >= T)
botIn = (s < -T) & (s.shift() >= -T); botOut = (s > -T) & (s.shift() <= -T)
Notes: float64 throughout. Use the same raw-sum Pearson as Pine; only summation order differs (~1e-15 relative). NaN comparisons are False, which matches Pine's na producing no cross. There are no seeds and no warm-up beyond P−1 bars. Close only; 3x synthesis is C3_t = C3_{t−1}·(1 + 3·r_t).

candidates.name_ja: MESAサインウェーブ（ヒルベルト位相）
candidates.concept: This is Ehlers' MESA Sinewave. A Hilbert-transform homodyne discriminator measures the dominant cycle length bar by bar (adaptive, 6-50 bars). A one-period DFT of the smoothed price then gives the dominant-cycle phase, and the line is sin(phase): +100 at the measured cycle crest and −100 at the trough. The wave stretches and compresses with the market's own rhythm, so the approach to each line looks like a smooth sine.
candidates.element_purity: This is pure phase of an adaptively measured cycle. The output lies on the unit circle, so swing size, volatility and trend strength cannot enter. On steady ramps the phase stalls (about −16 in an uptrend, +16 in a downtrend), so trends read neutral. It is the most orthogonal design tested: line corr with RSI14 0.05-0.10, with EMA20/ATR kairi 0.12-0.18, and with the E8 count lines 0.24-0.29. No swing pivots (≠ E5) and no counting (≠ E8).
candidates.raw_formula: src = hl2 (Ehlers default; ln(hl2) tested equivalent). Computed every bar; nz() means history before bar 0 is 0, and all states are seeded 0. Smooth = (4·src + 3·src[1] + 2·src[2] + src[3]) / 10. adj = 0.075·Period[1] + 0.54. H(z) = (0.0962·z + 0.5769·z[2] − 0.5769·z[4] − 0.0962·z[6])·adj. Detrender = H(Smooth). Q1 = H(Detrender). I1 = Detrender[3]. jI = H(I1). jQ = H(Q1). I2 = 0.2·(I1 − jQ) + 0.8·I2[1]. Q2 = 0.2·(Q1 + jI) + 0.8·Q2[1]. Re = 0.2·(I2·I2[1] + Q2·Q2[1]) + 0.8·Re[1]. Im = 0.2·(I2·Q2[1] − Q2·I2[1]) + 0.8·Im[1]. Period update: p = Period[1]; if Im ≠ 0 and Re ≠ 0 then p = 360 / degrees(atan(Im/Re)); p = min(p, 1.5·Period[1]); p = max(p, 0.67·Period[1]); p = clamp(p, 6, 50); Period = 0.2·p + 0.8·Period[1]; SmoothPeriod = 0.33·Period + 0.67·SmoothPeriod[1]. Phase: D = floor(SmoothPeriod + 0.5). RP = Σ_{k=0}^{D−1} sin(2πk/D)·Smooth[k] and IP = Σ_{k=0}^{D−1} cos(2πk/D)·Smooth[k]. φ = degrees(atan(RP/IP)) if |IP| > 1e−10, else φ[1] + 90·sign(RP). Then φ += 90 + (SmoothPeriod > 1 ? 360/SmoothPeriod : 0), which compensates the one-bar lag of the WMA. If IP < 0, φ += 180. Wrap: φ −= 360·floor((φ + 45)/360). Output is masked (na) for bar_index < 50.
candidates.normalization: line = 100·sin(φ + lead), with lead = 0° by default (45° gives Ehlers' LeadSine). Bounded in [−100, +100] by construction; no scaling needed.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±90, about ±26° around crest and trough. Measured share of bars beyond: 15.1 / 15.3 / 13.8% (NAS3 / SPX3 / GOOG3), split evenly top/bottom. ±95 gives about 10%.

//@version=6
indicator('E7-B MESAサインウェーブ', shorttitle='E7B', overlay=false, max_bars_back=100, max_labels_count=500)
upT  = input.float(90.0, '高値圏ライン')
loT  = input.float(-90.0, '安値圏ライン')
lead = input.float(0.0, '位相リード(度)', minval=0.0, maxval=60.0)
src  = hl2
hilb(float s, float a) => (0.0962 * s + 0.5769 * nz(s[2]) - 0.5769 * nz(s[4]) - 0.0962 * nz(s[6])) * a
var float per = 0.0
var float sp = 0.0
var float i2 = 0.0
var float q2 = 0.0
var float re = 0.0
var float im = 0.0
var float ph = 0.0
float sm  = (4.0 * src + 3.0 * nz(src[1]) + 2.0 * nz(src[2]) + nz(src[3])) / 10.0
float adj = 0.075 * per + 0.54          // per still holds the previous bar's value here
float det = hilb(sm, adj)
float q1  = hilb(det, adj)
float i1  = nz(det[3])
float jI  = hilb(i1, adj)
float jQ  = hilb(q1, adj)
float i2p = i2
float q2p = q2
i2 := 0.2 * (i1 - jQ) + 0.8 * i2p
q2 := 0.2 * (q1 + jI) + 0.8 * q2p
re := 0.2 * (i2 * i2p + q2 * q2p) + 0.8 * re
im := 0.2 * (i2 * q2p - q2 * i2p) + 0.8 * im
float pp = per
float p = pp
if im != 0.0 and re != 0.0
    p := 360.0 / math.todegrees(math.atan(im / re))
p := math.min(p, 1.5 * pp)
p := math.max(p, 0.67 * pp)
p := math.max(math.min(p, 50.0), 6.0)
per := 0.2 * p + 0.8 * pp
sp := 0.33 * per + 0.67 * sp
int dcp = math.floor(sp + 0.5)
float rp = 0.0
float ip = 0.0
if dcp >= 1
    for k = 0 to dcp - 1
        float ang = 2.0 * math.pi * k / dcp
        rp += math.sin(ang) * nz(sm[k])
        ip += math.cos(ang) * nz(sm[k])
float phs = math.abs(ip) > 1e-10 ? math.todegrees(math.atan(rp / ip)) : ph + 90.0 * math.sign(rp)
phs += 90.0 + (sp > 1.0 ? 360.0 / sp : 0.0)
if ip < 0.0
    phs += 180.0
phs := phs - 360.0 * math.floor((phs + 45.0) / 360.0)
ph := phs
float line = bar_index < 50 ? na : 100.0 * math.sin(math.toradians(phs + lead))
topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upT)
topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upT)
botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, loT)
botOut = ta.crossover(line, loT)
plot(line, 'メインライン', line > upT ? #d32f2f : line < loT ? #2e7d32 : #78909c, 2)
hline(upT, '高値圏ライン', #d32f2f, hline.style_solid)
hline(loT, '安値圏ライン', #2e7d32, hline.style_solid)
if barstate.isconfirmed and (topIn or topOut or botIn or botOut)
    label.new(bar_index, line, topIn ? '高値圏突入' : topOut ? '高値圏離脱' : botIn ? '安値圏突入' : '安値圏離脱', style=(topIn or topOut) ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color=(topIn or topOut) ? #d32f2f : #2e7d32, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '高値圏突入', '高値圏突入')
alertcondition(botIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '安値圏突入', '安値圏突入')
// Unverified: math.todegrees / math.toradians names; dynamic sm[k] requires max_bars_back >= 51. hilb() must be called on every bar (it is), so the [2]/[4]/[6] history stays bar-aligned.

Lead 0, lines ±90, warm-up mask 50 bars (validate from bar 150). On the three 3x series the measured dominant cycle has a median of 21-22 bars (IQR about 18-27), so it tunes itself to the roughly one-month swing rhythm of daily 3x ETFs without any period input.
candidates.signals: Confirmed bars only. 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +90). 高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +90). 安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −90). 安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −90). A label only at these four events; alerts on the 突入 events.
candidates.repaint: No future data and no repaint on confirmed bars; gate by barstate.isconfirmed. Caveat: the homodyne states are recursive and seeded at the first loaded bar, so the first ~100 bars depend on where TradingView's history starts (they converge after ~100-150 bars). Python must start the recursion on the same first bar, or compare only after bar 150. Confirmation delay: 0 bars.
candidates.behavior_at_turns: The line's extreme comes a median 1-2 bars before the price extreme. Pivot in zone or ≤3 bars after: 20 / 22 / 18%. Zone within ±5 bars: 38 / 44 / 36%. Late-only: 7-12%. Precision: 22 / 17 / 25%. About 16 direction changes per 100 bars; longest zone episode 7-9 bars. Every measured cycle produces a full ±100 swing regardless of swing size, so zone visits are regular: roughly one top visit and one bottom visit per ~21 bars. In trends the phase stalls and the line drifts toward ∓16, so it does not pin.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) The period estimate lags regime changes (0.2 then 0.33 smoothing), so the wave runs out of sync for one or two cycles after volatility shocks. (2) Unit-circle output carries no strength information, which produces many minor-cycle zone visits. (3) The phase can jump near IP ≈ 0 or after gaps. (4) It is the hardest of the six to port, and the recursion makes results depend on where history starts. (5) Like all cycle tools, it is blind at blow-off and capitulation extremes.

src = ((df['High'] + df['Low'])/2).to_numpy(float); n = len(src); lead = 0.0
sm, det, q1, i1, i2, q2, re, im, per, sp, ph = (np.zeros(n) for _ in range(11))
g = lambda a, t: a[t] if t >= 0 else 0.0     # == Pine nz(x[k]); every state seeded 0
line = np.full(n, np.nan)
for t in range(n):
    sm[t] = (4*src[t] + 3*g(src,t-1) + 2*g(src,t-2) + g(src,t-3))/10
    adj = 0.075*g(per,t-1) + 0.54
    H = lambda a: (0.0962*a[t] + 0.5769*g(a,t-2) - 0.5769*g(a,t-4) - 0.0962*g(a,t-6))*adj
    det[t] = H(sm); q1[t] = H(det); i1[t] = g(det,t-3); jI = H(i1); jQ = H(q1)
    i2p, q2p = g(i2,t-1), g(q2,t-1)
    i2[t] = 0.2*(i1[t]-jQ) + 0.8*i2p; q2[t] = 0.2*(q1[t]+jI) + 0.8*q2p
    re[t] = 0.2*(i2[t]*i2p + q2[t]*q2p) + 0.8*g(re,t-1)
    im[t] = 0.2*(i2[t]*q2p - q2[t]*i2p) + 0.8*g(im,t-1)
    pp = g(per,t-1); p = pp
    if im[t] != 0 and re[t] != 0: p = 360.0/np.degrees(np.arctan(im[t]/re[t]))
    p = min(p, 1.5*pp); p = max(p, 0.67*pp); p = max(min(p, 50.0), 6.0)
    per[t] = 0.2*p + 0.8*pp; sp[t] = 0.33*per[t] + 0.67*g(sp,t-1)
    D = int(np.floor(sp[t] + 0.5)); rp = ip = 0.0
    for k in range(D):                        # same accumulation order as Pine
        a = 2*np.pi*k/D; rp += np.sin(a)*g(sm,t-k); ip += np.cos(a)*g(sm,t-k)
    phs = np.degrees(np.arctan(rp/ip)) if abs(ip) > 1e-10 else g(ph,t-1) + 90*np.sign(rp)
    phs += 90 + (360.0/sp[t] if sp[t] > 1 else 0.0)
    if ip < 0: phs += 180
    phs -= 360*np.floor((phs + 45)/360); ph[t] = phs
    if t >= 50: line[t] = 100*np.sin(np.radians(phs + lead))
Signals as in E7-A with T = 90. For the 3x series, High/Low are synthesized against the prior close: H3_t = C3_{t−1}·(1 + 3·(H_t/C_{t−1} − 1)), and L3 likewise. Use close as src if the synthesized H/L are in doubt; the results are nearly identical.

candidates.name_ja: サイクル合致（3周期の位相平均）
candidates.concept: This uses Hurst's synchronicity principle: important turns tend to occur when several harmonically related cycles crest or trough at the same time. The amplitude-free phase cos φ (the same correlation phasor as E7-A) is computed for the half, base and double cycle (10, 20 and 40 bars) and the three are averaged. The line reaches a zone only when all three cycles agree that a crest or trough is happening now, so zone visits are rarer and more selective.
candidates.element_purity: Each term is still phase-only (cos φ of a correlation phasor): no amplitude, volatility or swing size. However, averaging in the 10-bar cycle makes the line behave partly like short-term momentum: corr with RSI14 0.62-0.64, with kairi 0.70-0.71, and 0.66-0.69 with the recommended E8 count line. It is the least distinct of the three cycle designs and is offered for its precision, not its purity.
candidates.raw_formula: For P in {Ph, P0, 2·P0}, with P0 = 20 and Ph = round-half-up(P0/2) = 10: compute Real_P and Imag_P exactly as in E7-A over the last P values of ln(close). mag_P = √(Real_P² + Imag_P²). cosφ_P = Real_P / mag_P if mag_P > 1e−9, else 0. raw = (cosφ_10 + cosφ_20 + cosφ_40) / 3. No recursion; first valid bar = 2·P0 − 1 = 39.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±60. This requires all three cycles to be near the crest or trough together, e.g. each cos φ around 0.6, or two of them around 0.9. Measured share beyond: 10.3 / 10.9 / 12.2%. On NAS3 it is skewed toward the bottom zone (3.9% top / 6.4% bottom).
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E7-C サイクル合致', shorttitle='E7C', overlay=false, max_bars_back=300, max_labels_count=500)
P0  = input.int(20, '基準サイクル長', minval=8, maxval=100)
upT = input.float(60.0, '高値圏ライン')
loT = input.float(-60.0, '安値圏ライン')
cosPhase(int P) =>
    float n = P
    float sx = 0.0
    float sxx = 0.0
    float sc = 0.0
    float scc = 0.0
    float sxc = 0.0
    float ss = 0.0
    float sss = 0.0
    float sxs = 0.0
    for i = 0 to P - 1
        float x = math.log(close[i])
        float cv = math.cos(2.0 * math.pi * i / P)
        float sv = -math.sin(2.0 * math.pi * i / P)
        sx += x
        sxx += x * x
        sc += cv
        scc += cv * cv
        sxc += x * cv
        ss += sv
        sss += sv * sv
        sxs += x * sv
    float vx = n * sxx - sx * sx
    float re = vx > 0 ? (n * sxc - sx * sc) / math.sqrt(vx * (n * scc - sc * sc)) : 0.0
    float im = vx > 0 ? (n * sxs - sx * ss) / math.sqrt(vx * (n * sss - ss * ss)) : 0.0
    float mag = math.sqrt(re * re + im * im)
    mag > 1e-9 ? re / mag : 0.0
int Ph = math.round(P0 / 2.0)
float line = bar_index < 2 * P0 - 1 ? na : 100.0 * (cosPhase(Ph) + cosPhase(P0) + cosPhase(2 * P0)) / 3.0
topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upT)
topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upT)
botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, loT)
botOut = ta.crossover(line, loT)
plot(line, 'メインライン', line > upT ? #d32f2f : line < loT ? #2e7d32 : #78909c, 2)
hline(upT, '高値圏ライン', #d32f2f, hline.style_solid)
hline(loT, '安値圏ライン', #2e7d32, hline.style_solid)
if barstate.isconfirmed and (topIn or topOut or botIn or botOut)
    label.new(bar_index, line, topIn ? '高値圏突入' : topOut ? '高値圏離脱' : botIn ? '安値圏突入' : '安値圏離脱', style=(topIn or topOut) ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color=(topIn or topOut) ? #d32f2f : #2e7d32, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '高値圏突入', '高値圏突入')
alertcondition(botIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '安値圏突入', '安値圏突入')
// Unverified: max_bars_back must cover 2*P0; math.round(x) is assumed to return int with ties rounding up.
candidates.default_params: P0 = 20, giving cycles of 10 / 20 / 40 bars (half, dominant and double: Hurst's 2:1 harmonic ladder). 20 is the dominant cycle measured on the 3x indices. Lines ±60; source ln(close).
candidates.signals: Confirmed bars only. 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +60). 高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +60). 安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −60). 安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −60).
candidates.repaint: Windowed, with no recursion and no pivots, so there is no repaint and no dependence on where history starts. Gate by barstate.isconfirmed. Delay: 0 bars.
candidates.behavior_at_turns: The line's extreme comes a median 1-2 bars before the price extreme. Pivot in zone or ≤3 bars after: 23 / 32 / 24%. Within ±5 bars: 27 / 38 / 34%. Late-only: 1-5%. Precision: 30 / 27 / 42%, the best of the cycle designs. About 26 direction changes per 100 bars (the 10-bar term adds ripple); longest zone episode 8-9 bars. In trends the 40-bar term stays near 0 and a zone is reached only when the short cycles crest together, so the line does not pin.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) Fewer zone visits (about 10-12% of bars), so it misses many 15% swings. (2) The 40-bar window adapts slowly after regime changes. (3) The 2:1 harmonic assumption is often violated by irregular 3x swings. (4) More momentum-like than E7-A and E7-B, so it risks resembling E2.

import numpy as np
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view as swv
def cosphase(x, P):
    out = np.full(len(x), np.nan); i = np.arange(P)
    W = swv(x, P)[:, ::-1]; n = float(P); sx = W.sum(1); sxx = (W*W).sum(1); vx = n*sxx - sx*sx
    def corr(y):
        sy = y.sum(); vy = n*(y*y).sum() - sy*sy
        return np.where(vx > 0, (n*(W@y) - sx*sy)/np.sqrt(vx*vy), 0.0)
    re = corr(np.cos(2*np.pi*i/P)); im = corr(-np.sin(2*np.pi*i/P)); mag = np.sqrt(re*re + im*im)
    out[P-1:] = np.where(mag > 1e-9, re/np.where(mag > 1e-9, mag, 1.0), 0.0); return out
x = np.log(df['Close'].to_numpy(float)); P0 = 20; Ph = int(np.floor(P0/2 + 0.5))   # NOT round(): Python's round is banker's rounding
line = 100*(cosphase(x, Ph) + cosphase(x, P0) + cosphase(x, 2*P0))/3        # NaN until bar 2*P0-1
Signals as in E7-A with T = 60.

elements.recommendation_reason: Among the cycle designs, E7-correlation-cycle-phase gives the best balance on the 3x data. About 17-18% of bars are in zones. Zone entry comes a median 2-3 bars before the extreme and exit comes on the extreme, which is a genuine そろそろ lead. Recall is 18-31% (pivot in zone or ≤3 bars after) and 41-45% (±5 bars), on par with or above RSI14. The path is smooth and sine-like (about 15 direction changes per 100 bars), and it never pins (episodes ≤6 bars). Most importantly for the user's rule that the indicators must not resemble each other, its zones almost never coincide with momentum zones (Jaccard vs RSI 0.03-0.07, line corr 0.37-0.39). It overlaps only modestly with the recommended E8 line (corr 0.42-0.43, zone Jaccard 0.10-0.17). It is a single windowed loop with no recursion, so Pine and pandas match bar for bar and do not depend on chart history. E7-B (MESA) is even less correlated with momentum but weaker and much harder to port. E7-C has the best precision but correlates 0.63 with RSI and 0.66-0.69 with E8, which conflicts with the non-resemblance goal. Candid caveat for the user: cycle tools time regular swings well but are blind at blow-off and capitulation extremes, which is exactly where E8 is strong. How the metrics were computed (for reproduction): NASDAQ Composite and S&P 500 1999-2018 from the arch wheel, and GOOG 2004-2013 from the backtesting wheel, each synthesized to 3x as C3_t = C3_{t−1}(1 + 3r_t), with O/H/L scaled the same way against the prior close and no fees. Ground truth is the prototype's hindsight zigzag(pct=0.15) on the 3x close. A hit is any in-zone bar in [p−3, p]; ±5 means any in-zone bar in [p−5, p+5]; precision counts zone episodes [s, e] with a same-side pivot in [s−2, e+3]. Only bars ≥150 are scored.

candidates.name_ja: TDセットアップ連続線（9カウント）
candidates.concept: DeMark's TD Setup turned into a line: count how many bars in a row the close has been above (or below) the close 4 bars earlier. Each qualifying bar adds one step of 11 points; 9 bars means the setup is complete and the line is at +100. The line enters the 高値圏 on the 7th consecutive bar. When the streak breaks it falls back, halving each bar so the drop looks smooth.
candidates.element_purity: Count only. The inputs are the booleans close_t > close_{t−4} and close_t < close_{t−4}; magnitudes are ignored and one failing bar resets the count. No averages, volatility, swing pivots or candle anatomy. Line corr with RSI14 is 0.70-0.74 because both share direction, but zone overlap with RSI zones is only 0.25-0.32 (Jaccard).
candidates.raw_formula: up_t = close_t > close_{t−4}; dn_t = close_t < close_{t−4}. Comparisons are strict, false for t < 4, and equality resets both. Su_t = up_t ? Su_{t−1} + 1 : 0. Sd_t = dn_t ? Sd_{t−1} + 1 : 0. Seeds 0; the count is not capped at 9. U_t = max(min(Su_t/9, 1), ρ·U_{t−1}). D_t = max(min(Sd_t/9, 1), ρ·D_{t−1}). ρ = 0.5; U and D seeded 0. The TD countdown (13) is deliberately not used: in our check only 6-35% of countdown-13 completions fell within ±5 bars of a 15% pivot (4 of 62 on SPX3), while setup-9 bars came a median 3-5 bars BEFORE the pivot.
candidates.normalization: line = 100·(U − D), in [−100, +100]. While a run is alive the line equals 100·count/9 (11.1 per step, +100 from the 9th bar onward). After a break it halves each bar. This is visual only: entry and exit timing do not change, because 0.5·100 < 75.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±75, which is equivalent to the 7th consecutive bar (77.8 > 75 > 66.7). Measured share beyond: 21.5 / 18.6 / 22.8%, of which the top zone is about 2/3. ±85 (8th bar) gives 14-17%.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
def run_len(b):
    out = np.zeros(len(b)); r = 0
    for t, v in enumerate(b):
        r = r + 1 if v else 0; out[t] = r
    return out
def hold(f, rho=0.5):
    out = np.zeros(len(f)); m = 0.0
    for t, v in enumerate(f):
        m = max(v, rho*m); out[t] = m
    return out
def lagged(a, k):
    up = np.zeros(len(a), bool); dn = np.zeros(len(a), bool)
    up[k:] = a[k:] > a[:-k]; dn[k:] = a[k:] < a[:-k]; return up, dn
c = df['Close'].to_numpy(float); up, dn = lagged(c, 4)
line = 100*(hold(np.minimum(run_len(up)/9, 1)) - hold(np.minimum(run_len(dn)/9, 1)))
s = pd.Series(line, index=df.index); T = 75
topIn = (s > T) & (s.shift() <= T); topOut = (s < T) & (s.shift() >= T)
botIn = (s < -T) & (s.shift() >= -T); botOut = (s > -T) & (s.shift() <= -T)
Notes: comparisons are strict and the first k bars are False, matching Pine's bar_index >= k guard. Close only.

candidates.name_ja: 多重連続カウント（1・2・3本前比）
candidates.concept: Counts, at three horizons at once, how many bars in a row the close has stayed above (or below) the close 1, 2 and 3 bars earlier. Each count is scaled by its rare length (3, 5 and 7 bars) and the three are averaged. Every additional unbroken up-close adds a step (about 22 → 45 → 68 → 79 → 90 in a clean run), so the line visibly climbs as the run matures (そろそろ). It crosses +70 around the 4th clean bar and drops as soon as the run breaks; on 3x ETFs that is usually the bar right after the swing high.
candidates.element_purity: Pure 連続 / カウント. The only inputs are the booleans close_t > close_{t−k} and close_t < close_{t−k}. A +0.2% close and a +8% close count the same, and one opposite close resets the 1-bar run regardless of its size. It uses no price averages or volatility normalisation (≠ E1/E10), no up/down magnitude balance (≠ E2), no rate of change of momentum (≠ E3), no volume (≠ E4), no swing pivots or time since a swing (≠ E5), no swing size (≠ E6), no spectral phase (≠ E7), and no candle anatomy (≠ E9). Long runs coincide with strong moves, so the line correlates 0.66-0.70 with RSI14. But the bars it flags overlap RSI's zones only 0.26-0.27 (Jaccard), whereas RSI and EMA kairi overlap 0.52-0.73.
candidates.raw_formula: For k in {1, 2, 3}: up_k,t = close_t > close_{t−k}; dn_k,t = close_t < close_{t−k}. Comparisons are strict, false for t < k, and equality resets both. ru_k,t = up_k,t ? ru_k,t−1 + 1 : 0. rd_k,t = dn_k,t ? rd_k,t−1 + 1 : 0. Seeds 0, uncapped. N_k = 2k + 1 = 3, 5, 7. Hold and decay: U_k,t = max(min(ru_k,t/N_k, 1), ρ·U_k,t−1) and D_k,t = max(min(rd_k,t/N_k, 1), ρ·D_k,t−1), with ρ = 0.5 and seeds 0. C_k = U_k − D_k, in [−1, 1].
candidates.normalization: line = 100·(C_1 + C_2 + C_3) / 3, in [−100, +100]. No clamp or rescaling is needed.
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±70. Measured share beyond: 17.5 / 14.0 / 17.5% (NAS3 / SPX3 / GOOG3). The top zone is about 2/3 of that, because 3x ETFs rise in consecutive steps and fall in fewer, larger bars. Options: ±65 gives 18-21% and ±75 gives 10-13%. An asymmetric lower line of −60 balances top and bottom visits.

N_k = 2k + 1 equals the measured 90th percentile of bar-level run lengths at each lag on all three 3x series (k=1: 3-4, k=2: 5-6, k=3: 7-8; k=4: 9, DeMark's number), so each component saturates exactly when its run becomes rare. ρ = 0.5 halves a broken run each bar: the fall is smoother and entry timing is unchanged. The design is scale-free, so the defaults are identical for TQQQ, SOXL and SPXL.
candidates.signals: Confirmed bars only. 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +70). 高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +70). 安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −70). 安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −70). Zone states: inTop = line > 70, inBot = line < −70. Typical sequence on hit pivots: 突入 a median 1 bar before the high (IQR 0-3), the last zone bar is the high itself, and 離脱 fires on the next bar. The same pattern holds mirrored at lows.
candidates.repaint: None. Only closes up to the current bar are used, and there are no pivots. The decay memory forgets within about 7 bars, so after a few bars results do not depend on where chart history starts. Signals are gated by barstate.isconfirmed. Delay: 0 bars.
candidates.behavior_at_turns: The most pinpoint of the six candidates: the median offset between the line's extreme and the 15% zigzag extreme is 0 bars. Mean NAS3 line path around tops (t−6..t+4): −3, 4, 12, 18, 22, 31, 53, 26, −10, −33, −36. Around bottoms: −7, −14, −20, −25, −31, −43, −62, −37, −1, 23, 27. Pivot inside the zone or ≤3 bars after exit: 46 / 46 / 55%, with 0% late-only. Within ±5 bars: 51 / 53 / 62%. Precision: 28 / 19 / 41%. For comparison, RSI14 70/30 has recall 22 / 22 / 31% and precision 36 / 27 / 46%. The line is step-like, with about 39 direction changes per 100 bars (RSI about 50). In strong trends the 1-bar run breaks on any down close, so zone episodes last ≤10-11 bars, but a grind produces repeated top-zone visits on each leg of 4+ bars. Capitulation streaks are its strength: NAS3 was −72 on 2002-10-09, −84 on 2009-03-09 and −99 on 2018-12-24, all in the zone on the low. Trend tops built without consecutive closes are missed: 49 on 2000-03-10 and 19 on 2018-10-01.
candidates.failure_modes: (1) V-reversals and one-bar crashes: big but non-consecutive moves never build counts, since the line is magnitude-blind by design. (2) Grinding uptrends: repeated top-zone visits before the real top (counter-trend false signals). (3) Choppy ranges: 4-bar mini-runs touch the zone (precision 19-41%). (4) Discrete steps: one opposite close knocks 20-30 points off. (5) The bottom zone is visited about half as often as the top zone on 3x ETFs. (6) Exactly equal closes reset runs (rare on daily data).
candidates.python_replication:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
def run_len(b):
    out = np.zeros(len(b)); r = 0
    for t, v in enumerate(b):
        r = r + 1 if v else 0; out[t] = r
    return out
def hold(f, rho=0.5):
    out = np.zeros(len(f)); m = 0.0
    for t, v in enumerate(f):
        m = max(v, rho*m); out[t] = m
    return out
def lagged(a, k):
    up = np.zeros(len(a), bool); dn = np.zeros(len(a), bool)
    up[k:] = a[k:] > a[:-k]; dn[k:] = a[k:] < a[:-k]; return up, dn
c = df['Close'].to_numpy(float); comps = []
for k in (1, 2, 3):
    up, dn = lagged(c, k); Nk = 2*k + 1
    comps.append(hold(np.minimum(run_len(up)/Nk, 1)) - hold(np.minimum(run_len(dn)/Nk, 1)))
line = 100*(comps[0] + comps[1] + comps[2])/3
s = pd.Series(line, index=df.index); T = 70
topIn = (s > T) & (s.shift() <= T); topOut = (s < T) & (s.shift() >= T)
botIn = (s < -T) & (s.shift() >= -T); botOut = (s > -T) & (s.shift() <= -T)
Notes: the line is defined from bar 0 (no NaN); score from bar 10 onward. Comparisons are strict and the first k bars are False, as in Pine's bar_index >= k guard. Close only; 3x synthesis is C3_t = C3_{t−1}·(1 + 3·r_t). Values are continuous because of the decay, so exact ties at ±70 do not occur in practice.

candidates.name_ja: 高値・安値切り上げ連続
candidates.concept: Counts bar-structure staircases instead of closes. Consecutive higher highs and consecutive higher lows (buyers lifting both ends of the bar day after day) are set against consecutive lower lows and lower highs. Each streak is scaled by 5 bars (about its rare length) and the two are averaged. A long unbroken staircase marks exhaustion of that leg.
candidates.element_purity: Count only, on bar-to-bar extremes. No magnitudes; it resets on the first failing bar; no swing pivots and no volatility. It is not E9: there is no close-location, wick or body analysis, only whether today's high or low exceeds yesterday's. It is the least momentum-like count design tested: line corr with RSI14 0.53-0.60 and with kairi 0.60-0.66; zone overlap with RSI zones 0.14-0.19 (Jaccard).
candidates.raw_formula: hh_t = high_t > high_{t−1}; hl_t = low_t > low_{t−1}; ll_t = low_t < low_{t−1}; lh_t = high_t < high_{t−1}. Comparisons are strict and false at t = 0. Each run length r_* resets to 0 on failure (seeds 0). f = min(r/5, 1). Hold and decay: H(f)_t = max(f_t, ρ·H_{t−1}), with ρ = 0.5 and seed 0. C_HH = H(f_hh) − H(f_ll). C_HL = H(f_hl) − H(f_lh).
candidates.thresholds: Fixed ±65. Measured share beyond: 14.6 / 12.7 / 12.7%. ±60 gives 14-17%.
candidates.pine_v6_sketch:
//@version=6
indicator('E8-C 高値安値切り上げ連続', shorttitle='E8C', overlay=false, max_labels_count=500)
N   = input.int(5, '飽和カウント', minval=2, maxval=15)
rho = input.float(0.5, '途切れ後の減衰 ρ', minval=0.0, maxval=0.9, step=0.1)
upT = input.float(65.0, '高値圏ライン')
loT = input.float(-65.0, '安値圏ライン')
runLen(bool c) =>
    var int r = 0
    r := c ? r + 1 : 0
    r
hold(float f) =>
    var float m = 0.0
    m := math.max(f, rho * m)
    m
float nn = N
bool hh = bar_index >= 1 and high > high[1]
bool hl = bar_index >= 1 and low > low[1]
bool ll = bar_index >= 1 and low < low[1]
bool lh = bar_index >= 1 and high < high[1]
float cHH = hold(math.min(runLen(hh) / nn, 1.0)) - hold(math.min(runLen(ll) / nn, 1.0))
float cHL = hold(math.min(runLen(hl) / nn, 1.0)) - hold(math.min(runLen(lh) / nn, 1.0))
float line = 100.0 * (cHH + cHL) / 2.0
topIn  = ta.crossover(line, upT)
topOut = ta.crossunder(line, upT)
botIn  = ta.crossunder(line, loT)
botOut = ta.crossover(line, loT)
plot(line, 'メインライン', line > upT ? #d32f2f : line < loT ? #2e7d32 : #78909c, 2)
hline(upT, '高値圏ライン', #d32f2f, hline.style_solid)
hline(loT, '安値圏ライン', #2e7d32, hline.style_solid)
if barstate.isconfirmed and (topIn or topOut or botIn or botOut)
    label.new(bar_index, line, topIn ? '高値圏突入' : topOut ? '高値圏離脱' : botIn ? '安値圏突入' : '安値圏離脱', style=(topIn or topOut) ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up, color=(topIn or topOut) ? #d32f2f : #2e7d32, textcolor=color.white, size=size.tiny)
alertcondition(topIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '高値圏突入', '高値圏突入')
alertcondition(botIn and barstate.isconfirmed, '安値圏突入', '安値圏突入')
candidates.default_params: N = 5: the measured bar-level 90th percentile of higher-high and higher-low runs is 5 (lower-low and lower-high: 4) on NAS3. ρ = 0.5, lines ±65. Scale-free.
candidates.signals: Confirmed bars only, which matters here because the realtime high and low can still extend. 高値圏突入 = ta.crossover(line, +65). 高値圏離脱 = ta.crossunder(line, +65). 安値圏突入 = ta.crossunder(line, −65). 安値圏離脱 = ta.crossover(line, −65).
candidates.repaint: None on confirmed bars. It uses only the current and prior bar's high and low; intrabar the current high or low can change, hence the barstate.isconfirmed gating. The decay forgets within about 7 bars. Delay: 0 bars.
candidates.behavior_at_turns: The line's extreme comes a median 0 to 1 bar before the price extreme. Pivot in zone or ≤3 bars after: 39 / 40 / 35%. Late-only: 4-6%. Within ±5 bars: 55 / 53 / 52%. Precision: 25 / 19 / 34%. About 41 direction changes per 100 bars; zone episodes ≤6-10 bars. In strong trends, inside and overlapping bars break the staircase, so it rarely pins; it fires on clean staircases (melt-ups and waterfall declines).
candidates.failure_modes: (1) Inside bars and gap days break or distort streaks. (2) It needs reliable High/Low. On a synthesized 3x series, H/L come from the index's intraday range scaled 3× against the prior close (H3_t = C3_{t−1}·(1 + 3·(H_t/C_{t−1} − 1))), which makes it more sensitive to the synthesis than the close-only designs. (3) Equal highs or lows reset streaks. (4) Lower recall than E8-B, and jumpy.

elements.recommendation_reason: E8-close-run-ensemble has the best turn alignment of all six candidates. The line's extreme sits on the swing-extreme bar itself (median offset 0, and the mean path peaks exactly at the pivot). Recall is 46-55% with zero late-only cases, and 51-62% within ±5 bars, at 14-17.5% of bars in zones — roughly double RSI14's recall. It remains a pure, magnitude-blind count of unbroken closing streaks, and its zones overlap RSI's only 0.26-0.27, versus 0.52-0.73 for kairi vs RSI. It is strongest exactly where E7 is blind: the 2002-10, 2009-03 and 2018-12 capitulation lows were all in the zone on NAS3. Its overlap with the recommended E7 line is modest (corr 0.42-0.43, zone Jaccard 0.10-0.17), so the two panes give different information. The defaults are principled and scale-free (N_k = 2k+1 equals the measured 90th-percentile run length; ρ = 0.5), so no per-ETF tuning is needed. Caveat: the line is step-like and correlates 0.66-0.70 with RSI. If E2's final momentum line turns out too close, E8-hhhl-streak is the more distinct fallback (corr 0.53-0.60, zone overlap 0.14-0.19, recall 35-40%). The TD Sequential countdown was tested and dropped because countdown-13s were poorly aligned on the 3x data (e.g. 4 of 62 within ±5 bars of a pivot on SPX3). Same evaluation protocol as described for E7.
